**Job Summary**
Iron Mountain is seeking an experienced Project Manager, Mechanical and Electrical to join our Data Center Operations team.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing the full lifecycle planning, execution, and delivery of critical mechanical and electrical infrastructure projects across our data center facilities, ensuring work is completed safely, on schedule, and within budget. You will join a high-performing engineering and operations team dedicated to delivering mission-critical reliability, operational excellence, and scalable infrastructure solutions.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Lead Project Delivery and Financial Governance: Direct the end-to-end planning, scheduling, and execution of complex mechanical and electrical projects, managing project budgets, resource allocation, and timelines to deliver data center infrastructure within established financial and operational targets.
* Drive Stakeholder and Partner Collaboration: Partner cross-functionally with internal engineering teams, facility operations, general contractors, and external vendors to negotiate contracts, coordinate equipment procurement, and proactively resolve project risks while minimizing facility disruptions.
* Maintain Quality, Compliance, and Operational Standards: Conduct thorough technical design reviews and on-site quality inspections to ensure all installations strictly adhere to safety regulations, environmental standards, and data center operational best practices.

What You’ll Bring
  
  
**The Ideal Candidate Will Have**

* Relevant Experience: 10+ years of project management experience, including at least 3 years successfully managing mechanical and electrical infrastructure projects within data centers or comparable mission-critical environments.

* Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Construction Management, or equivalent practical hands-on experience in technical facility project management.

description:
***Who We Are?***

Cleantech Industry Resources accelerates United States solar, battery storage and EV projects by providing turnkey development as a service including 100% internal systems engineering. The company deploys a leading team that spun out of the largest solar power producer in the world. This team operates within a sophisticated suite of software to support projects from land origination, through to commercial operation.

***Location of Position:***

Chennai, India (Remote Coordination for USA-based Projects)

***What We Offer***

* Opportunity to join a top-notch, collaborative team of professionals
* Fantastic team environment and collaborative culture
* Professional development opportunities to grow into an industry leader
* Medical Insurance for the employee and family
* Spot Recognition bonus for exceptional performance
* Long Term Incentive policy
* Regular team outings, events, and activities to foster a positive work environment

***Our Commitment to Diversity***

At CIR, we are dedicated to nurturing a diverse and equitable workforce that truly reflects our community. We deeply value each person’s unique perspective, skills, and experiences. CIR embraces all individuals, regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or nationality. We are steadfast in our commitment to fostering a just and inclusive world through intentional policies and actions. Your individuality enriches our collective strength, and we strive to ensure everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered.

***Position Summary***

The Project Manager will oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of solar projects executed in the United States while coordinating remotely from India. This role involves managing cross-functional teams, ensuring project milestones are met, and maintaining seamless communication with internal teams, external stakeholders, and clients. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in project planning and control within the solar industry and possess strong leadership, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

***Core Responsibilities***

**Project Planning and Execution**

Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables based on contractual agreements.

Develop detailed project plans, schedules, and budgets using tools like MS Projects, Primavera, and Procore, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.

Conduct critical path analysis and adjust project schedules using project management software to meet deadlines and milestones.

Coordinate procurement of materials and equipment with supply chain teams, ensuring timely delivery.

**Stakeholder Coordination and Communication**

Act as the primary point of contact for internal teams, suppliers, contractors, and clients in the USA.

Facilitate effective communication and alignment across time zones, ensuring stakeholder satisfaction.

Use CRM tools to maintain comprehensive records of stakeholder communications and project updates.

Provide regular project updates and status reports through Procore or similar platforms to internal and external stakeholders.

**Team Leadership and Coordination**

Collaborate with engineering, development, SCM, and business development teams to ensure smooth project execution.

Assign tasks and responsibilities to team members while tracking progress using MS Projects and Procore.

Utilize internal CRM tools for task management, tracking deliverables, and facilitating team collaboration.

Foster a collaborative team environment, encouraging innovation and efficiency.

**Risk Management and Compliance**

Identify project risks, assess their impact, and develop mitigation strategies, documenting them within Procore or Primavera.

Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and environmental standards during project execution.

Monitor regulatory requirements and collaborate with stakeholders to secure necessary permits.

**Budget and Financial Management**

Develop and manage project budgets, tracking expenses and ensuring cost control using CRM and financial tools.

Monitor project financials, including invoicing, revenue tracking, and overhead management.

Identify cost-saving opportunities and implement efficiency improvements, leveraging insights from Procore and CRM analytics.

**Documentation and Reporting**

Maintain accurate project documentation, including contracts, schedules, and progress reports, using MS Projects, Procore, and CRM systems.

Prepare and circulate daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports, ensuring alignment with organizational standards.

Archive project records within Procore or CRM platforms for compliance and future reference.

**Commissioning and Post-Project Evaluation**

Oversee the commissioning process, ensuring solar projects are fully operational and documented within project management tools.

Coordinate the handover of completed projects to clients or operations teams using Procore for streamlined documentation.

Conduct post-project evaluations to identify lessons learned and best practices for future projects, leveraging reports from CRM and Procore.

***Education Requirements***

Bachelors/master’s degree in electrical/mechanical engineering.

***Technical Skills and Experience***

**Experience**

8+ years of experience in project management within the solar or renewable energy sector.

Proven experience in managing large-scale solar projects (100MW+ preferred).

Familiarity with US-based regulatory and compliance standards for renewable energy projects is an advantage.

**Technical Skills**

Proficiency in project management tools: Primavera P6, MS Project, SAP, and AutoCAD.

Advanced skills in CRM tools and Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel for reporting.

Basic knowledge of PVsyst and other solar-specific design software is a plus.

**Soft Skills**

Strong problem-solving, analytical, and critical-thinking abilities.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with an ability to manage cross-cultural teams.

Robust multitasking and time management skills to coordinate across time zones effectively.

***Psychosocial Skills /Human Skills/Behavioural Skills***

* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Project Management experience a plus.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to take ideas and run with them from concept to conclusion.
* Technical understanding of clean energy business processes
* Exceptional verbal and writing communication skills with superiors, peers, partners, and other stakeholders.
* Excellent interpersonal skills while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment.

**Additional Requirements**

* Ability to work flexible hours to accommodate US time zones.
* Strong understanding of solar energy systems, construction processes, and commissioning requirements.
* Commitment to driving projects with professionalism, integrity, and a focus on quality.

***Physical Demands***

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. The physical demands of this job require an individual to be able to work at a computer for most of the day, be able to participate in conference calls and travel to team retreats on a time-to-time basis. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

***Work Conditions***

The work environment is usually quiet (normal city traffic noises are common), a blend of artificial and natural light, temperate and generally supports a collaborative work environment. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

***Equal Opportunity Employer***

At Cleantech Industry Resources, we embrace diversity and uphold a strong dedication to establishing an all-encompassing atmosphere for both our staff and associates. Our choices in employment are free from any bias related to race, creed, nationality, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, physical limitations, veteran status, or any other legally safeguarded attributes.

Being an integral part of Cleantech Industry Resources means you can expect to be immersed in a realm of professional possibilities within a culture that nurtures teamwork, adaptability, and the embracing of all.

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Manager, Tax Services –**
**Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) - SAP MM/FICO/SD integration with Direct or Indirect Tax experience**
Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting practice is seeking a Manager, Tax Services professional to help clients modernize and improve their tax operations. In this role, you will lead SAP tax transformation and application managed services efforts, guide teams through complex delivery requirements, and help translate tax and business needs into technology-enabled solutions. You will work across tax, process, and technology teams to support scalable, compliant, and efficient tax functions.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Manager, Tax Services professional on the Tax Transformation Consulting team, you will be responsible for...
  
  

* Business Development: Develop and maintain contact with top decision makers at key clients; organize and lead pursuit teams; participate and lead aspects of the proposal development process; contribute to the development of proposal pricing strategies
* Client Management: Manage the day-to-day interactions with executive clients and sponsors
* Engagement Management: Lead engagement planning and budgeting; mobilize and manage engagement teams; define deliverable structure and content; facilitate buy-in of proposed solutions from top management levels at the client; direct on-time, quality delivery of work products; manage engagement economics; and manage engagement risk
* AMS Delivery & Operations Management: Own end-to-end delivery of SAP FICO/MM/SD tax AMS engagements, including SLA governance, ticket triage and escalation across L1/L2/L3, incident and problem management, and driving continuous improvement in support processes and tooling
* Practice Development & Eminence: Develop practical solutions and methodologies; develop "thought-ware" and "point-of-view" documents; participate in public speaking events; get published in industry periodicals
* People Development: Perform the role of counselor and coach; provide input and guidance into the staffing process; actively participate in staff recruitment and retention activities; provide leadership and support for delivery teams and staff in local offices

**The team**
Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) - Ever expanding regulations and increasing scrutiny on multinational corporations has made it necessary for leading-edge tax departments to serve a critical role in the risk management and overall performance of the enterprise. This has resulted in an opportunity for Deloitte to provide even greater value through our tax services, in helping develop tax departments of the future that are strategic, agile, and, above all, focused on creating value for the business.
  
  
Deloitte's TTC group helps our clients' tax departments move forward from their current state to the next generation of tax functions and is dedicated to finding new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations. Deloitte TTC professionals are aligned across our global network of member firms to address our clients' objectives in a seamless fashion. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who help connect our clients' global strategies with the options that exist to turn strategy into an executable plan.
  
  
TTC's Enterprise Tax Transformation (ETT) professionals provide an integrated approach to process improvement that can help the tax department maximize its strategic value to the organization. Companies that have already implemented, or are considering implementing, an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system often overlook the tax benefits these systems can provide or underestimate the impact on the tax department. To be most effective from a tax perspective, a successful ERP implementation requires professionals who specialize in tax and can effectively address a corporate tax function's unique needs, requirements, and obligations. Our ETI team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology, and practical experience to help clients avoid the pitfalls of an ERP implementation.
  
  
How you’ll grow At Deloitte - We’ve invested a great deal to create a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. We want all our people to develop in their own way, playing to their own strengths as they hone their leadership skills. And, as a part of our efforts, we provide our professionals with a variety of learning and networking opportunities—including exposure to leaders, sponsors, coaches, and challenging assignments—to help accelerate their careers along the way. No two people learn in the same way. So, we provide a range of resources including live classrooms, team-based learning, and eLearning. DU: The Leadership Center in India, our state-of-the-art, world-class learning Center in the Hyderabad offices is an extension of the Deloitte University (DU) in Westlake, Texas, and represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to our people’s growth and development. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.
  
  
Deloitte supports your progression through a well-defined career path by providing challenging assignments, mentoring, and targeted trainings. Recent postgraduates begin as a consultant. The career path from there is to senior consultant, then manager, senior manager and onto a path to director or partner or principal.
  
  
Deloitte’s culture
  
  
Our positive and supportive culture encourages our people to do their best work every day. We celebrate individuals by recognizing their uniqueness and offering them the flexibility to make daily choices that can help them to be healthy, centred, confident, and aware. We offer well-being programs and are continuously looking for new ways to maintain a culture that is inclusive, invites authenticity, leverages our diversity, and where our people excel and lead healthy, happy lives. Learn more about Life at Deloitte.
  
  
Corporate citizenship
  
  
Deloitte is led by a purpose: to make an impact that matters. This purpose defines who we are and extends to relationships with our clients, our people, and our communities. We believe that business has the power to inspire and transform. We focus on education, giving, skill-based volunteerism, and leadership to help drive positive social impact in our communities. Learn more about Deloitte’s impact on the world.
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad/Bengaluru/Mumbai/Pune/Gurugram/Chennai/Kolkata
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 8 to 15+ years of total experience
* 5+ years of implementation experience in SAP ECC 6.0 & S/4HANA with a focus on Tax integration across SAP FICO/MM/SD, including Direct or Indirect Tax experience
* Experience with tax technology applications such as ONESOURCE/Global Next Integration, Vertex Accelerator and Chainflow Accelerator Integration, Avalara, and Sovos
* Expert in Direct and Indirect Tax configuration, Withholding Taxes, local country indirect tax localizations, VAT customizations, and reporting

* Relentless focus on quality of work products while adhering to completing deliverables on time

* Strong analytical skills in business process design and requirements preparation
* Chartered Accountant, MBA, Master of Commerce (M.Com), or comparable/equivalent postgraduate qualification, with overall experience in Finance, Accounting, Taxation, and Audit

Preferred:

title: IT Strategist
description:
**Job Title:**
IT Strategist
  
  
**Department**
: ISPL Cardif IT
  
  
**About Business Line/Function**
BNP Paribas Cardif is a world leader in bancassurance partnerships, providing its customers with products and services that let them realise their goals while protecting themselves from unforeseen events. BNP Paribas Cardif is committed to having a positive impact on society and to making insurance more accessible. A subsidiary of BNP Paribas, the insurer has a unique business model anchored in partnerships. It creates solutions for more than 500 partner distributors in a variety of sectors – including banks and financial institutions, automotive sector companies, retailers and telecommunications companies – as well as for financial advisors and brokers who market the products to their customers. With a presence in 30 countries and strong positions in Europe, Asia and Latin America, BNP Paribas Cardif is a global specialist in personal insurance, the world leader in creditor insurance and a major contributor to financing for the real economy. With 9,000 employees worldwide, BNP Paribas Cardif had gross written premiums of €40.5 billion in 2025.
  
  
BNP Paribas Cardif IT is a global organization with about 3000 IT staff across Europe, Latin America and Asia. Its mission is to drive and support our business strategy across all regions by leading digital transformation and delivering secure, resilient, and scalable industrial technology solutions. It is committed to enabling innovation, strengthening cyber resilience, and fostering collaboration and diversity across markets and teams to create exceptional value for our customers and partners, and ensure sustainable growth for BNP Paribas Cardif at the global scale.
  
  
**Position Purpose:**
The
**IT Strategist**
is the strategic architect and operational orchestrator for the IT leadership team. This role is responsible for defining the department's strategic direction and ensuring its successful execution through rigorous governance, transformation management, and high-level communication. You will act as the bridge between strategic intent (CTO/CIO vision) and operational reality (Production/Delivery), ensuring that the organization’s transformation—specifically the India sourcing initiative—is seamless, data-driven, and delivers maximum value to our business beneficiaries.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Strategic Definition & Roadmap Orchestration
* Strategy Formulation: Actively contribute to the definition and promotion of the IT industrialization and production strategy, ensuring alignment with the BNP Paribas Group’s global technological policy.
* Transformation Roadmap: Design and manage the multi-year transformation roadmap, translating long-term vision into actionable milestones for the India transition and other strategic shifts.
* Decision Support: Provide the COO/Head of IT with high-level synthesis, risk opinions, and "decision-ready" intelligence to facilitate complex strategic choices.
* Executive Communication & Visual Storytelling
* Strategic Narrative Design: Lead the creation of sophisticated, executive-level presentations (PowerPoint) for Steering Committees, Board reviews, and Group-level reporting.
* Stakeholder Alignment: Develop and execute communication plans that translate technical and operational complexities into clear, compelling business value for Onshore Beneficiaries and Group leadership.
* Transparency & Reporting: Establish a culture of transparency by designing high-level reporting frameworks that provide a consolidated view of strategy, budget, and transformation progress.
* Governance, Performance & Business Alignment
* Governance Frameworks: Implement and lead governance bodies to facilitate decision-making processes, trajectory monitoring, and stakeholder alignment.
* KPI & Performance Architecture: Define and oversee the deployment of relevant performance indicators (KPIs/SLOs) to monitor the quality, stability, and ROI of the new operational setup.
* Business Relationship Liaison: Act as the ultimate escalation point for "business irritants," ensuring that the interests of Onshore Beneficiaries are represented in the design and implementation of new IT solutions.
* Operational & Financial Oversight
* Transformation Monitoring: Oversee the "Build, Run, Improve" cycle of the transformation, ensuring that the transition to India delivers expected efficiency and cost-control targets.
* Budget & Cost Governance: Monitor the departmental strategic budget, ensuring that investments in transformation and production are based on a clear business rationale (ROI/Efficiency).
* Risk & Continuity Oversight: Ensure that the transformation strategy integrates IT Risk, Cybersecurity, and Business Continuity (BCP) requirements from the design phase.

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**

* Strategy & Transformation: Proven ability to define, promote, and implement large-scale organizational change and IT industrialization strategies.
* Business / IT Relationship Management: Expertise in managing complex stakeholder ecosystems and aligning IT capabilities with business needs.
* Financial & Budget Steering: Ability to manage strategic budgets, monitor cost evolution, and ensure the financial viability of the transformation roadmap.
* Risk & Governance: Deep understanding of IT Risk, Cybersecurity governance, and the ability to provide informed "Risk Opinions" on strategic decisions.

**Specific Qualifications**
**Skills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities)**
**Technical Skills**

* Advanced Visual Storytelling: Mastery of PowerPoint to create high-impact, executive-level visual narratives.
* Analytical Ability: Superior ability to synthesize vast amounts of data into actionable strategic insights.
* Project/Program Management: Advanced knowledge of Agile, Waterfall, and ITIL methodologies to oversee complex, multi-threaded programs.
* Change Management: Ability to understand, explain, and support large-scale organizational change.

**Behavioral Skills**

* Impact & Influence: Exceptional ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive commitment toward a shared strategic vision.
* Decision Making: Ability to make high-pressure decisions based on incomplete or complex information.
* Resilience: High capacity to maintain focus and leadership stability in a fast-paced, transformative, and often ambiguous environment.
* Creativity & Problem Solving: A proactive approach to identifying bottlenecks in the transformation and designing innovative solutions.
* Communication Excellence: Mastery of both oral and written communication in English, tailored for executive audiences.

**Education Level:**
Master’s Degree
  
  
**Experience:**
10–15+ years
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai
  
  
**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. title: ERP Implementation Executive
description:
**ERP Implementation Executive – BOS**

**Location:**
Chennai, Tamil Nadu

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About BOS**

**BOS is a next-generation Business Operating System designed to help companies manage and connect their operations across areas such as sales, procurement, inventory, manufacturing, finance, workforce management and other business functions.**

**BOS goes beyond traditional ERP software by adapting to the operational processes of each organisation rather than forcing every business into a rigid, predefined system.**

**We are currently implementing BOS with businesses across multiple industries and are looking for an ERP Implementation Executive to work directly with customers and our product and development teams.**

**About the Role**

**As an ERP Implementation Executive, you will help businesses successfully adopt and implement BOS.**

**This is not primarily a software development role. You will work closely with business owners, department heads and operational users to understand how their business works, configure BOS around their processes, coordinate data migration, train users, support testing and take departments through go-live.**

**You will act as the bridge between the customer and the BOS product/development team**
.

The role provides significant exposure to real business operations and is suited to someone who wants to develop a career in ERP implementation, business analysis and enterprise technology consulting.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Meet customers, department heads and operational users to understand their existing business processes.
* Study how departments currently operate using ERP systems, Excel, documents and manual processes.
* Document business processes, requirements, approval flows, user roles and operational rules.
* Map existing customer processes to BOS and identify configuration or product requirements.
* Work with the BOS product and development teams to translate business requirements into system requirements.
* Configure customers, users, roles, permissions, departments, workflows and other implementation settings within BOS.
* Assist with collection, cleaning, validation and migration of master and transactional data.
* Coordinate implementation activities across departments such as Commercial, Procurement, Inventory, Manufacturing, Finance and HR/Workforce.
* Conduct product demonstrations and user training for department heads and end users.
* Prepare test scenarios and coordinate functional testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Record issues, gaps and enhancement requirements identified during implementation.
* Work with developers to verify that issues have been correctly resolved.
* Support customers during go-live and post-implementation stabilization.
* Monitor adoption after go-live and help users transition from their existing processes to BOS.
* Maintain implementation documentation, meeting notes, action items and implementation status.
* Visit customer offices and operational locations when required.

**What We Are Looking For**

**We are looking for someone who combines business understanding, communication skills and technology aptitude**
.

The ideal candidate should:

* Be comfortable speaking with business owners, managers and operational staff.
* Be curious about how businesses actually operate.
* Be able to understand a business process and translate it into a software workflow.
* Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Be organised and capable of following multiple implementation activities simultaneously.
* Be comfortable working with Excel and business data.
* Have good written and verbal communication skills.
* Be comfortable learning complex enterprise software.
* Be willing to visit customer locations and work closely with customers during implementations.
* Take ownership of problems rather than simply passing requirements between the customer and development team.

**Preferred Experience**

**Candidates with 1–4 years of experience**
in any of the following would be particularly suitable:

* ERP implementation
* ERP functional consulting
* Business analysis
* Software implementation
* Customer onboarding for enterprise software
* Manufacturing ERP
* Inventory or warehouse systems
* Procurement systems
* HRMS / payroll implementation
* Accounting or finance software implementation

Experience with systems such as
**SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Odoo, Zoho, Tally, ERPNext or similar ERP/business applications**
would be beneficial but is not mandatory.

Candidates who have worked inside manufacturing or other operational businesses and have strong systems knowledge may also be considered.

**Educational Background**

**Relevant qualifications may include:**

* B.Com / M.Com
* BBA / MBA
* BCA / MCA
* BE / B.Tech
* Information Systems
* Operations / Supply Chain
* Finance / Accounting
* or another relevant discipline

We value practical ability and willingness to learn more than a specific degree.

**Skills That Will Be Valuable**

* ERP implementation
* Business process mapping
* Requirements gathering
* Functional documentation
* User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
* Data migration
* Microsoft Excel
* User training
* Customer communication
* Project coordination
* SQL knowledge – advantageous but not required
* Understanding of APIs/integrations – advantageous but not required
* Understanding of AI and modern business software – advantageous

**Why Join BOS?**

**BOS is being built as an alternative to the traditional approach to enterprise software.**

**Rather than joining an organisation where you repeatedly implement the same predefined ERP modules, you will have the opportunity to understand different businesses and help shape how their operations are represented within a new generation of business software.**

**You will work closely with the BOS leadership, product and engineering teams and gain exposure to:**

* Enterprise software implementation
* Business process design
* Manufacturing and operational businesses
* Product development
* Business analysis
* AI-enabled enterprise software
* Customer consulting
* Implementation project management

As BOS grows, this role can develop into
**Implementation Consultant, Senior Implementation Consultant, Implementation Manager and Implementation/Operations leadership roles**
.

description:

Zyeta designs and delivers future-ready workplaces, from corporate office interiors and turnkey fit-outs to workplace strategy and WELL and sustainability consulting. As Construction Manager – Civil & Interiors, you will lead civil and interior execution across corporate workplace fit-out projects, covering partitions, ceilings, flooring, glazing, joinery, painting and furniture installation. description:

**Job Description**
The CAS Audit Project Manager is primarily responsible for completing internal audit engagement assignments with minimal supervision from audit team management. The Audit Project Manager is expected to understand risk and risk management techniques, identify and analyze business processes, key risks and critical controls, and evaluate control design adequacy; perform or supervise control testing; and document work performed in conformance with internal audit policies and procedures. This individual may also be involved in other side projects, department initiatives, and other administrative audit activities. The ideal candidate has internal audit experience in the financial services industry specifically bank operations.
  
  
The primary focus of this role over the next 36 months includes completing annual key SOX financial statement control testing for internal audit and other audit support work specific to bank operations. Internal audit performs SOX testing on behalf of management to ensure strong reliance by external auditors. The role may directly or indirectly lead team members.
  
  
**Key accountabilities:**

* Performing control testing and/or supervising staff auditors performing control testing based on audit program directions. Includes using appropriate sampling and control testing techniques; identifying and assessing the relevance of possible issues; and documenting work performed to support audit scope and conclusions, to facilitate an efficient review, and to meet internal audit policies and procedures.
* Drafting audit issues under the supervision of audit team management. Includes drafting potential exposures and significance, identifying appropriate root causes, and developing operationally effective and cost-effective recommendations.
* Assisting audit team management in the reporting and wrap-up phases of audits. Includes assisting with drafting audit reports.
* Learning from and applying coaching received.
* Serving as a subject matter expert in a particular topic, helping drive strategy, and may support multiple audit engagements covering the related topics.
* Handling complex tasks autonomously and being able to influence business line understanding of risk mitigation.
* Performing other duties as requested by audit team management.
* Assisting audit team management in planning audit engagements. Includes understanding risk and risk management techniques; identifying and analyzing business processes, key risks, and critical controls; interviewing auditees; and evaluating control design adequacy.
* Providing coaching and on-the-job training for team members, as applicable, to ensure engagements are completed in conformance with internal audit policies and procedures.
* Partnering with the assigned line of business, other Risk/Compliance/Audit (RCA) professionals and managers, and RCA Managers to, depending on their function, create, implement, maintain, review or oversee an effective risk management framework.
* Participating in projects and/or activities ensure compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations.
* Identifying gaps and informing solutions that minimize losses resulting from inadequate internal processes, systems, or human errors.
* Identifying, responding to, or escalating risks, as appropriate.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience
* Typically more than ten years of applicable experience

**Preferred Skills and Experience:**

* Considerable knowledge of applicable laws, regulations, financial services, and regulatory trends that impact bank operations, including cash servicing, money movement, deposit processing, legal order processing, treasury client servicing, claims/disputes and complaint handling, card operations, and print services. Candidate should also understand the evolving use of artificial intelligence and process automation to create efficiencies and streamline processes.
* Relevant internal audit experience in the financial services industry in areas including SOX, regulatory compliance, and risk management.
* Considerable understanding of the business line’s operations, services, systems, and associated risks and controls.
* Considerable knowledge of Risk/Compliance/Audit competencies and the ability to hold others accountable on individual projects.
* Advanced process facilitation, project management, and analytical skills for complex processes.
* Thorough understanding of The Institute of Internal Auditors’ Global Internal Audit Standards and the common definition of internal controls.
* Business acumen and credibility to help business lines proactively identify and address the evolving risk landscape and changing workforce needs.
* Excellent presentation, interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills.
* Strong critical thinking and analytical skills.
* Proven adaptability to changing priorities and the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously.
* Ability to successfully coordinate with multiple groups to complete projects.
* Proficient computer navigation skills using a variety of software packages, including Microsoft applications.
* Relevant professional certifications, such as CIA, CFE, CISA, Accredited Payments Risk Professional, etc.

**Role Overview**

The role requires a strong understanding of end-to-end book production, excellent client communication skills, and the ability to coordinate effectively with internal production, editorial, composition, quality, and technology teams.

The ideal candidate will have experience working with a publishing house or a publishing services company, understand the complete book production lifecycle, and be capable of managing customer expectations, delivery schedules, quality standards, and operational performance.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1.     End-to-End Book Production Management**

* Demonstrate a thorough understanding of the complete book production lifecycle, from manuscript receipt to final deliverables.
* Manage and monitor production stages, including:
* Manuscript assessment, pre-editing, and content preparation.
* Copyediting, language editing, and proofreading.
* Typesetting and composition, including print and digital formats.
* Artwork, tables, figures, permissions, and reference management.
* Author queries, corrections, and review cycles.
* Page proofing, quality checks, and final file validation.
* Indexing, where applicable, and preparation of print-ready PDFs and eBook outputs.
* Final delivery, archival, and project closure.
* Ensure adherence to client-specific workflows, production schedules, quality benchmarks, and service-level agreements (SLAs).
* Monitor project progress, identify bottlenecks, and implement corrective actions to avoid delays and rework.

**2.     Production Coordination & Delivery**

* Coordinate with production managers, editors, typesetters, proofreaders, quality teams, and other stakeholders.
* Track multiple titles and projects simultaneously, ensuring visibility into milestones, dependencies, and delivery timelines.
* Monitor production volumes, turnaround times (TAT), quality metrics, and pending activities.
* Ensure that project teams have clear briefs, specifications, and priorities.
* Escalate risks in advance and drive timely resolution of production issues.
* Ensure compliance with publishing standards, customer specifications, and internal quality processes.

**3. Quality & Process Improvement**

* Maintain high standards of editorial, compositional, and final-delivery quality.
* Analyse recurring errors, customer feedback, rework, and production delays to identify root causes.
* Work with internal teams to implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, improve productivity, and reduce production costs without compromising quality.
* Support the adoption of workflow automation, digital publishing solutions, and AI-enabled tools wherever relevant.
* Monitor account-level performance against agreed SLAs, quality standards, and delivery commitments.
* Support workload planning, resource coordination, and production forecasting.
* Track relevant operational metrics, including productivity, turnaround time, error rates, rework, and customer satisfaction.
* Support estimates, production planning, scope discussions, and change requests in coordination with the relevant internal teams.
* Identify potential opportunities to expand the scope of services offered to existing customers.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

·        5–7 years of relevant experience in book publishing, book production, or publishing services.

·        Candidates from publishing houses, academic publishers, STM publishers, trade publishers, or publishing services companies are preferred.

·        Strong practical knowledge of book production stages, workflows, terminology, and deliverables.

·        Postgraduate qualification preferred.

·        Strong academic background, preferably from a reputed institution, with English-medium education.

·        Excellent spoken and written English

·        Strong email-writing, meeting-management, presentation, and reporting skills.

·        Ability to explain production issues, risks, and corrective actions clearly and professionally.

title: Senior Consultant – Business Systems Analyst – Coupa
description:
**Role Title:**
Senior Consultant – Business Systems Analyst – Coupa
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai
  
  
We are one purpose-led global organisation. The enablers and innovators, ensuring that we can fulfil our mission to push the boundaries of science and discover and develop life-changing medicines. We take pride in working close to the cause, opening the locks to save lives, ultimately making a massive difference to the outside world.
  
  
AstraZeneca (AZ) is in a period of strong growth and our employees have a united purpose to make a difference to patients around the world who need both our medicines and the ongoing developments from our science. In this journey AZ must continue to work across borders and with partners and new colleagues in a fast and seamless way. The ambition, size and complexity of the organisation, coupled with the opportunities afforded by new technology, has led the Board to approve a large-scale transformation programme – Axial.
  
  
The Axial Programme will be powered by S/4HANA a new ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) system which will be implemented right across the organisation and will provide our business with standardised processes, enhanced financial management, common data and real time reporting, transforming the way we work through our entire supply chain - from bench to patient.
  
  
The new system will be used by more than 20,000 employees daily, is foundational to all AZ entities and is central to most core business processes. This is a once in a generation programme for AstraZeneca and will shape our ways of working globally for many years to come.
  
  
The Axial programme needs the best talent to work in it. Whether it’s the technical skills, business understanding or change leadership, we want to ensure we have the strongest team deployed throughout. We are striving to deliver a world class change programme that leaves all employees with a fuller understanding of their role in the end-to-end nature of our global company. This programme will provide AZ with a competitive edge, to the benefit of our employees, customers and patients.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Business Analysis Leadership: Apply business analysis techniques and lead delivery within a global S/4HANA Finance transformation, ensuring solutions align with clear business objectives.
* Finance Capability Design: Be responsible for the design of Finance capabilities, enable seamless delivery across releases, and lead solution remediation to protect process integrity and performance.
* SAP Best Practice and Architecture: Ensure compliance with SAP best practices, maintain integrated architecture standards, and implement robust, compliant data designs that endure.
* Planning and Risk Management: Assist in project planning, proactively handle risks and interdependencies, and keep delivery on time and on budget.
* Delivery Methodologies: Organise and implement project activities using Agile or Waterfall approaches, including SAP Activate, selecting the right tool for the outcome.
* Multi-functional Solution Design: Partner with the IT Design Team to produce solution designs that meet business and multi-functional requirements without fragmenting standards.
* Global Process Alignment: Engage with Enterprise Process Owners to define IT solutions that align to standardised global processes and deliver consistent outcomes.
* Finance Process Design and Integration: Lead Finance process design during global definition, ensuring deep integration with SAP solutions and related data objects.
* Standards Development and Testing: Develop and test global standard solutions, and bring designs through governance forums and frameworks to ensure adoption and quality.
* Product and Design Integration: Work with IT Business Analysts, Product Managers, and design experts to ensure global designs are coherent, scalable, and integrated.
* Innovation with External Experts: Collaborate with partner SME to bring the best of technology and standard approaches into our solutions.
* Strategic Design Forums: Participate in cross-functional design forums to align global designs with strategic business goals and system architecture.
* Localisation within Standards: Address localisation needs during deployment while safeguarding global standardisation and maintainability.
* Documentation and Enablement: Create clear solution designs, maintain high-quality project documentation, and deliver training on relevant tools and technologies.
* Coupa Solution and Process Expertise: Apply hands-on Coupa experience to analyse, design, and support Coupa-enabled procurement and invoicing capabilities integrated with SAP S/4HANA.
* P2P and Accounts Payable Process Leadership: Bring strong end-to-end business process understanding across Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Accounts Payable (AP), including requisitioning, purchasing, goods receipt, invoicing, matching, approvals, and payment-related dependencies.
* Coupa-to-SAP Data Mapping and Validation: Define, review, and validate Coupa versus SAP field mappings for master and transactional data; establish mapping rules, identify data gaps, reconcile interface outputs, and support defect resolution through SIT and UAT.

**Essential For The Role**

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field of study or equivalent experience
* Experience applying business analysis tools, techniques, and concepts (e.g., requirements management, user-centered design, business process/product design) to deliver business change
* Experience collaborating with business partners to identify and address process/product requirements and IT needs
* Experience leading discussions, identifying and documenting business IT problem statements, business process/product design, and report requirements
* Experience working with third-party suppliers/vendors and supplier solutions/products
* Experience planning and handling resources and budgets within assigned areas
* Demonstrable hands-on experience working with Coupa, including procurement and invoicing processes and integration touchpoints with SAP.
* Strong functional understanding of end-to-end Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Accounts Payable (AP) business processes, controls, and data flows.
* Prior experience mapping Coupa fields to SAP fields for master and transactional data, with responsibility for data validation, reconciliation, interface testing, and defect analysis during SIT and UAT.

**Desirable for the Role**

* Certification in business analysis practice (preferred)
* Experience in advising business partners across one or more functional domains within the pharmaceutical industry;
* Experience in effectively communicating with and influencing individuals at various levels (e.g., peers, managers, team members)
* Experience working within a global matrix organization, including geographically dispersed teams and partners.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.
  
  
**Why AstraZeneca?**
At Astrazeneca we’re dedicated to being a Great Place to Work. Where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. There’s no better place to make a difference to medicine, patients and society. An inclusive culture that champions diversity and collaboration, and always committed to lifelong learning, growth and development. We’re on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare.
  
  
**So, what’s next?**

* Are you already imaging yourself joining our team? Good, because we can’t wait to hear from you.
* Are you ready to bring new ideas and fresh thinking to the table? Brilliant! We have one seat available and hope its yours
* If you’re curious to know more then we welcome your application. Apply now!

description:
**Role Description**
Head of Onboarding & Event Management India ( Investment Banking)
  
  
Overview of Role
  
  
The Onboarding & Event Management Module is comprised of 4 key pillars:
  
  
Data Management,
  
  
Third party setup,
  
  
Derivative Onboarding and Broker Management.
  
  
The team is tasked with delivering all onboarding activities required to bring a Client or Client Fund to life on our Investment platform.
  
  
The primary responsibility of this candidate is to efficiently manage the delivery of the end-to-end setup, maintenance, and closure of mandates, portfolios, agreements, and related accounts across key systems. You will be responsible for developing and managing a multiskilled team.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead, mentor and develop team members across multiple locations fostering a culture of collaboration and openness.
* Oversee daily operations and performance of the team, ensuring delivery of a high-quality service to clients and stakeholders.
* Work with the Head of Onboarding Delivery & Oversight to manage prioritisation of onboarding activities.
* Manage the teams capacity, ensuring all activities are allocated, monitored and delivered against agreed timelines and SLA’s
* Identify end-to-end process enhancements for efficiency gains and risk reduction, ensuring all changes are agreed before being implemented.
* Monitor market and regulatory changes and where required implement changes to processes and procedures
* Ensure strict adherence to all procedures and ensure that process outcomes are fully trackable and auditable.

* Ensure risk is managed and our risk recording policy is strictly adhered to and notify the Head of Global Platform Onboarding as any issues arrive.

Overview of the areas you will be responsible for delivering:

* Experience of developing and managing a multiskilled team

title: Adoption Manager Content & Channel
description:
**Summary**
The Adoption Manager is responsible for driving hands-on adoption of Guided Buying across priority Layer-4 taxonomy sub-categories and rollout markets. The role converts category strategy into practical buying journeys, activates super-user networks, coordinates targeted enablement, and uses adoption data to improve user behavior and channel conversion. Success in this role means users are guided to the right buying channels because the experience is clear, relevant, and easier than off-channel alternatives.
  
 
  
**Job Responsibilities:**

* **Adoption planning:**
  Develop sub-category adoption plans with category managers, defining the target buying channel, user groups, buying scenarios, adoption risks, and intervention plan for each wave.
* **Buying journey design:**
  Map how users buy today and define the future-state buying journey across catalogues, contract-linked purchase orders, preferred suppliers, tactical sourcing, or other approved routes.
* **Super-user activation:**
  Identify, engage, and manage super users by market, location, or user group; establish feedback loops and ensure user issues are captured, prioritised, and resolved.
* **Enablement and communications:**
  Partner with Change & Enablement and Experience teams to deliver targeted walkthroughs, Q&A, quick reference material, and nudges that address specific buying behaviours.
* **Data-led intervention:**
  Monitor adoption signals including Guided Buying usage, channel utilisation, free-text buying, off-channel activity, catalogue usage, contract operationalisation, and recurring user issues.
* **Issue resolution:**
  Work with C&C Operations, Local Procurement, category owners, supplier enablement, and BAU teams to resolve root causes such as content gaps, channel design issues, supplier readiness, data quality, or unclear ownership.
* **Governance and reporting:**
  Maintain the adoption tracker, manage actions and risks, provide progress updates to the Adoption Lead, and escalate decisions or blockers that put adoption targets at risk.

 
  
**Required Skills:**

* **P2P/S2P and procurement-channel adoption:**
  Approximately seven or more years in procurement or transformation, including direct work with guided buying, catalogues, contract-linked buying, or preferred-supplier routes to drive measurable change in adoption.
* **Hands-on adoption delivery:**
  Owned adoption plans, user segmentation, buying journeys, interventions, super-user networks, and issue resolution—not only communications or training.
* **Data-led problem solving:**
  Used channel-utilisation, free-text, off-channel, catalogue, contract, or user-issue data to diagnose causes and prioritise action to drive adoption metrics.
* **Influence across functions and markets:**
  Secured delivery from category, procurement operations, suppliers, technology, change, and local-market teams without direct authority.
* **Transformation delivery and ambiguity:**
  Delivered in a complex rollout, managed dependencies and risks, and converted unclear requirements into an actionable plan with governance.

 
  
**Preferred Skills:**

* **SAP Ariba ecosystem exposure:**
  Practical exposure to SAP Ariba Guided Buying, SLP, Supplier Business Network, or a comparable procurement platform.
* **BAU transition and repeatability:**
  Built a playbook, governance cadence, exit criteria, and named ownership to sustain adoption after rollout.

title: SDM-IOA Delivery
description:
**Job Summary**
Serve as a seasoned service delivery manager for integrated order and assortment solutions in a hybrid work model driving reliable purchase order management services for global retail clients while ensuring data accuracy across master data management processes and optimizing store facing outcomes through stable day shift operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Manage end to end service delivery for integrated order automation solutions that support consistent and timely purchase order processing for global retail customers in a hybrid work environment.
* Coordinate with cross functional technology and business teams to ensure stable day shift operations for purchase order management applications that directly support store replenishment and vendor collaboration.
* Monitor service performance indicators for purchase order workflows and master data records to detect issues early and drive measurable improvements in accuracy throughput and system availability.
* Define and enforce standardized operating procedures for incident management problem resolution and change implementation within the purchase order management and master data management retail landscape.
* Collaborate with product owners and business analysts to translate retail buying and merchandising requirements into practical service enhancements that improve purchase order cycle time and data quality.
* Oversee release planning and deployment activities for enhancements and defect fixes across purchase order management solutions while minimizing disruption to business operations during day shift windows.
* Establish clear communication routines with stakeholders to provide transparent updates on service status incident root causes and remediation plans for master data management and purchase order processes.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that simplify purchase order creation approval and tracking flows while ensuring alignment with retail master data standards and store operations needs.
* Coordinate with vendor and internal support teams to ensure timely resolution of priority incidents affecting purchase order submission acknowledgement and receipt posting in downstream retail systems.
* Track operational risks related to data integrity configuration changes and integration points between purchase order management master data repositories and store systems and work to mitigate these risks proactively.

title: Manufacturing Optimization Engineer
description:
**Summary**
Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other’s ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It’s the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you’ll do more than join something — you’ll add something.
  
  
**Description**
Manufacturing Optimization Engineers (MOEs) own the continuous improvement strategy and operational excellence initiatives at Apple’s contract manufacturing (CM) partner factories in India. MOEs are responsible for driving breakthrough performance across safety, quality, productivity and cost by leading lean transformation programs and embedding best-in-class manufacturing practices. MOEs sit at the intersection of Apple’s engineering and operations communities, working cross-functionally to assess current-state performance, develop future-state visions and execute scalable improvement plans. They work in concert with supplier operations, quality and industrial engineering teams, as well as Apple's Product Design and Manufacturing Design organizations. Together, these teams implement and sustain new and existing manufacturing processes, workflows, materials and technologies across Apple's supply base in India.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Target Setting & Planning - collaborate cross-functionally to assess the current state of the plant’s operations and assist in continuous improvement target setting, develop future state vision and implementation plans to drive operational excellence across CM partner factories in India.
* Project Implementation - work as a site DRI to implement and monitor continuous improvement
* projects at CM factories. Facilitate cross-functional expert teams to drive breakthrough or best-in-class performance in equipment, people, quality, material flow, and cost.
* Project Tracking & Reporting - use standard tracking and reporting systems to drive project performance and ensure timely completion of process, quality and cost-saving goals. Prepare and present status reports, key issues, and mitigation plans to Apple leadership teams.
* Sustaining Improvement - perform analysis on equipment and workforce utilization, line balancing, WIP levels, and shop floor management for maximum efficiency and operational excellence. Lead sustainability index improvement projects to conserve natural resources and reduce operational waste.
* Strategic Program - form a Lean strategy for selected major vendors and lead programs of benchmarking and Value Stream Mapping (VSM) to drive systemic improvement across projects and vendors. Study critical areas impacting productivity and yield such as man-machine coordination, robot efficiency, and container design.
* Supplier Coordination - act as liaison between supplier and internal Apple departments, identifying barriers to project success and soliciting support from cross-functional champions when needed. Manage identification, development, and engagement of existing and new/developing supplier partners.
* Best Practice Sharing - coordinate multiple improvement projects simultaneously, identify and drive implementation of model Lean lines/cells, and extend learnings to other suppliers and factories across the network.
* Digital Manufacturing - build and evaluate discrete-event simulation models. Design factory layouts using CAD/CAM and 3D factory modeling tools. Develop plant control systems. Perform ergonomic studies and recommend improvements.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or above in Industrial, Mechanical Engineering or a related field
* 5+ years of manufacturing or engineering experience
* Familiarity with Continuous Improvement (CI) tools and methodologies
* Familiarity with time study methodologies such as MOST, MTM and MODAPTS
* Willingness and ability to travel internationally & domestically up to 50%

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Lean Manufacturing and Lean Six Sigma (Green Belt or Black Belt)
* Knowledge of AI/ML applications in manufacturing environments
* Experience with Design for Assembly (DFA) / Design for Manufacturing (DFM) methodologies
* Experience with discrete-event simulation tools such as FlexSim or Plant Simulation
* Experience with ergonomic simulation tools such as Siemens Jack / Process Simulate Human
* Proficiency in factory layout tools such as Factory CAD, Autodesk Factory Design Suite, or VisMockup
* Strong project management skills with ability to drive multiple concurrent initiatives
* Strong cross-functional stakeholder management skills
* Hands-on experience in any of the following: mechanical engineering, manufacturing practices/techniques involving CNC machined parts, sheet metal, enclosures, jigs, tooling, fixtures, injection molding, vacuum forming, plastic parts, ceramics, or similar
* Experience working with OEMs and Contract Manufacturers
* Strong communication skills; fluent in English (Mandarin proficiency is a plus for cross-regional collaboration)
* Strong project management skills with ability to drive multiple concurrent initiatives
* Strong cross-functional stakeholder management skills

At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.

title: Engineering Leader
description:
**About Us:**
Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Join Us. Build a Better World Through Business.**
At Barry-Wehmiller Companies, we believe business can be a powerful force for good. Headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, we are a global leader in manufacturing technology and services. Since our founding in 1885 as a maker of brewing machinery, we’ve grown through the acquisition of more than 80 companies, serving industries such as packaging, paper converting, sheeting, corrugating, engineering, and IT consulting. In 2016, we ranked No. 10 on the
*St. Louis Business Journal*
list of the city’s Top 150 Privately Held Companies.
  
  
What truly sets us apart is our culture—rooted in Truly Human Leadership, a philosophy that prioritizes the well-being and growth of every individual. We measure success by the way we touch lives, not just by financial results.
  
  
In India, Barry-Wehmiller operates as a hub of innovation and collaboration through our Global Competency Center (GCC) and other strategic functions. The GCC houses centers of excellence in engineering, content management, sourcing, software development, global IT operations, and shared financial services—providing critical support to Barry-Wehmiller divisions worldwide.
  
  
Our culture is built on:
  
  

* Ownership – Drive features end-to-end, from design to deployment.
* Flexibility – A friendly, results-oriented environment that respects your time.
* Empowerment – Your ideas matter, and your work creates visible impact.
* Learning and Growth – Tackle complex challenges alongside passionate peers, with continuous support for your development.

**Career Development and Global Exposure**
At Barry-Wehmiller, your growth is our priority. You’ll have access to world-class learning programs, leadership development opportunities, and mentorship from industry experts. Our global footprint means you’ll collaborate with teams across continents, gaining exposure to diverse markets, cutting-edge technologies, and best practices from around the world. Whether you aspire to deepen your technical expertise or take on leadership roles, we provide the resources and support to help you thrive.
  
  
If you’re ready to bring your best thinking to a high-impact, future-focused environment—where long-term stability meets start-up agility—and be part of a company that cares deeply about people, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Engineering Leader provides leadership oversight for the GCC Engineering flex pool, ensuring engineering resources are deployed effectively across multiple global divisions while maintaining the agreed scope, operating intent, and stakeholder commitments of the flex team model. Day-to-day technical challenge resolution, deliverable quality, and output management will be owned by front-line leaders within the flex team.
  
  
Reporting to the Director, GCC Engineering, the Flex Team Leader enables GCC scalability, cross-platform collaboration, and shared-services identity by establishing the right governance, cadence, role clarity, and stakeholder engagement mechanisms for the flex team.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Resource Allocation and Delivery
* Oversee flex pool deployment across platforms, ensuring the required Mechanical, Electrical, and Controls Engineering capacity is available and aligned to agreed priorities, while front-line leaders manage day-to-day deliverable execution.
* Establish delivery governance through front-line leaders who are accountable for technical issue resolution, quantity of work completed, quality of outputs, and timely escalation of risks or constraints.
* Bench strength ownership
* Drive a monthly demand-planning cadence with platforms and partner with recruiting to sustain available capacity at all times through proactive team build-out with efficient forecasting and demand planning.
* Partner with engineering leaders to plan the cohort size, composition and deployment to fulfil recruitment needs across the GCC engineering team.
* Stakeholder Engagement
* Partner with platform engineering leaders and internal front-line leaders to anticipate flex resource demand, confirm scope and priorities, and provide weekly and monthly updates on capacity, commitments, delivery health, and stakeholder risks.
* Team Leadership and Capability Building
* Build organizational capability by developing front-line leaders, enabling them to coach flex engineers, manage technical readiness, and ensure consistent execution against platform-specific standards.
* Use a skills matrix to maintain visibility to team capability, coverage gaps, readiness levels, and deployment suitability across the flex team.
* Partner with Director, GCC Engineering and People team on recruitment, onboarding, and training.
* Governance and Reporting
* Own allocation governance, billing visibility, stakeholder commitment tracking, monthly reporting, heart count forecasts, and core flex team utilization metrics.
* Contribute to GCC dashboards (utilization, attrition, skills coverage, project allocation).
* Support continuous improvement and standardization of engineering processes by enabling governance, escalation discipline, and consistent execution practices through front-line leaders.
* GCC Integration and Culture
* Role-model GCC identity while ensuring fairness and transparency in cross-platform assignments.
* Encourage knowledge-sharing and collaboration across flex and dedicated teams.

**Technical and Operational Leader Capability**

* Seeking an experienced engineering leader with a strong understanding of mechanical engineering delivery and cross-platform stakeholder management. The role requires sufficient technical breadth to engage credibly with platform leaders and front-line technical leaders, while relying on designated front-line leaders for detailed technical decisions and deliverable ownership.
* The ideal candidate will bring relevant industry experience, proven people leadership, governance discipline, and the ability to manage delivery commitments through front-line leaders while maintaining clear visibility to execution health.
* Working knowledge of discrete machine design, engineering workflows, CAD-based delivery environments, FEA concepts, and global engineering standards is preferred.
* Certifications such as PMP or Six Sigma Black Belt will be considered an advantage, reflecting structured governance, execution discipline, continuous improvement mindset, and the ability to drive predictable delivery through teams.
* Exposure to industrial machinery design, installation, commissioning, and practical engineering constraints is desirable to support informed stakeholder discussions and appropriate escalation management.
* Experience managing distributed teams, external partners, or shared-service delivery models is important to ensure commitments, timelines, escalation paths, and stakeholder expectations are managed effectively.
* A key expectation from this role is to build confidence with BW group companies by ensuring the flex team model delivers reliably against agreed scope, quality expectations, communication cadences, and stakeholder commitments.
* The candidate should demonstrate a strong learning mindset and proven experience developing front-line leaders who can manage technical depth, execution quality, team productivity, mentorship, and performance management within the flex team.

*At Barry-Wehmiller we recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If your experience is close to what you see listed here, please still consider applying. We know that our differences often can bring about innovation, excellence and meaningful work—therefore, people from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply to our positions. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodations during the interview process.*

**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced Technical Customer Success Manager with 4+ years of experience in SaaS integrations, technical project management, API integrations, and customer-facing technical operations.
  
  
The ideal candidate should possess a strong technical understanding of SaaS platforms, REST APIs, integration workflows, and automation technologies, along with excellent customer communication and project management skills.
  
  
This role will primarily focus on
**post-implementation customer success**
, ensuring seamless transitions from project delivery to ongoing operational support, maintaining integration stability, resolving technical challenges, and driving continuous improvements.
  
  
The candidate will act as the primary technical point of contact for assigned customers after their integration projects go live, collaborating with engineering, implementation, and customer stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* SaaS Integration Management
* Understand and manage integrations between SaaS applications and third-party platforms.
* Troubleshoot API failures, authentication issues, data synchronization errors, and integration disruptions.
* Analyze integration workflows, field mappings, data transformations, and dependencies.
* Coordinate with engineering teams to resolve complex technical issues.
* Support integrations built using REST APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and integration automation platforms.
* Identify integration performance bottlenecks and recommend improvements.
* Ensure integrations continue functioning reliably when SaaS platforms or APIs change.
* Technical Project Management
* Independently manage multiple customer integration accounts and post-go-live activities.
* Plan and coordinate bug fixes, enhancements, integration changes, and technical improvements.
* Track customer requests, issues, priorities, timelines, and deliverables.
* Manage technical dependencies and communicate risks proactively.
* Coordinate with developers, QA engineers, and Technical Leads for issue resolution.
* Provide clear and timely status updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Ensure proper documentation and adherence to internal delivery processes.
* Post-Go-Live Customer Success
* Take ownership of integration projects after successful production deployment.
* Manage the transition from implementation teams to customer success operations.
* Ensure integration stability, reliability, and successful ongoing operations.
* Conduct periodic customer check-ins and technical health reviews.
* Proactively identify integration risks, failures, and customer concerns.
* Maintain strong customer relationships through proactive communication and technical guidance.
* Drive issue resolution and maintain customer satisfaction.
* Incident Management & Technical Support
* Take ownership of customer-reported integration incidents.
* Perform initial technical investigation and root cause analysis.
* Coordinate incident resolution with the appropriate technical teams.
* Manage issue severity, priority, escalation, and communication.
* Ensure critical customer issues receive appropriate attention.
* Document incident findings, resolutions, and preventive actions.
* Work toward reducing recurring production issues.
* Integration Monitoring & Continuous Improvement
* Monitor integration health, API failures, scheduled jobs, and data synchronization processes.
* Identify recurring issues and opportunities for automation.
* Recommend improvements to integration architecture and operational workflows.
* Coordinate preventive maintenance and integration upgrades.
* Improve monitoring, alerting, troubleshooting, and support processes.
