title: Senior Technical Lead BIM - Structural - "High-rise & Complex Buildings" - Chennai
description:
**Company Description**
**About Ramboll**
Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a foundation-owned people company. We have more than 18,000 experts working across our global operations in 35 countries. Our experts are leaders in their fields, developing and delivering innovative solutions in diverse markets including Buildings, Transport, Planning & Urban Design, Water, Environment & Health, Energy, and Management Consulting. We invite you to contribute to a more sustainable future working in an open, collaborative, and empowering company. Combining local experience with global knowledge, we together shape the societies of tomorrow.
  
  
**Ramboll in India**
Ramboll India is part of Ramboll Group owned by the Ramboll Foundation, with strong corporate values and long-term thinking. In India we have major offices in Gurugram, Noida, Hyderabad, Chennai and Mumbai. Here, you can apply your professional passion for high quality and delivering innovative solutions within Buildings, Transport, Water, Environment & Health, Energy and Management Consulting. We invite you to contribute to a sustainable future, working in an open, collaborative, and empowering culture.
  
  
We invite you to bring your passion, curiosity, positive energy, and technical expertise to develop sustainable solutions for industry projects worldwide. To succeed in this role, you must possess a strong technical background in industry engineering (Process, Chemical, Petrochemical, etc.), extensive experience as a Piping and Layout specialist, and the ability to lead project teams across Ramboll’s offices and geographies within the Plant Design discipline.
  
  
**You will join our High-Rise Buildings**
**Department**
As our new
**Senior Technical Lead BIM - High Rise Structure**
, you will be part of our global High-Rise department, Ramboll’s dedicated team of Highrise experts which have designed over 150 tall building projects globally, including some of the most technically challenging. You would be responsible to coordinate with project managers and/or engineers for Analysis and Design work in the Highrise department in Chennai to support the global department which also has offices in Copenhagen, UK, Middle East, and Singapore.
  
  
**The BIM Lead owns day-to-day resourcing and quality performance of the BIM function, which sits entirely within REC. The role gives the BIM function a single point of accountability for resource allocation, output quality and staff development.**
**Job Description**
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Allocate BIM staff across active projects in line with project delivery plans and the Department's resourcing methodology.
* Identify resourcing gaps or conflicts early and raise them to the Head of Department and the relevant Project Lead before they affect delivery, in line with the Project Delivery and Governance Guideline.
* Own overall BIM output quality and drawing presentation standards across REC.
* Set and monitor productivity and quality standards for the BIM team, distinct from the project-level quality checks performed by the BIM Quality Lead and Senior BIM Coordinator(s).
* Escalate any resourcing decision beyond the Department's established methodology, and any matter that cannot be resolved through coordination with the Quality function or the relevant Project Lead, to the Head of Department.
* Maintain visibility of BIM team capacity and utilisation across REC.

**Secondary Responsibilities**

* Design and deliver a structured training scheme for the BIM team, covering software proficiency, modelling standards and productivity.
* Assign team members to the training scheme and track completion and resulting quality/productivity improvement.
* Identify individual skill gaps and provide or arrange targeted training as needed.
* Coordinate with Project Leads and Project BIM Leads on project-specific BIM resourcing and delivery needs.
* Report resourcing status, training progress and quality trends to the Head of Department on a regular basis.

**Ideal Character Type**

* Hands-on and detail-focused: comfortable reviewing models and drawings directly, not managing purely at a distance.
* Owns resourcing and quality outcomes; escalates early rather than explaining late.
* Calm and structured under multiple concurrent project deadlines.
* Coaching mindset: builds capability in the team through training rather than working around gaps.

**Qualifications**
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Degree or diploma in a relevant BIM, architectural technology or engineering discipline.
* Minimum 25 years of relevant BIM experience, including substantial experience in a managerial or lead capacity with direct responsibility for team and resource management, ideally within a multi-disciplinary structural or MEP design environment.
* Proven track record with top-tier engineering consultancies in the region.
* Relevant professional accreditations required.
* Demonstrated experience designing or delivering structured training programmes for technical teams.
* Strong working knowledge of BIM standards, modelling software (e.g. Revit) and quality/productivity benchmarking.

**Why This Role May Interest You**

* Genuine ownership of the BIM function's resourcing, quality standards and training programme.
* A newly defined role with a direct hand in shaping how BIM is structured across REC.
* Group backing for the tools and training the function needs.

**Additional Information**
**Working at Ramboll**
To work at Ramboll means being part of a people organisation. We are focused on knowledge sharing and collaboration across competence areas and geography, and we aim for a strong diversity among our employees. This enables us to solve a broad range of projects, and we firmly believe that cross-collaboration leads to creative and longstanding solutions. Thus, the possibilities at Ramboll are many and diverse –we invest a lot in the development of people and offer career paths tailored for each individual.
  
  
**How To Apply**
If you are interested in applying, please send your application through our online recruitment system by clicking the link ‘apply’ below. Attach your CV, cover letter and relevant documents showcasing why you are the right fit for the role, and when you are available to start. We look forward to receiving your application.

title: Senior SAP S/4 HANA Tax Consultant
description:
Ford is building a dedicated MMP Tax team to provide ongoing support for the MMP program and related transformation initiatives. * 10+ years of experience in SAP S/4HANA or ECC (SAP ERP Central Component) tax design, implementation, or support, with a focus on Materials Management (MM) and Finance/Controlling (FI/CO) configuration and customization.
* Demonstrated tax-domain experience within SAP environments (required).
* 1-2+ years of product management experience within SAP S/4 Tax, with a proven delivery track record. (To be confirmed — see note to hiring manager below.)
* Experience with SAP–Vertex tax engine integration strongly preferred.
* Proven experience on integration projects, partnering effectively with cross-functional interface teams.
* Strong understanding of tax-related business processes, including exposure to corporate tax/compliance functions.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills in a global, cross-functional environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes of business issues and align solutions to business drivers.
* Collaborative, solution-oriented approach with experience building and leading cross-functional teams.

**Major Responsibilities**

* Supervises an Environmental, Safety, and Health (ESH) program inclusive of technical and administrative aspects; compliance activities; and processes and plans associated with all three ESH disciplines (including medical).

* Establishes ESH emergency preparedness planning and confirms investigation and resolution of ESH incidents.

**Education And Experience Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree (or international equivalent) related to environmental, safety, health or science-related discipline and 8 -10 years of relevant experience or 12-14 years of relevant work experience

**Required Knowledge And Skills**

* Advanced knowledge in a field of science, safety/industrial engineering, or related discipline.
* Knowledge of national safety laws/regulations and regulatory agencies’ regulatory requirements and responsibilities, industry standards/current practices for ESH, and best management practices for minimizing potential ESH risks during project execution.
* Knowledge of engineering and construction systems, methods, and work processes.
* Experience in managing and/or providing technical oversight of ESH subcontractors or consultants.
* Experience in ESH assessments/inspection during construction.
* Knowledge of hazardous materials and physical risks and the mechanisms to mitigate them.

* Coordinates with and provides technical assistance to other project-assigned functional leads (e.g., engineering, subcontracts, procurement, project controls) with regards to compliance with project-specific ESH requirements.

* Provides technical support and assistance directly to construction supervision and subcontractors in planning and executing field activities in accordance with the project safety requirements.
* Conducts ESH assessments/inspections of project construction activities to monitor compliance with ESH requirements including contractual commitments, laws and regulations, and the project’s ESH plan.
* Reporting of observed opportunities for improvement through construction supervision (i.e., Foreman/General Foreman/Superintendents) and validating that appropriate action is taken to mitigate the identified opportunities for improvement, e.g., mitigating the observed dropped object potential.
* Lead and participate as required in incident investigations, preparing Initial Incident Notifications, conducting investigations, and completing Incident Investigation Reports, meeting quality and timeframe expectations.
* This position has a work scope that includes field inspections and the physical ability to conduct field inspections which require the following activities: extensive walking in and around a construction site, climbing ladders, climbing scaffolding, working on elevated platforms, working on uneven surfaces and working in small or confined spaces. Some lifting may be required.

title: Principal Data Center Facilities Development Manager
description:
**Job Description**
Leads the construction of data centers by colocation providers, ensuring projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. Creates, reviews, and maintains documentation, including design review, commissioning, and problem-solving papers. Implements and oversees quality control processes to ensure all construction activities meet design specifications and industry standards. Conducts detailed site walks and leads the startup and commissioning phases of major data center projects. Identifies gaps in risk identification and mitigation and develops tailored solutions to address these gaps. Serves as the primary point of contact between the company and colocation providers. Selects, negotiates, and manages contracts with external vendors, contractors, and suppliers, ensuring contract compliance and performance and construction activities align with the approved design plans and specifications. Oversees the installation of power, cooling, networking, and structured cabling systems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Construction Project Management-Project Planning and Execution:**

* Leads the construction of data centers by colocation providers, ensuring projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.
* Develops and maintains detailed project schedules, coordinating with colocation providers to ensure timely milestone delivery across multiple projects.
* Creates and manages project budgets, optimizing resource allocation to ensure cost-effective project execution.
* Creates, reviews, and maintains documentation, including design review, commissioning, and problem-solving papers, ensuring standards are upheld, documents are managed effectively, and materials are suitable for their intended purpose.

**Construction Project Management-Project Integration and Quality Assurance:**

* Implements and oversees quality control processes to ensure all construction activities meet design specifications and industry standards.
* Collaborates actively in the coordination and integration of tenant fit out projects, ensuring alignment between different phases of design, construction, and commissioning.
* Conducts detailed site walks to monitor schedule, coordination, and quality throughout the life of the project.
* Leads the startup and commissioning phases of major data center projects, ensuring that all systems are operational and meet design specifications.

**Risk and Problem Management:**

* Evaluates the risk profiles associated with timely project delivery for multiple projects.
* Identifies gaps in risk identification and mitigation and develops tailored solutions to address these gaps.
* Develops and implements mitigation strategies for major construction project risks to ensure project success.

**Stakeholder and Vendor Management:**

* Serves as the primary point of contact between the company and colocation providers, facilitating clear and effective communication, and resolving routine issues independently.
* Develops and maintains key relationships to effectively support internal and external stakeholders, identifying opportunities for process improvements.
* Selects, negotiates, and manages contracts with external vendors, contractors, and suppliers, ensuring contract compliance and performance.

**Design Coordination and Improvement:**

* Collaborates with design teams to ensure that construction activities align with the approved design plans and specifications, addressing routine design issues independently.
* Provides comprehensive colocation provider evaluation input for continuous improvement and identifies opportunities for process enhancements.
* Oversees the installation of power, cooling, networking, and structured cabling systems, ensuring adherence to quality standards.

**Core Responsibilities**
**Planning & Execution:**

* Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.

**Collaboration & Partnership:**

* Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.

**Problem Solving:**

* Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.

**Continuous Learning:**

* Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.

**Performance and Development:**

* Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. title: Project Engineer Electrical and Instrumentation
description:
**Job Description**
**Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?**
**Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.**
You assist in planning, developing and execution of capital projects, technical development, feasibility perspectives of engineering-related activities in the supply chain and capital-expense project execution to support growth, world-class manufacturing and productivity with the highest level of quality, safety and environmental requirements. You help ensure sure that Mondelēz business and innovation processes in project management and Mondelēz standards in execution are followed.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute**
The role supports capital project execution, and you will be accountable for the quality of the results and execution of capital projects using Mondelēz standards, and business and innovation processes in project management. You will help define and deliver the capital and technical agenda during the development phase of capital investments with stakeholders so that accurate budgets, plans and fit-for-purpose technical solutions are provided and develop the capital budget according to the contract and forecast cash flow. You will also help ensure that applicable engineering developments and standards are properly implemented, and support the development and implementation of state-of-the-art processes and equipment strategies to optimize resources, harmonize assets and rollout best practices.
  
  
**What You Will Bring**
A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:
  
  

* Engineering or operations
* Working effectively and under pressure to meet deadlines
* Analysis
* Project management

**More About This Role**
Lead the electrical and automation engineering project a the site, ensuring reliable, safe, and efficient execution of all electrical systems and automation system for Sricity Engineering Projects on existing lines and capacity expansion.
  
  
**What you need to know about this position:**
**Safety-First Mindset**
Champions electrical safety culture and compliance at all levels.
  
  
**Analytical Problem Solving**
Data-driven root-cause analysis and sustainable corrective actions.
  
  
**Stakeholder Management**
Translates technical topics for diverse audiences; strong influencer.
  
  
**Adaptability**
Comfortable with ambiguity; thrives in a fast-paced manufacturing setting.
  
  
**Results Orientation**
Continuous-improvement bias backed by measurable outcomes.
  
  
**What extra ingredients you will bring:**
**PLC / SCADA**
Strong knowledge of PLC programming (Rockwell / Siemens), SCADA/HMI design, industrial networking (Ethernet/IP, Profinet, Modbus TCPIP), and instrumentation. Shall have sound knowledge of Batch process and Pack-ML Standards.
  
  
**Electrical**
Solid understanding of power distribution, motor control, and electrical protection systems. MCC panels and Drives.
  
  
**Instrumentation**
Good knowledge or Instruments, Selection and Calibration processes including legal meteorology.
  
  
**Digital and Cybersecurity**
Digital mindset, familiar with Digital applications for factory operations.
  
  
OT infrastructure – Networks, Network management, Server, Virtual Environment, Cybersecurity tools and Secure Remote access tools.
  
  
**Process and Equipment Safety.**
Hands on knowledge of Process Safety and Equipment safety Standards (SIL and PL). To design and validate the safety of the equipment and processes.
  
  
**Leadership**
Proven ability to lead and develop technical teams in a fast-paced operational setting.
  
  
**Project Mgmt**
Experience managing capital projects (>$500K electrical/automation scope).
  
  
**Communication**
Ability to translate complex technical topics for non-technical stakeholders; strong written and verbal English.
  
  
**Education / Certifications:**
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation/Control Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline.
  
  
Experience: 5–6 years of progressive experience in electrical and automation engineering within a manufacturing environment (FMCG/food & beverage preferred)
  
  
**Job specific requirements:**
**Electrical Systems**

* Own the design, BOQ preparation, installation, commissioning, all electrical systems across for new capacity expansion & Plant projects.
* Ensure compliance with local electrical codes, MDLZ engineering standards, and relevant safety regulations (e.g., NFPA 70E, IEC, local statutory requirements).

**Automation for plant projects**

* Design and implementation of automation and control systems, including PLCs (Allen-Bradley, Siemens, etc.), SCADA/HMI, VFDs, servo drives, instrumentation, and industrial networks for new capacity expansion.
* Support in plant digital manufacturing roadmaps.

**Project Delivery**

* Lead electrical and automation scope for capital projects — from concept and design through FAT/SAT, installation, commissioning, and handover.
* Manage external contractors, system integrators, and OEMs to deliver projects on time, on budget, and to specification.
* Prepare and manage project budgets, schedules, and risk registers for the E&A scope.

**People Leadership**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of electrical and automation technicians/engineers.
* Build technical capability through structured training, mentoring, and skills-gap assessments.
* Foster a culture of safety, ownership, and continuous improvement within the team.
* Coordinate with Site Automation team, SSAL and Electrical maintenance team for Project shut and integration planning.

**Safety & Compliance**

* Champion electrical safety practices, including lockout/tagout (LOTO), arc-flash risk assessments, and safe work permits.
* Ensure all electrical and automation work complies with MDLZ Global Engineering Standards, local regulations, and insurance requirements.
* Maintain up-to-date electrical single-line diagrams, panel schedules, and automation documentation.

**Travel requirements:**
**Work schedule:**
Within Country Relocation support available and for candidates voluntarily moving internationally some minimal support is offered through our Volunteer International Transfer Policy
  
  
**Business Unit Summary**
Mondelez India Foods Private Limited (formerly Cadbury India Ltd.) has been in India for over 70 years, making sure our mouth-watering and well-loved local and global brands such as
*Cadbury*
chocolates,
*Bournvita*
and
*Tang*
powdered beverages,
*Oreo*
and
*Cadbury Bournvita*
biscuits, and
*Halls*
and
*Cadbury Choclairs Gold*
candies get safely into our customers hands—and mouths
*.*
Headquartered in Mumbai, the company has more than 3,300 employees proudly working across sales offices in New Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata and Chennai and in manufacturing facilities at Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh and Andhra Pradesh, at our global Research & Development Technical Centre and Global Business Hub in Maharashtra and in a vast distribution network across the country. We are also proud to be recognised by Avatar as the Best Companies for Women in India in 2019 – the fourth time we’ve received this award.
  
  
Mondelēz International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Regular

title: Squad Lead - Oncology
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
**Squad Lead –Oncology**
**Location- Chennai**
The Squad Lead is responsible for setting and executing the Outcome Based Plan. Oncology in India is a critical component of the India portfolio priorities today and in the future and our ambitions for positive patient outcomes are extensive.
  
  
The Squad Lead is the accountable person for delivering on our therapy area ambition(s) in the cluster and this role requires strong Visionary, Architect, Catalyst and Coaching capabilities.
  
  
**Key responsibilities:**
The Squads will focus on system shaping, partnership priorities and driving execution excellence which will in turn define what work needs to be delivered. Squad leads are empowered with, and E2E accountable for, creating and delivering value propositions to our customers, including defining work packages (incl. start & end date, resource & investment requirements), optimal working models (e.g. commissioning of work vs. execution within squad) & for executing/overseeing work in alignment with Disease Area Strategy and close collaboration with Disease Area Squad and Key Account Managers under the supervision of Cluster Heads.
  
  

* Preferred oncology & Hematology therapy area experience as well as a track record of effective people leadership in functional and/or network teams
* Customer experience in pharmaceutical healthcare (ideally in oncology & hematology)
* Providing inspirational leadership in setting the vision and strategic ambition for the cluster and assuming overall accountability for the delivery for this vision/ambition
* Creating an environment where diverse technical disciplines can align, develop and execute in order to pursue the cluster/affiliate/disease area North Star ambition
* Leadership coaching of PJPs, peers and more broadly as required, to ensure individuals and teams are developing and growing in line with their passion and the needs of the Organization
* Acting as a guardian for high standards of compliance, ethics and safety; putting patients at the Center of all actions by consistent business behavior that complies with applicable laws, industry codes and Roche’s Code of Conduct
* Responsible for co-creating and executing strategic partnerships to improve penetration of Roche innovation in corporate accounts and other important regional accounts
* Ensuring PJP’s purpose/vision, goals, strategy, planning and execution (including investment) are aligned to both DA squad AND Cluster Priorities
* Partnering with the broader affiliate (including Disease Area Squad, Key Account Managers, Cluster Enabling functions etc.) to ensure appropriate strategic alignment and required customized modifications
* Fostering collaboration and expertise-sharing across the organization to remove silos and duplication, ensure efficient use of similar skill sets, and to ultimately support common pursuit of the North Star

Who we are
  
  
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
  
  
**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

title: Sr. Specialist - PMO
description:
**Company Overview**
Acentra Health exists to empower better health outcomes through technology, services, and clinical expertise. Our mission is to innovate health solutions that deliver maximum value and impact.
  
  
Lead the Way is our rallying cry at Acentra Health. Think of it as an open invitation to embrace the mission of the company; to actively engage in problem-solving; and to take ownership of your work every day. Acentra Health offers you unparalleled opportunities. In fact, you have all you need to take charge of your career and accelerate better outcomes - making this a great time to join our team of passionate individuals dedicated to being a vital partner for health solutions in the public sector.
  
  
At Acentra Health, we embrace emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence and advanced analytics that can be utilized to improve processes, enhance decision-making, and drive better health outcomes. We value professionals who are curious about new technologies and motivated to use innovative tools to increase efficiency, quality, and impact in their roles.
  
  
**Job Summary And Responsibilities**

* Applies project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid) as they relate to scheduling and planning.
* Develops and maintains project schedules throughout the entirety of the project life cycle with support from project team members; collaborates with the team to gather status updates and incorporate changes.
* Supports senior schedulers and project managers in making adjustments to project schedules as needed.
* Conducts scheduling analysis to ensure schedules are structured to align with project and client goals and objectives.
* Proactively ensures sufficient time is built in for key deliverables and milestones within project schedules.
* Generates schedule reports and supports status or workstream meetings with schedule data, agendas, and notes; establishes, collects, and reports on project metrics.
* Assists in the preparation of periodic status reports to keep leadership informed of project progress.
* Inputs and updates tasks, milestones, dependencies, and timelines in Microsoft Project or similar tools.
* Tracks and maintains schedule-related documents and artifacts in project repositories (e.g., SharePoint) and supports scheduling management systems and reporting processes.
* Ensures that project schedules align to budgetary requirements and provides analysis to assess any impacts on project cost or schedule.
* Develops and performs analysis of the critical path and constraints to determine the effects of changes and recommend workarounds.
* Conducts recovery analysis and recommends corrective actions for slipped schedules.
* Works with project team members to status activities and collaborates with clients to incorporate schedule needs into the master schedule.
* Supports the identification, escalation, and tracking of risks, issues, action items, and change requests per project process.
* Functions as an individual contributor under moderate supervision.

**Job Requirements And Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree required (Business, Healthcare, Information Systems, or related field).
* Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Visio, SharePoint, PowerPoint); direct experience using Microsoft Project or similar tools required.
* Strong attention to detail and time management skills.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Comfortable working in a team-oriented, remote environment.
* Strong understanding of IT project management and can create and manage project plans.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and evaluative skills
* Experience producing schedule dashboards or reports using Excel, Power BI, or comparable reporting tools is preferred.
* Ability to manage multiple schedules and deadlines while maintaining data quality and appropriate documentation.

title: Implementation Consultant Professional II
description:
**Drive Customer Success as an Onboarding & Implementation Specialist – Tekla Structures**
Are you a seasoned structural engineer with deep expertise in Tekla Structures who thrives on solving complex technical challenges and guiding clients toward operational success? Trimble is seeking an Onboarding and Implementation Specialist to join our Professional Services team in India. In this high-impact position, you will own the end-to-end implementation journey for enterprise clients, turning complex steel and concrete detailing requirements into streamlined, best-practice workflows.
  
  
**About Us**
Dedicated to the world’s tomorrow, Trimble is a technology company delivering solutions that enable our customers to work in new ways to measure, build, grow and move goods for a better quality of life. Core technologies in positioning, modeling, connectivity and data analytics connect the digital and physical worlds to improve productivity, quality, safety, transparency and sustainability. From purpose-built products and enterprise lifecycle solutions to industry cloud services, Trimble is transforming critical industries such as construction, geospatial, agriculture and transportation to power an interconnected world of work. For more information about Trimble (NASDAQ: TRMB), visit: www.trimble.com
  
  
**Our Division:**
Trimble's Professional Services team provides the strategic framework, technical onboarding, and implementation rigor that enable engineering and detailing firms to maximize ROI from their software investments across the structural lifecycle.
  
  
**What Makes This Role Great**
Reporting directly to the Manager of Professional Services, Training & Onboarding (India), you will serve as the trusted technical advisor for net-new and existing Tekla Structures accounts across India. You will have full ownership over discovery meetings, workflow customization, and client success roadmaps. Working at the intersection of sales, customer support, and global product development, you will play a central role in conveying real-world customer feedback directly back to core engineering teams to influence future software capabilities.
  
  
Key Exciting Responsibilities
  
  

* End-to-End Onboarding Execution: Lead full-lifecycle software onboarding and implementation programs for new and existing clients utilizing Tekla Structures (Steel and Concrete configurations).
* Workflow Discovery & Problem Solving: Conduct deep-dive technical discovery sessions to analyze client requirements, troubleshoot output customization challenges, and engineer tailored structural detailing workflows.
* Implementation Collateral & Best Practices: Develop high-grade onboarding materials, system configurations, and best-practice guidelines that empower clients to adopt optimal structural detailing standards.
* Project Delivery & Client Tracking: Help clients establish realistic deployment milestones, deliver ongoing technical guidance to protect timelines, and meticulously track project deliverables and engagement logs.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Value Advocacy: Serve as the primary onboarding anchor across Sales, Support, and Product Development teams, while actively presenting the value of Professional Services to prospective clients.

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* Tekla Structures Deep-Dive Expertise: 4–5 years of direct, hands-on experience using Tekla Structures across Steel and Concrete modules.
* Domain & Industry Experience: 6–7 years of hands-on structural detailing and design experience with strong domain mastery in structural steel and reinforced concrete workflows.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Civil, Structural, or Mechanical Engineering.
* Communication & Engagement: Fluent written and spoken English with exceptional interpersonal skills to command credibility across client C-suites and job-site engineering teams.
* Independent Execution: Strong diagnostic capability to troubleshoot software issues independently, manage tight schedules, and drive project success with minimal supervision.

**Bonus Points For**

* Multilingual Capability: Fluency in spoken Hindi to engage effectively across diverse regional client bases in India.
* Global Design Codes: Direct experience executing structural detailing projects according to international engineering codes and standards.
* Customer-Centric Mindset: Highly organized, detail-oriented approach with an eagerness to learn complementary Trimble software products.

**Logistics**

* Location: Chennai.
* Job Type: Full-Time.

Why You'll Love Working With Us
  
  
At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real-World Impact. We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.
  
  

* You'll work on projects that truly matter: Our purpose-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for millions of people worldwide.
* Collaborate with like-minded people: Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem." You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging.
* Be an owner: Trimble thrives on individuals who take initiative and embrace ownership. You'll find an entrepreneurial spirit where success is often "self-authored," empowering proactive "doers."
* Enjoy true flexibility: We offer flexible work arrangements, which are a significant driver for employees joining and staying with us.

**How to Apply:**
Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on one of the Apply buttons located in this posting.
  
  
**Join a Values-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate.**
At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). We believe in empowering local teams to create impactful strategies, ensuring our global vision resonates with every individual. Become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.

title: Process & Requirements Analyst - VP
description:
Join us as a “
**Process & Requirements Analyst-VP**
” and help us deliver a simpler, better and more balanced experience for our colleagues and leaders across the world.
  
  
As the Process & Requirements Analyst, you will play a critical role in transforming the bank through disciplined business analysis, requirements management and process design across complex change initiatives. You will independently facilitate stakeholder discussions, capture and translate complex business needs into clear documentation, map current-state journeys and shape practical future-state designs. You will identify pain points, dependencies and testing scenarios, and translate business requirements into functional requirements for technology delivery teams. Working confidently with global stakeholders and cross-functional teams, you will simplify ambiguity, challenge assumptions and maintain end-to-end traceability from business need through design, configuration, validation and testing. You will also partner with Change and Training leads to ensure launch collateral connects the new solution to the agreed requirements and intended benefits.
  
  
To be successful as a “Process & Requirements Analyst-VP”, you should have experience with:
  
  
**Required Skills**

* Critical Reasoning, Curiosity & Attention to Detail: Must have strong analytical skills, be specific, tenacious, curious and quick to learn, with a focus on crystallizing requirements and problem statements. Should be proactive, ask the right questions, probe for clarity, and move at pace. You can look across requirements, connecting the dots across a broad set of requirements, to support creation of a coherent design solution.
* Business Analysis and Requirements Management: Independently facilitates complex stakeholder discussions, captures and analyses business needs, and translates them into clear, prioritised and traceable business and functional requirements.
* Process Mapping and Improvement: Creates clear current-state and future-state process maps, identifies pain points, dependencies and improvement opportunities, and uses tools such as Blueworks, Visio or comparable process mapping applications.
* Ability to work in dynamic, fast paced, agile environment. You are a really fast learner, understanding different information quickly, assimilating new information and being able to represent that clearly and coherently, in a manner that others, not involved, can understand.
* You are solutions oriented, credible with colleagues, People Leaders and senior leaders able to work across centres of excellence, colleague support, HR tech and the journey experience team, creating one coherent, aligned set of requirements and designs.
* Technology Change and Governance: Uses Jira to manage requirements, traceability, governance and version control across design, build and testing activities, and works effectively with technology delivery teams.
* Testing and User Acceptance: Defines realistic positive and negative test scenarios from requirements and process analysis, understands key dependencies and supports thorough user acceptance testing.
* Strategic Requirements Leadership: Translates strategic objectives into clear business outcomes, capability needs and prioritised requirements, ensuring alignment across multiple initiatives and stakeholder groups.
* Senior Stakeholder Management and Influencing: Builds trusted relationships with senior leaders, constructively challenges assumptions, facilitates evidence-based decisions and secures alignment where priorities or perspectives differ.
* Portfolio Prioritisation and Dependency Management: Assesses value, urgency, risk and delivery complexity to support prioritisation, while identifying and managing cross-functional dependencies, constraints and impacts.
* Risk, Controls and Design Governance: Embeds risk and control considerations into requirements and solution design, establishes clear decision records and traceability, and ensures appropriate governance throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Benefits and Outcome Focus: Defines measurable outcomes and acceptance criteria, links requirements to intended benefits and uses evidence to confirm that delivered solutions address the original business need.

**Additional Skills**

* Business English and Multinational Experience: Highly experienced in writing detailed specifications in business English and working with global stakeholders; experience supporting United Kingdom-based teams is highly desirable. Experience in Human Resources, Workday or process transformation environments is also desirable.

**Leadership Capabilities**

* Lead Through Ambiguity: Provides structure and direction in complex or uncertain situations, makes sound decisions with incomplete information and maintains momentum while key issues are resolved.
* Cross-functional Leadership: Leads virtual and cross-functional teams through discovery, design and validation activities, clarifying accountabilities and creating an environment in which challenge and collaboration are encouraged.
* Decision Facilitation and Conflict Resolution: Surfaces trade-offs, resolves competing priorities and facilitates timely decisions, escalating material risks or unresolved issues with clear options and recommendations.
* Coaching and Capability Building: Coaches analysts and delivery colleagues, sets quality standards, provides constructive feedback and shares practical methods that strengthen requirements and process analysis capability.
* Executive Communication: Communicates complex information in a concise and compelling way, tailoring messages for senior audiences and presenting clear insights, impacts, recommendations and decisions required.
* Accountability for Delivery Quality: Sets expectations for quality, pace and governance, monitors progress and intervenes early to address gaps, ensuring requirements remain coherent, testable and aligned to agreed outcomes.

**Basic/ Essential Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree

You may be assessed on critical reasoning, business analysis, requirements management, process mapping, stakeholder engagement, change and transformation, risk and controls, business acumen, strategic thinking, and digital and technology skills. Assessment may include a process-flow exercise or case-study discussion focused on gathering requirements, structuring delivery activities, managing stakeholders and supporting project execution.
  
  
This role will primarily be based in Chennai, India, with Pune accepted as a secondary location.
  
  
Core hours for this role are 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM IST, with flexibility required for key afternoon meetings. There is a policy to attend the office 3 days in a week on Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday of every week.
  
  
  

* Purpose of the role

To support the organisation, achieve its strategic objectives by the identification of business requirements and solutions that address business problems and opportunities.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Identification and analysis of business problems and client requirements that require change within the organisation.
* Development of business requirements that will address business problems and opportunities.
* Collaboration with stakeholders to ensure that proposed solutions meet their needs and expectations.
* Support the creation of business cases that justify investment in proposed solutions.
* Conduct feasibility studies to determine the viability of proposed solutions.
* Support the creation of reports on project progress to ensure proposed solutions are delivered on time and within budget.
* Creation of operational design and process design to ensure that proposed solutions are delivered within the agreed scope.
* Support to change management activities, including development of a traceability matrix to ensure proposed solutions are successfully implemented and embedded in the organisation.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.

title: AVP - Country Regulatory Reporting
description:
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy**

**Business**

* Understanding and articulating country specific regulatory requirements, FRR metrics computation and methodologies, and regulatory parameters and key drivers.

* Continuously striving for process optimization to enhance production efficiency and reduce errors.

**Company Description**

EVtron Tech is a startup focused on designing, manufacturing, and deploying electric vehicle (EV) charging solutions for logistics fleets, factories, and commercial facilities.

Our mission is to accelerate India’s transition to sustainable mobility through reliable EV charging hardware, smart charging software, and turnkey deployment solutions.

We manufacture our own EV chargers and develop an in-house Charging Management System (CMS) that enables operators to monitor and manage charging infrastructure through web and mobile platforms.

**Role Description**

We are looking for an
**Installation Supervisor**
to join our growing team and support the installation and commissioning of EV charging infrastructure across customer locations.

This role is ideal for diploma candidates who enjoy field work, coordinating installation activities, and ensuring projects are executed safely and efficiently. The primary responsibility is to supervise installation teams and electricians while ensuring installations are completed as per company standards and project timelines.

The role offers exposure to EV charging infrastructure, electrical installations, customer interactions, commissioning activities, vendor coordination, and end-to-end project execution in a fast-paced startup environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Supervise the installation of EV charging stations at customer sites.
* Coordinate and guide electricians, contractors, and installation teams during project execution.
* Ensure electrical wiring, cable routing, earthing, mounting, and associated installation activities are carried out as per company standards.
* Conduct site inspections and verify site readiness before installation activities begin.
* Support electrical connections, basic troubleshooting, and minor installation work whenever required.
* Assist in charger testing, commissioning, and successful handover to customers.
* Coordinate with customers, vendors, and internal teams to ensure timely completion of installation projects.
* Maintain installation checklists, site reports, commissioning records, and project documentation.
* Ensure compliance with electrical safety practices, company procedures, and applicable standards.
* Monitor installation quality and report technical or site-related issues to the engineering team.
* Support preventive maintenance, service visits, and installation audits whenever required.
* Travel to customer locations for installation, commissioning, and project support activities.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Diploma in Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEE), Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or a related discipline.
* ITI (Electrician) candidates with relevant experience are also encouraged to apply.
* 0–2 years of experience in electrical installation, site supervision, industrial maintenance, or related field activities.
* Basic understanding of electrical wiring, single-phase and three-phase systems, MCBs, DBs, earthing, conduits, and electrical safety practices.
* Good communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
* Comfortable working at customer sites and traveling for installation projects.
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced startup environment.

**It's a Plus If You Have**

* Experience in EV charger installation, solar installations, industrial electrical systems, or automation projects.
* Experience supervising electricians or installation contractors.
* Familiarity with electrical testing tools such as multimeters, clamp meters, or insulation testers.
* Basic troubleshooting experience with electrical equipment.
* Valid two-wheeler driving license.
* Startup experience or the ability to handle multiple responsibilities independently.
* Interest in electric mobility and sustainable infrastructure.

**Why Join EVtron?**

* Be part of India's growing EV charging infrastructure ecosystem.
* Gain exposure to installation, commissioning, customer interactions, and project execution.
* Opportunity to take ownership and grow into project execution and operations leadership roles.
* Be part of a fast-growing EV startup focused on sustainable mobility.

**How to Apply?**

Interested candidates can send their resume to careers@evtron.in with the subject line:

📩
**Application for Installation Supervisor – [Your Name]**

Applicants are encouraged to mention their experience in electrical installations, site supervision, industrial maintenance, EV charging, solar installations, commissioning activities, or any other relevant field experience.

title: Lead Consultant - SAP S/4HANA – IT Product Expert – Asset Maintenance
description:
**Role Title:**
Lead Consultant - SAP S/4HANA – IT Product Expert – Asset Maintenance
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai
  
  
We are one purpose-led global organisation. The enablers and innovators, ensuring that we can fulfil our mission to push the boundaries of science and discover and develop life-changing medicines. We take pride in working close to the cause, opening the locks to save lives, ultimately making a massive difference to the outside world.
  
  
AstraZeneca (AZ) is in a period of strong growth and our employees have a united purpose to make a difference to patients around the world who need both our medicines and the ongoing developments from our science. In this journey AZ must continue to work across borders and with partners and new colleagues in a fast and seamless way. The ambition, size and complexity of the organisation, coupled with the opportunities afforded by new technology, has led the Board to approve a large-scale transformation programme – Axial.
  
  
The Axial Programme will be powered by S/4HANA a new ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) system which will be implemented right across the organisation and will provide our business with standardised processes, enhanced financial management, common data and real time reporting, transforming the way we work through our entire supply chain - from bench to patient.
  
  
The new system will be used by more than 20,000 employees daily, is foundational to all AZ entities and is central to most core business processes. This is a once in a generation programme for AstraZeneca and will shape our ways of working globally for many years to come.
  
  
The Axial programme needs the best talent to work in it. Whether it’s the technical skills, business understanding or change leadership, we want to ensure we have the strongest team deployed throughout. We are aiming to deliver a world class change programme that leaves all employees with a fuller understanding of their role in the end-to-end nature of our global company. This programme will provide AZ with a competitive edge, to the benefit of our employees, customers and patients.
  
  
The Product expert owns end-to-end solution design within the Production to Despatch Door IT Design Team. The role defines, maintains and improves AstraZeneca’s global template in line with fit-to-standard principles and SAP standard.
  
  
As the central design authority, the role aligns business processes, SAP design, master data, integrations, reporting and compliance into a scalable, deployable global Asset Maintenance template.
  
  
Working with Process Leads, site SMEs, Architecture, Data, Integration, Testing, Deployment and SI/SAP partners, the Product Expert ensures integration with Manufacturing, Quality, Finance, Procurement, Inventory/Warehouse Management, EHS and Reporting.
  
  
The role ensures the global solution is documented, governed, validated and tested to programme and AstraZeneca compliance standards. It leads design decisions through governance, handles risks and assesses local requirements without compromising the global template.
  
  
During deployment, the role supports localisation, data migration, cutover, business readiness and hypercare, helping sites adopt the standard design while meeting GxP, validation, data integrity and change control requirements.
  
  
The role also shapes a future-ready global maintenance template by applying expertise in digital and mobile maintenance, connected worker solutions, predictive maintenance, analytics, IoT and AI.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own and lead the SAP S/4HANA Asset Maintenance solution design, ensuring it underpins the global standard process and integrates effectively across the wider ERP landscape
* Act as the IT design authority for Asset Maintenance, translating business capability requirements into fit-to-standard SAP design decisions, configuration principles and deployable solution outcomes and taking these through the relevant governance forums

In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing Central Finance solutions within SAP S/4HANA environments. Technical & Functional Core Competencies
  
  

* Deep functional understanding of SAP FI (Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, General Ledger, Cash Management).
* Technical proficiency in AIF monitoring, error resolution, object mapping, and reconciliation frameworks.

Soft Skills

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills for cross-functional collaboration.
* Proven ability to manage stakeholder expectations in high-visibility enterprise initiatives.

* Exposure to SAP Treasury and Risk Management (TRM) or Advanced Payment Management (APM).
* Experience with multi-national, multi-currency implementations and complex banking formats (e.g., ISO 20022, MT940, BAI2).

* Actively evaluate and introduce new AI-assisted engineering tools and workflows as they emerge, rather than waiting for direction from above. Operate as a proactive, senior engineering leader

* Track record of building or scaling a team from the ground up ideally in a GCC, global captive, or new-site environment, not just growing an existing, well-defined team.

title: AM/Manager - BIM Design Engineer
description:
**Position: AM/Manager - BIM Design Engineer**

**Experience: 6 to 12 years**

We are seeking a skilled Structural 3D design Engineer with 6 to 12 years of experience, preferably with expertise in RAN design and wireless telecom site planning. Good to have knowledge in technology upgradation like 4G and 5G technologies. Strong knowledge in 3D Revit 2026 with structural BIM modelling and AutoCAD (2D/3D drawing & annotations).

**Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering / mechanical engineering / Structural Engineering.

**Software skills: -**

Mandatory: Revit 2026 – Building information modeling (BIM), AutoCAD, Navisworks / Solibri (optional)

**Requirements & Responsibilities: -**

* Study and analyze all inputs from client to prepare & include Structure information, Antenna details, Shelter information, Mount/strengthening structural drawing, Fabrication drawing, Lease area details and Technologies.
* Convert existing CAD-based rooftop site (RTT) & Ground based site (GBT) drawings into BIM models using Autodesk Revit 2026.
* Follow SOW to develop and maintain Construction drawings, structural drawings, building drawings, and detailed 2D/3D models using AutoCAD & Autodesk Revit in BIM formats. Model all required site components according to the MSD structure.
* Adapt to different operator standards and prepare detailed drawing plans (preliminary, detailed design & As-builts) for telecom structures & buildings into BIM models using Autodesk Revit 2026. Apply the required geometric Level of Geometry (LOG) and information attributes (LOI).
* Prepare plans of site access, Site layout, Antenna layout, Site elevation, Equipment Room/Cabinet Layout/elevation, Ancillaries configuration details and Electrical details as per client standards and design into Autodesk Revit in BIM formats.
* Produce high-quality structural drawing for Tower/Monopole, Shelters/ODU's, Strengthening, Foundation Strengthening, Antenna/Dish/RRU Mount of wireless, telecom cell sites based on the design document, Survey information and Photos in Autodesk Revit in BIM formats.
* Quality audit existing photos, old site survey reports and hand sketch the drawing to match latest photos. Export into IFC format using client approved export settings.
* Perform quality checks (QC) on BIM models for accuracy and completeness. Generate construction documentation and extract quantities for BOQ preparation. Generate and involve in clash detection reviews using Navisworks.
* Collaborate with structural & design engineers and project teams to resolve design clashes and constructability issues.
* Prepare BOM (Bill of Materials) and technical documentation for production.
* Conduct design reviews and implement feedback for continuous improvement.
* Deliver documentation in DWG, PDF formats, Excel & BIM formats and maintain version control with proper documentation of all files.
* Understand 2G/3G/4G & 5G concepts and interpret the RAN equipment’s from reports & photos.
* Ensure models comply with BIM Execution Plans (BEP), project standards, and industry codes. Coordinate with architects, MEP engineers, and contractors to resolve design clashes using clash detection tools.
* Assist in implementing BIM workflows and training team members on BIM standards.

**Knowledge / Skills**

* Good to have fair understanding of Telecom network mainly on Cell sites structures.
* Good knowledge of Autodesk Revit & AutoCAD with 3D drawings of telecom sites (Structural drawings of telecom structure, floor plans, Site layout, Site elevation, etc.).
* Strong Knowledge in Mounting standards, Member connections, Bolts, Brackets etc.
* Good to have knowledge in technological upgradation like 4G and 5G technology.
* Proficiency in both German & English.
* Hands on experience and exposure to Nokia, Huawei and Ericsson wireless platforms.

title: Specialist, Service Management
description:
**Job Description –**
In this role, you will be responsible for the configuration, administration, and support of our ServiceNow platform, with a specific focus on our HR Service Delivery (HRSD) module. This role aligns with industry titles such as ServiceNow Engineer, ServiceNow Configuration Administrator, ServiceNow HRSD Administrator, or HR Systems Administrator (ServiceNow).

  
  

**The Role**

  
  

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented ServiceNow Configuration Administrator to join our team. This role centers on configuring and building out platform functionality — forms, workflows, business rules, and Knowledge Management components — alongside collaboration with various business stakeholders to ensure the platform effectively supports our HR operations.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  
  

**System Configuration & Administration**

  

  
* Configure forms, fields, business rules, UI policies, and workflows within HRSD applications to support evolving business requirements.
  
  
* Facilitate and execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and Production Validation for biannual ServiceNow version updates.
  
  
* Perform testing of newly deployed functionalities to ensure they meet business requirements and are free of defects.
  
  
* Configure and implement solutions to address issues and enhancement requests raised by HR Operations in a timely manner.
  
  
* Coordinate with external teams to implement fixes and new features, such as working with the Service Management Platform team on Automated Test Frameworks (ATF) to reduce manual testing.
  
  
* Configure data alignment for key company lists, such as the VIP list, by comparing data from different systems (e.g., Fusion Master Active Report and SNow User Profile Report).
  
  
* Configure and manage ownership of various ServiceNow assets, including Knowledge Management components such as User Criteria and HR Criteria setup, assignment groups, and key dashboards for HR Operations and Knowledge Management.
  
  
* Configure access control, content visibility, and workflow alignment to meet organizational and reporting needs, including:
  
  
* Configuration and creation of system-related knowledge articles.
  
  
* Structuring historical data records such as HR Taxonomy, List of HR Services, and List of Users with cross-country access, etc.
  

  

**Development & Implementation**

  

  
* Configure and develop new functionalities for HR Operations to improve efficiency and user experience.
  
  
* Facilitate the rollout of newly configured functionalities for HR, ensuring a smooth transition for users.
  
  
* Participate in regular ServiceNow development grooming calls to represent HR and discuss new stories.
  
  
* Assist with UAT and production validation for ongoing configuration projects, such as the Onboarding, Lifecycle Events, and Offboarding projects within HRSD.
  

  

**Reporting & Analytics**

  

  
* Create and distribute monthly reports, including the Monthly Content Hits Report and the Monthly HR Knowledge Base (KB) Feedback Report, to inform the Knowledge Management team of key metrics.
  
  
* Analyze and present data from the QnA Log to identify trends and areas for improvement.
  
  
* Update progress on various metrics for projects.
  

  

**Stakeholder Collaboration & Communication**

  

  
* Attend and represent the team in various meetings, including the HRSD Monthly check-in, Knowledge Management Forum, and myHelp Governance Board.
  
  
* Act as a point of contact for the GPC team regarding requests for ServiceNow checklists and HR case usage.
  
  
* Communicate with stakeholders, including employees, HR agents, and senior leadership, regarding the status of issues and projects. For example, keep the Knowledge Management team updated on the status of Hi-Tickets or problem tickets related to reporting functionalities.
  

  

**About You**

  
  

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

  

  
* Proven 5+ years of experience in ServiceNow configuration and administration, with specific experience in HR Service Delivery (HRSD) highly preferred.
  
  
* Strong hands-on configuration experience across ServiceNow modules — forms, workflows, business rules, and UI policies — along with knowledge of platform best practices.
  
  
* Experience with UAT and quality assurance processes.
  
  
* Proficiency in creating reports and dashboards, and in analyzing data to provide actionable insights.
  
  
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
* Strong business acumen with the ability to lead non-technical business conversations, and to coach stakeholders through requirements gathering.
  
  
* Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues.
  
  
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
* Knowledge and experience in implementing and optimizing AI Summary functionality for Knowledge Articles.
  

  

**Who we are:**

  
  

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.

description:

Location
  
  
India
  
  
**About The Role**
The
**Partner Success Manager**

The successful candidate combines strong partner relationships with rigorous execution and uses data to identify risks, remove barriers, and improve partner performance.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Develop and manage role-based partner enablement, onboarding, certification, product training, and ongoing knowledge programs.

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.

What we are looking for
  
  

* 5+ years of experience in partner management, channel sales or partner operations.
* Experience working with VARs, system integrators, software partners, or indirect go-to-market models.
* Strong understanding of enterprise software sales cycles, pipeline management, forecasting, account planning, and partner economics.
* Ability to translate strategy into actionable plans, measurable milestones, and effective execution across stakeholders.
* Strong relationship management, communication, presentation, facilitation, and executive engagement skills.
* Strong analytical capabilities with proficiency in CRM, reporting, collaboration, and productivity tools.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities across regions and functions with sound judgment and attention to detail.
* Preferred: Experience in supply chain planning, SaaS, enterprise applications, or digital transformation.
* Preferred: Experience managing global/multi-regional partner portfolios, partner enablement, certifications, demand generation, channel programs, or complex co-sell models.

**#Intermediate, #Senior**
**Work With Impact:**
Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.
  
  
**Work with Fortune 500 Brands:**
Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.
  
  
**Social Responsibility at Kinaxis:**
Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long-term net-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.
  
  
People matter at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee:

For more information, visit the Kinaxis website at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com .

We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com. After the initial screening, all subsequent decisions regarding your application, including final selection, are made by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

title: PM- Detailing
description:
**Job Title: Project Manager (PM) – Detailing**

**Department: Engineering / Structural Reinforcement Detailing**

**Location: Chennai**

**Mode of Work: Hybrid**

**Job Purpose:**

The Project Manager (PM) – Rebar Detailing will be responsible for managing structural reinforcement detailing projects in accordance with applicable international standards, client requirements, and project specifications. The role involves leading rebar detailing teams, ensuring the quality and accuracy of reinforcement drawings and bar bending schedules, coordinating with clients, and ensuring timely project completion.

Experience in UK rebar detailing standards is preferred, along with relevant experience in UAE or other international metric-standard projects.

**Key Responsibilities:-**

***Project Management:***

* Manage and supervise rebar detailing projects in accordance with applicable standards and client requirements.
* Ensure timely delivery of reinforcement detailing drawings, bar bending schedules (BBS), and related documentation.
* Monitor project schedules, deliverables, resource allocation, and team productivity.
* Coordinate with internal teams and clients to resolve project clarifications and technical queries.

***Technical Responsibilities:***

* Prepare, review, and oversee reinforcement detailing drawings and bar bending schedules.
* Ensure detailing compliance with applicable standards, including BS 8666, relevant BS EN standards, and project specifications, as applicable.
* Review drawings for accuracy, completeness, constructability, and correct reinforcement arrangement.
* Support the team in resolving complex reinforcement detailing and technical issues.
* Ensure correct interpretation of structural drawings, reinforcement layouts, sections, and schedules.

***Team Management:***

* Lead and guide a team of rebar detailers and checkers.
* Monitor team productivity and ensure adherence to project timelines and quality requirements.
* Conduct technical reviews and provide mentoring to team members.
* Support skill development and training within the rebar detailing team.

***Quality & Compliance:***

* Ensure all deliverables meet company quality standards, applicable detailing standards, and project-specific requirements.
* Implement quality checks and drawing reviews before submission to clients.
* Maintain accuracy and consistency in reinforcement drawings, bar bending schedules, and related documentation.

**Client Coordination:**

* Participate in client meetings to discuss project requirements, technical clarifications, and progress.
* Address client comments and ensure timely incorporation of feedback.
* Maintain effective client communication for smooth project execution.

**Reporting:**

* Provide weekly project status updates covering progress, risks, deliverables, and resource utilization.
* Identify and escalate project issues, technical challenges, and delivery risks to management when necessary.

**Required Qualifications:**

***B.E. in Civil Engineering is mandatory.***

**Experience:**

* 12–15 years of experience in structural reinforcement detailing or rebar detailing.
* Experience in UK rebar detailing standards or relevant international metric-standard projects, such as UAE projects.
* Strong experience in managing detailing teams, project delivery, quality control, and client coordination.

**Technical Skills:**

* Knowledge of UK reinforcement detailing standards, particularly BS 8666, is an advantage.
* Experience with relevant international metric standards and project-specific detailing requirements.
* Strong understanding of reinforcement detailing, bar bending schedules (BBS), reinforced concrete structures, and construction drawings.

**Proficiency in detailing software such as:**

1. AutoCAD
2. Rebar CAD
3. CADSRC
4. Revit

* Working knowledge of Revit is an advantage but is not the primary requirement.
* Ability to interpret structural engineering drawings, reinforcement layouts, sections, and schedules.

**Key Competencies:**

* Strong technical knowledge of reinforcement detailing.
* Project planning, execution, and delivery management.
* Team leadership and mentoring skills.
* Client communication and coordination skills.
* Quality control and technical review capabilities.
* Problem-solving, decision-making, and attention to detail.
