title: Sr. Manager, Manufacturing , Chiller
description:
**Role: Sr.Manager, Manufacturing , Chiller**
**Location: Sricity**
**Full/ Part-time: Full time**
**About Carrier**
Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, life-saving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the centre of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow Carrier on social media at @Carrier.
  
  
**About The Role**
The General Manager – HVAC Chillers will lead end-to-end manufacturing operations for a comprehensive range of HVAC chiller products, including air-cooled chillers, water-cooled chillers, centrifugal chillers, scroll chillers, and data center cooling chillers.
  
  
The role is responsible for production execution, manufacturing planning, quality control, engineering collaboration, laboratory testing, customer witness testing, and material availability. The position requires close coordination with Engineering, Quality, Procurement, Sourcing, Supply Chain, and other cross-functional teams to ensure safe, efficient, and cost-effective manufacturing while meeting customer delivery commitments and product performance requirements.
  
  
**Job Responsibility**

* Manufacturing and Production Operations
* Lead daily manufacturing operations for air-cooled, water-cooled, centrifugal, scroll, and data center chillers.
* Ensure production targets, customer delivery schedules, productivity, and capacity utilization are achieved.
* Establish standardized work processes, manufacturing procedures, and shop-floor operating discipline.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve productivity, reduce manufacturing costs, minimize waste, and optimize resource utilization.
* Ensure compliance with EHS requirements, operational standards, and applicable manufacturing procedures.
* Production Planning and Execution
* Develop and execute production plans aligned with customer demand, sales forecasts, and delivery commitments.
* Coordinate with Planning, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Sourcing teams to ensure timely availability of critical components and materials.
* Monitor production schedules, work-in-progress, capacity constraints, and material shortages to minimize line stoppages.
* Identify production risks and implement recovery plans to protect customer deliveries.
* Optimize production sequencing, manpower deployment, equipment utilization, and manufacturing lead times.
* Quality Control and Process Excellence
* Ensure process quality throughout all stages of chiller manufacturing, assembly, testing, and dispatch.
* Work closely with Quality teams to establish and maintain process controls, inspection standards, and corrective-action systems.
* Drive root-cause analysis and corrective and preventive actions for manufacturing defects, rework, and customer complaints.
* Ensure adherence to engineering specifications, product standards, approved processes, and customer-specific requirements.
* Promote a culture of first-time-right manufacturing and continuous quality improvement.
* Engineering and New Product Development
* Collaborate with Product Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, and Design Engineering teams on new product introductions, engineering changes, and product improvements.
* Support first-of-a-kind (FoAK) builds, prototype builds, pilot production, and transition to serial or mass production.
* Ensure manufacturing readiness through process validation, tooling readiness, work instructions, operator training, and capacity planning.
* Provide manufacturing feedback to Engineering on design-for-manufacturability, assembly processes, serviceability, and cost optimization.
* Support the resolution of technical issues encountered during product development, production, and performance testing.
* Laboratory Testing and Customer Witness Testing
* Ensure readiness and effective utilization of chiller testing laboratories and associated test infrastructure.
* Possess a strong understanding of chiller performance testing, functional testing, test procedures, instrumentation, and test data interpretation.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Quality, and Laboratory teams to ensure products meet specified performance and reliability requirements.
* Plan and manage customer witness testing, factory acceptance testing (FAT), and other customer inspection requirements.
* Ensure test documentation, results, traceability, and customer approvals are completed on schedule.
* Coordinate the resolution of test failures, technical deviations, and customer observations before product release.
* Procurement, Sourcing, and Material Availability
* Work closely with Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, and Supplier Quality teams to ensure uninterrupted availability of production materials.
* Review critical material shortages, supplier delivery performance, long-lead-time components, and supply constraints.
* Participate in supplier recovery planning and escalation to resolve material availability issues affecting production.
* Support supplier development, localization initiatives, alternate-source qualification, and cost-reduction programs.
* Align material procurement plans with the production schedule, product mix, and customer delivery priorities.
* People Leadership and Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Lead and develop production, planning, and manufacturing teams, building a strong culture of accountability and ownership.
* Establish clear performance objectives, operational reviews, and capability-development plans for the team.
* Work collaboratively with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Procurement, Sales, and Customer Service to resolve business challenges.
* Drive structured daily management, performance reviews, escalation processes, and cross-functional problem-solving.
* Develop technical capabilities within the organization through training, standardization, and knowledge sharing.
* Operational Performance and Business Excellence
* Monitor and improve key operational metrics, including safety, quality, delivery, productivity, cost, inventory, and manufacturing lead time.
* Drive lean manufacturing, waste elimination, process standardization, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Develop and manage operational budgets, manufacturing cost targets, and resource requirements.
* Identify capacity expansion and process improvement opportunities to support business growth, particularly in data center cooling applications.
* Provide regular operational performance updates, risk assessments, and improvement plans to senior management.
* Qualifications and Experience
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* A postgraduate qualification in Operations Management or Business Administration is desirable.
* Typically 15+ years of experience in HVAC, industrial refrigeration, chiller manufacturing, or related engineering and manufacturing operations, including significant leadership experience.
* Demonstrated experience managing production operations and planning for complex HVAC equipment or industrial cooling systems.
* Strong technical knowledge of air-cooled chillers, water-cooled chillers, centrifugal chillers, scroll chillers, and data center cooling solutions.
* Practical understanding of chiller assembly processes, performance testing, quality systems, and factory acceptance or customer witness testing.
* Experience in new product introduction, first-unit builds, manufacturing scale-up, and mass-production readiness.
* Proven experience in cross-functional coordination with Engineering, Quality, Procurement, Sourcing, and Supply Chain teams.
* Technical and Leadership Competencies
* Strong knowledge of HVAC chiller systems, manufacturing processes, and product performance requirements.
* Understanding of chiller testing, laboratory operations, performance validation, and customer acceptance requirements.
* Expertise in production planning, capacity management, material planning, and delivery execution.
* Strong problem-solving, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement capabilities.
* Demonstrated leadership in managing large teams and driving cross-functional accountability.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, decision-making, and customer-facing skills.
* Ability to balance customer commitments, product quality, manufacturing efficiency, and cost objectives.
* Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

**Performance Will Be Measured Against The Following Key Indicators**

* Safety: EHS compliance, incident reduction, and adherence to safe operating practices.
* Delivery: On-time production completion and on-time customer delivery performance.
* Quality: First-pass yield, defect rate, rework, warranty issues, and customer complaints.
* Productivity: Production output, labor productivity, capacity utilization, and manufacturing lead time.
* Material Availability: Production line stoppages due to material shortages and supplier delivery performance.
* Testing and Customer Satisfaction: On-time completion of laboratory testing, customer witness tests, and factory acceptance testing.
* New Product Introduction: Timely completion of FoAK builds, production readiness, and mass-production ramp-up.
* Cost and Inventory: Manufacturing cost improvement, scrap reduction, inventory control, and working capital optimization.
* People Development: Team capability, technical competency, employee engagement, and leadership development.
* Expected Outcome

The General Manager – HVAC Chillers will ensure a safe, reliable, quality-driven, and customer-focused manufacturing operation capable of delivering the full chiller portfolio on time. The role will strengthen cross-functional execution, improve material availability and production efficiency, support product development and industrialization, and build the manufacturing capabilities required to support future business growth, particularly in data center cooling and high-performance chiller applications.

We offer a competitive total rewards package that may include other benefits and wellbeing programs. Offerings vary by role and location and are designed to support employees’ health, security, and success.

title: Sr Manager - Reliability & Root Cause Analysis
description:
**Job Description Summary**
We are seeking an experienced Manager - Reliability & Root Cause Analysis to lead a multidisciplinary engineering team within the Fleet Intelligence & Reliability organization. The team is responsible for identifying systemic fleet risks, determining the physical and systemic causes of complex failures, and ensuring that corrective and preventive actions deliver measurable and sustainable reliability improvement across the global Solar and Storage installed fleet.
  
  
This role owns the technical governance of Root Cause Analyses for complex, high-impact, recurring, and fleet-wide issues. The manager will ensure that investigations are evidence-based, technically rigorous, and completed with clear accountability from initial containment through corrective-action validation and fleet-risk closure.
  
  
The leader will manage engineers across relevant disciplines, which may include power electronics, electrical systems, mechanical systems, embedded software, plant controls, and systems engineering. The position requires close partnership with Fleet Performance & Analytics, Product Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Sourcing, Project Engineering, Field Operations, and commercial teams to convert fleet experience into product and operational improvement.
  
  
**Job Description**
Roles and Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary engineering team responsible for fleet reliability, failure investigation, and Root Cause Analysis.
* Own and continuously improve the RCA governance process, including issue prioritization, ownership assignment, technical reviews, milestones, escalation, corrective-action tracking, validation, and closure criteria.
* Lead investigations of complex, high-impact, systemic, and recurring failures affecting solar inverters, battery energy storage systems, plant controls, power conversion equipment, and associated interfaces.
* Ensure investigations are grounded in verified evidence, operating data, event logs, inspection results, failure reproduction, laboratory analysis, engineering calculations, and appropriate structured problem-solving methods.
* Differentiate failure symptoms, direct physical causes, contributing factors, systemic causes, and organizational causes, ensuring that conclusions are supported by evidence.
* Drive immediate containment, short-term mitigation, and permanent corrective and preventive actions with the relevant engineering and operational owners.
* Prioritize investigations using safety exposure, customer impact, availability loss, recurrence, fleet population, warranty exposure, and financial consequence.
* Maintain a fleet-level view of failure modes and systemic risk across products, projects, regions, configurations, software versions, suppliers, and operating environments.
* Partner with Fleet Performance & Analytics to use fleet data, trends, event signatures, and risk models to detect emerging issues, quantify exposure, and verify corrective-action effectiveness.
* Translate field and fleet learning into recommendations for product requirements, design changes, validation plans, software releases, manufacturing processes, supplier controls, maintenance strategies, and technical documentation.
* Provide technical leadership during critical fleet events, customer escalations, and executive-level issue reviews.
* Ensure customer-facing and internal RCA reports are accurate, evidence-based, clear, and delivered in accordance with committed milestones.
* Develop and maintain reusable engineering knowledge, including RCA standards, failure libraries, lessons learned, troubleshooting guides, technical advisories, and investigation templates.
* Support the definition and deployment of Change, Modification, and Upgrade actions resulting from fleet reliability findings.
* Establish and monitor meaningful metrics such as RCA cycle time, milestone adherence, recurrence rate, corrective-action closure, investigation backlog, and quantified fleet-risk reduction.
* Promote a culture of safety, technical rigor, accountability, collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Control Systems Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related technical field.
* Demonstratable experience in engineering, reliability, failure analysis, product engineering, installed-base engineering, or a related technical function.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex technical investigations or RCAs involving multidisciplinary systems.
* Demonstrated experience leading engineers, technical teams, or significant cross-functional engineering programs.
* Experience with power generation, renewable energy, battery energy storage, power conversion, industrial automation, or comparable complex industrial equipment.
* Ability and willingness to travel internationally as required.

Desired Characteristics
  
  

* Advanced degree in engineering, reliability, systems engineering, or a related discipline.
* Previous people-leadership experience within a global engineering or technical organization.
* Strong knowledge of solar inverters, battery energy storage systems, power electronics, plant controls, electrical protection, thermal management, and industrial communication networks.
* Experience applying structured investigation methodologies such as Fault Tree Analysis, 5 Whys, Ishikawa analysis, 8D, Kepner-Tregoe, or Failure Mode and Effects Analysis.
* Knowledge of reliability engineering, failure mechanisms, accelerated testing, design validation, reliability growth, and corrective-action effectiveness assessment.
* Experience analyzing operational data, waveforms, alarms, event logs, failed components, inspection evidence, and intervention history.
* Strong systems thinking, technical judgment, and ability to make risk-based decisions with incomplete or evolving information.
* Proven ability to influence Product Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Sourcing, Operations, and commercial teams in a matrixed environment.
* Strong customer-facing skills and the ability to communicate sensitive technical findings with clarity, credibility, and appropriate transparency.
* Ability to manage multiple high-priority investigations across a global fleet.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Self-starting attitude with the ability to establish structure, set priorities, develop people, and drive issues through sustainable closure.

******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes

title: Vulnerability and Patch Manager
description:
Expleo is a trusted partner for end-to-end, integrated engineering, quality services, and management consulting for digital transformation. We help businesses harness technological change to deliver innovation, improve resilience, and support the secure delivery of complex products, platforms, and systems.
  
  
As part of the Expleo UK Cybersecurity Practice, you will join a managed Cyber Operations service for a major UK energy network operator that forms part of the UK's Critical National Infrastructure (CNI). The service is governed by Expleo in the UK, with a 24/7 UK Security Operations Centre delivered by a specialist partner and an Expleo consultancy team in India providing design, engineering and assurance expertise across the client's security tooling estate.
  
  
As
**Vulnerability and Patch Manager**
, you will lead the vulnerability intelligence, prioritisation and patch advisory service across the client's server, end-user, network and security device estate, coordinating remediation through the client's operational teams and suppliers.
  
  
**This is a design, review and advisory role.**
You will work within Expleo's offshore consultancy team, outside the client's operational environment. You will not have access to the client's operational systems or data and will not make live changes. Operational changes are implemented by UK-based, security-cleared personnel; your work provides the designs, analysis, recommendations and assurance that those changes depend on. You will work from information released to the team through Expleo's controlled UK service boundary.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Responsibilities**

* Lead a continuous vulnerability assessment programme, using outputs from the client's vulnerability management platform released through the UK service boundary.
* Prioritise vulnerabilities using threat-informed criteria (CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, NCSC advisories and vendor PSIRTs) and produce monthly remediation recommendations.
* Issue critical patch advisories, typically within 24 hours, based on client guidance and credible threat intelligence, to enable expedited remediation by UK-based personnel and client suppliers.
* Produce a monthly report on vendor patch and firmware releases across the server, end-user, mobile, network and security estate.
* Produce OS patch and device firmware compliance reports.
* Consolidate patch and upgrade status reporting for firewalls, intrusion prevention, email gateway, secure web gateway and application control platforms.
* Track intrusion prevention signature (digital vaccine) compliance against the 48-hour target, working with the Security Engineer | Network.
* Maintain the vulnerability exception and risk acceptance register and present items for decision through service governance.
* Prepare and co-facilitate the monthly vulnerability and patch review with the UK Head of Service, client teams and third-party suppliers.
* Carry out targeted vulnerability analysis in support of incidents and investigations when directed.
* Apply safe practice for operational technology (OT) assets, where scanning and patching are constrained.
* Support the growth of Expleo's Cybersecurity Practice through knowledge sharing and technical contribution.

**Qualifications**

* Degree in computer science, cybersecurity or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Vulnerability management vendor certification, e.g. Rapid7, Tenable or Qualys (at least one required).
* CompTIA CySA+, PenTest+, GIAC GEVA, or ITIL 4 Foundation would be advantageous.

**Essential Skills**

* Vulnerability management platforms (e.g. Rapid7 InsightVM, Tenable, Qualys) and interpretation of their outputs.
* Patch management processes and tooling (e.g. Intune/MECM, Ivanti, Tanium, BigFix).
* Threat-informed prioritisation using CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV and vendor advisories.
* Coordinating remediation across internal teams and third-party suppliers.
* Strong reporting and data analysis (Excel, Power BI).
* Clear, concise written advisories for technical and non-technical audiences.

**Desired Skills**

* OT vulnerability management and safe scanning practice.
* Energy, utilities or other CNI sector experience.
* Experience supporting NIS or CAF-aligned assurance reporting.

**Experience**

* 8-12 years in IT security or infrastructure, including 4+ years managing vulnerability and patch management programmes.
* Experience running risk exception and acceptance processes through governance.

**What Do I Need Before I Apply**

* Have the right to work in India.
* Be based in, or willing to relocate to, Chennai.
* Be willing to complete Expleo enhanced pre-employment background screening (equivalent in standard to the UK Baseline Personnel Security Standard) and any additional vetting the client requires.
* Be able to work hours that overlap with the UK business day, with occasional out-of-hours advisory support during major incidents.
* Have excellent written and spoken English, suitable for engagement with senior UK stakeholders.
* Be comfortable working within a strict security boundary, with no access to the client's operational systems or data.

**Benefits**

* Collaborative working environment: we stand shoulder to shoulder with our clients and our peers through good times and challenges.
* We empower all passionate, technology-loving professionals to expand their skills and take part in inspiring projects.
* Expleo Academy enables you to acquire and develop the right skills by delivering a suite of accredited training courses.
* Competitive local company benefits [India HR to confirm the benefits package].
* Always working as one team, our people are not afraid to think big and challenge the status quo.

“We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.”
  
  
If you are an experienced vulnerability management professional who can turn vulnerability data into clear, prioritised action, we encourage you to apply today.

description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast-forward your career at Comcast.
  
  
**Job Summary**
Comcast’s Residential Billing Strategy & Operations team is taking the next step in expanding its leadership structure by hiring a Director 1 to lead our full India offshore team. All current India based people managers and professionals supporting Comcast Residential Billing Strategy & Operations will report to this role. This role is accountable for CIEC operational performance, talent management, controls, delivery quality, and execution outcomes, while also being the on-the-ground leader responsible for US based counterparts who own functional strategy and product/process decisions. As the Director of Residential Billing Strategy & Operations, this role will lead teams accountable for the performance, reliability, and operations of Comcast’s end-to-end billing ecosystem. This environment processes tens of billions in annual revenue, supports millions of customers, and underpins financial integrity, digital experiences, and the company’s ability to compete and grow. This leader will be accountable to manage teams ensuring enterprise pricing, promotional, and go-to-market (GTM) strategies are accurately delivered, highly governed, and operationally scaled across every billing platform and customer segment. This role will oversee biller related data flows, operational processes, and configuration quality, that translate enterprise decisions into accurate, trusted customer bills, while advancing automation, data intelligence, and AI-enabled capabilities that improve precision, speed, and adaptability. As the senior people leader in the CIEC this role will also be responsible for talent management and strategy inclusive of succession planning, eNPS scores, employee engagement, and hiring processes. The CIEC director will be a senior leader of the Billing Operations team reporting directly to the SVP of the Residential Billing Strategy & Operations team alongside other US based senior leaders. The candidate will be expected to collaborate on a global scale with leaders in the both the US and CIEC.

People Leadership & CIEC Operations
  
  

* Lead the full CIEC (India offshore) team supporting Residential Billing Strategy & Operations.

Automation, Data Quality & Analytics

* Lead CIEC automation work as an extension of the broader Billing Operations Continuous Improvement team -- identifying, building, and scaling automation, data intelligence, and AI-enabled solutions that simplify work and improve resiliency across the billing lifecycle.

* Support prioritization, risk mitigation, and integrated execution of the billing, configuration, pricing-enablement, data, and operational initiatives assigned to CIEC.
* Oversee local planning, communication, readiness, and change adoption for new capabilities and releases of new technology.
* Communicate department strategies and objectives effectively within CIEC and across the broader organization.

title: Engineer/ Senior Engineer - Indirect Purchase
description:

* Monitor supplier performance and drive corrective actions related to quality, delivery, responsiveness, cost, and service.

* Ensure procurement activities comply with company policies, ethical standards, legal requirements, delegation of authority, and applicable trade/compliance requirements.
* Maintain procurement metrics and reports covering spend, savings, sourcing progress, supplier performance, open orders, and key risks.

**Who You Are:**

* You act with a clear sense of ownership, build and deliver solutions that meet customer expectations, establish and maintain effective customer relationships and credit others for their contributions and accomplishments.

**For This Role, You Will Need:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Business Administration, Commerce, or a related discipline.
* Five or more years of relevant experience in indirect procurement, sourcing, purchasing, or supplier management, preferably in a manufacturing environment.
* Demonstrated capability in RFQ/RFP management, commercial bid analysis, supplier negotiations, and purchase order processes.
* Working knowledge of indirect procurement categories, contract terms, supplier performance management, and total cost concepts.
* Experience with Oracle or a comparable ERP/procurement system and strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

**Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:**

* Experience in manufacturing-site indirect procurement and service contracts.
* Exposure to CAPEX commercial negotiation with cross-functional project teams.
* Knowledge of e-sourcing, supplier onboarding, contract management, and procurement analytics.
* Recognized procurement or supply chain certification is an advantage

As the Data & AI Delivery Leader, you will drive high-impact initiatives that deliver tangible business value through a balanced mix of architectural strategy and hands-on execution. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end delivery of modern data platforms, generative AI, and intelligent automation while collaborating across business and technology teams to shape scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions. * Lead architecture and delivery for strategic enterprise Data and AI initiatives in a role that is intentionally hands-on, with direct impact on scalable, secure, high-quality business outcomes.
* Shape enterprise data foundations, analytics architecture, AI/ML enablement, generative AI, knowledge retrieval, and intelligent automation capabilities.

* Translate business capability needs into architecture blueprints, technical decisions, and implementation direction.

* Guide data architecture across cloud-native platforms including lake, warehouse, semantic, and consumption layers, and ensure governed, reusable data models aligned to business definitions.
* Lead design and delivery of enterprise AI solutions including generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, enterprise AI assistants, knowledge retrieval, intelligent workflow automation, and predictive analytics use cases.
* Establish practical delivery and evaluation patterns for AI solutions from experimentation through production rollout, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure solutions meet enterprise standards for governance, security, privacy, responsible AI, operational readiness, and supportability.
* Act as a key interface across business stakeholders, product leaders, governance leaders, engineering teams, and enterprise technology leadership, while actively building team capability through mentoring, coaching, and practical knowledge transfer.

* Deep understanding of cloud data platforms, preferably GCP / BigQuery or equivalent enterprise cloud ecosystems.
* Strong expertise in data architecture, data modelling, semantic design, analytical solution patterns, and governed data foundations.
* Practical experience designing or leading enterprise AI solutions, including generative AI, knowledge retrieval, AI assistants, or ML-enabled decision-support capabilities.

* Experience guiding cross-functional teams across architecture, engineering, analytics, governance, security, and business stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of data governance, metadata, lineage, quality, security, responsible AI, and enterprise standards.
* Strong communication, leadership, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills, with the ability to operate effectively in ambiguity and lead through change.

Nice to Have

description:
Manager - ST&S Delivery

JOB DESCRIPTION

Manager/Associate Director - ST&S Delivery

Settlements | iData | Contracts & Confirmations | Accounting, Reporting & Controls

Role Purpose

The Manager, ST&S Delivery will own end-to-end service delivery across assigned Oil & Gas Supply, Trading & Shipping operations covering Settlements, iData, Contracts & Confirmations, and Accounting, Reporting & Control, the role will lead operational teams, manage client governance, maintain service performance and controls, resolve material escalations, and execute the agreed transformation roadmap. The Manager will translate the Delivery Head’s strategic direction into operational plans and ensure accurate, timely and controlled delivery across high-value and time-sensitive processes.

Key Responsibilities

•

Own delivery performance across assigned ST&S processes, ensuring achievement of agreed SLAs, KPIs, quality standards, close-calendar commitments and control requirements.

•

Lead operational delivery across settlements, reference and master data, contracts and confirmations, and accounting, reporting and controls.

•

Establish effective workload management, capacity planning, staffing, prioritization and resource-deployment practices across delivery teams.

•

Monitor volumes, work queues, ageing, exceptions, reconciliations, productivity, quality and operational risks; intervene early where performance is at risk.

•

Lead resolution of material settlement breaks, confirmation mismatches, contract exceptions, data defects, reconciliation differences, accounting issues and control failures.

•

Act as the primary operational contact for assigned client stakeholders and lead service reviews covering delivery, risks, controls, improvement actions and transformation progress.

•

Build effective relationships across trading operations, finance, treasury, legal, tax, credit, risk, compliance, technology and data teams.

•

Ensure adherence to maker-checker controls, four-eye reviews, delegated authorities, segregation of duties, approval protocols, records retention and audit-trail requirements.

•

Oversee operational-risk events, control incidents, audit findings, business-continuity requirements and remediation actions.

•

Prepare and present governance packs covering service levels, quality, ageing, productivity, risk, controls, financial performance and improvement outcomes.

•

Convert the transformation roadmap into executable initiatives, milestones, resource plans, readiness criteria and measurable benefits.

•

Lead process diagnostics and standardization; sponsor workflow, digitization, analytics and automation opportunities after stabilizing performance and addressing source-data causes.

•

Ensure SME participation across design, validation, testing, UAT, knowledge transfer, hypercare and post-implementation reviews.

•

Retain appropriate human review and approval for material commercial, legal, regulatory, accounting and payment decisions.

•

Lead Deputy Managers, Team Leads and operational teams; set objectives, coach leaders, build cross-skilling, maintain succession coverage and strengthen accountability.

Manager - ST&S Delivery

Core Domain & Functional Skills

•

Strong understanding of the Oil & Gas, energy or commodity-trading lifecycle across crude, products, gas, LNG and/or power.

•

Settlements: AR/AP invoicing, pricing validation, payment preparation, netting, cash allocation, collections, disputes, intercompany, ancillary/brokerage settlements and reconciliations.

•

iData: counterparty and bank-account records, payment data, standard settlement instructions, settlement and netting reference data, governance and data-quality remediation.

•

Contracts & Confirmations: contract administration, trade-term validation, physical and derivative confirmations, electronic matching, discrepancy management and counterparty engagement.

•

Accounting, Reporting & Controls: journals, derivative and balance-sheet accounting, P&L and working-capital reconciliations, financial close, controls, audit and reporting support.

•

Ability to manage service performance, capacity, productivity, operational risk, governance and benefits realization in a multi-stakeholder environment.

•

Working exposure to ETRM/CTRM platforms, ERP or finance systems, reconciliation tools, workflow/case-management platforms, automation and reporting dashboards.

Experience & Qualifications

•

11-14 years of relevant experience in Oil & Gas, energy or commodity-trading operations, including at least 7 years in service delivery, operations management or people leadership.

•

Demonstrated experience managing multi-process or multi-team operations in an SLA-driven and control-oriented environment.

•

Strong experience in at least two scope areas, with end-to-end awareness across the wider ST&S lifecycle.

•

Proven ability to manage client stakeholders, service reviews, operational escalations and cross-functional dependencies.

•

Experience in transition, process standardization, workflow implementation, automation, digitization or operating-model transformation.

•

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Commerce, Engineering, Technology, Energy Management or a related discipline. Relevant accounting, Lean Six Sigma, Agile, transformation or change certification is desirable.

•

Fluent business English, with flexibility to support business and market timelines.

Leadership & Behavioural Expectations

•

Strong ownership and accountability for delivery outcomes, controls and stakeholder commitments.

•

Ability to balance service, risk, commercial, people and transformation priorities.

•

Sound judgement, structured problem solving and confidence in managing senior stakeholders and difficult escalations.

•

Clear written, verbal and presentation skills, with the ability to work across cultures, commodities, regions and systems.

•

A coaching mindset that develops people, protects critical knowledge and promotes continuous improvement.

Measures of Success SLA and KPI achievement | accurate and timely delivery | fewer aged exceptions and recurring breaks | stronger controls | effective client governance | improved productivity and visibility | sustained transformation benefits | capable and engaged teams

**Job Title: Business Relationship Manager**
**Overview**
The Business Relationship Manager serves as the primary link between the AI team and business units across the organization. The role is responsible for gathering business requirements, prioritizing AI initiatives, supporting technology rollouts, and ensuring successful adoption and business value of AI solutions.
  
  
The role will work closely with business stakeholders, engineering teams, and Learning & Development to drive adoption, track usage and satisfaction, and address adoption risks.

4–6 years

**About Josh Talks**

At
**Josh Talks**
, we believe voice will be the primary interface between humans and machines.

Our mission is to help machines talk like humans by building benchmarks, datasets, and foundational speech models that power global speech AI. We focus on high-quality, diverse, real-world data because the next breakthrough in speech AI will not come from algorithms alone.

Today’s models still feel robotic because they are often slow and inaccurate. Our goal is to enable natural conversations with
**<200 ms latency**
and
**<5% WER**
.

We are building benchmarks, datasets, and foundational speech models using
**State Space Models (SSMs)**
where Transformers fall short. We are a small, fast-moving team obsessed with precision; every decision is measured, documented, and shipped with intent.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**Program Manager**
to lead large-scale speech dataset programs across Indian languages. This role sits at the intersection of
**operations, product, data quality, and execution**
.

title: Project Engineer
description:
**Job Title: Assistant Project Manager / Project Manager – Industrial Cleantech & Thermal Projects**

**Job Overview**

The Assistant Project Manager / Project Manager will oversee the execution, installation, and commissioning of industrial cleantech and thermal projects. The position requires coordination with engineering teams, vendors, contractors, logistics partners, and client plant personnel to ensure projects meet defined schedules, quality standards, safety requirements, and budget expectations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan and manage daily site activities, project schedules, milestones, resource allocation, and execution timelines.
* Coordinate installation, testing, and commissioning of industrial thermal systems, HVAC/R equipment, waste heat recovery systems, and solar thermal solutions.
* Manage vendors, contractors, suppliers, and logistics partners to ensure timely equipment delivery and installation quality.
* Coordinate with mechanical, thermal, piping, and electrical engineering teams to resolve technical and site execution issues.
* Liaise with client plant managers, maintenance teams, and other stakeholders to support smooth project execution.
* Ensure compliance with industrial safety standards, site protocols, quality procedures, and applicable pressure vessel and equipment regulations.
* Coordinate Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), equipment inspections, and commissioning activities, wherever applicable.
* Maintain daily progress reports, project schedules, site measurement records, material tracking reports, and project handover documentation.
* Identify project delays, technical challenges, and execution bottlenecks, and implement corrective actions.
* Monitor project progress to support timely delivery within defined quality and budget requirements.

**Candidate Profile**

* 3–5 years of hands-on experience in industrial project execution, HVAC/R, thermal systems, piping, equipment installation, or commissioning.
* Practical understanding of industrial site operations, project planning, and execution management.
* Experience coordinating with vendors, contractors, engineering teams, and client-side personnel.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel, MS Project, and AutoCAD.
* Understanding of industrial safety practices, quality control, and equipment installation procedures.
* Ability to coordinate site activities independently and resolve on-site execution challenges.
* Willingness to travel to industrial client sites across India.
* Strong communication, coordination, problem-solving, and time-management skills.

**Qualification**

B.E. / B.Tech in any of the following engineering disciplines:

* Mechanical Engineering
* Mechatronics Engineering
* Electrical Engineering
* Production Engineering

**Preferred Experience**

* Exposure to waste heat recovery (WHR), industrial heat pumps, solar thermal systems, or other industrial energy-efficiency projects.
* Experience in manufacturing plants, process industries, HVAC/R projects, or mechanical and piping installation.
* Familiarity with equipment testing, commissioning, and project handover processes.

title: Data Architect
description:
**Data Architect – Data Platform Delivery & Client Program Lead**

**Full Time | Chennai |**

**Role Overview:**

We are looking for an experienced Data Architect to own the architecture, delivery, and client relationship for a strategic data program at an enterprise manufacturing organization, built on a modern cloud data stack. You will operate within the client's established enterprise architecture design standards and governance frameworks adapting and delivering to those standards rather than building in a greenfield. In areas where standards do not exist, you will have the opportunity to shape & help establish standards.

This is a role that goes well beyond technical design. Alongside architecting and leading hands-on implementation, you will play an account leadership role, own client delivery and stakeholder relationships, contribute to presales, and act as the primary liaison for the data program. Over time, we see your contribution in organizational presales and contributions to multiple accounts.

You will architect and guide solutions across Snowflake, cloud ETL / integration tooling (Informatica IICS, Talend, Boomi), AWS, and enterprise reporting (Cognos, Power BI) while playing a strategic role leading the team and partnering directly with client stakeholders to shape the roadmap and deliver outcomes.

This role suits someone who is technically deep, delivery lead capable, and client-facing, with solid team-management foundations and a genuine appetite to grow as a leader. We will actively support your development in people and delivery management.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Architecture & Solution Design**

* Own the end-to-end data architecture across the client stack: Snowflake, IICS, Talend, Boomi, Qlik Replicate, AWS, Cognos, and Power BI.
* Design scalable, secure, and cost-effective solutions spanning ingestion, integration, data warehousing, modelling, and reporting.
* Work within the client's enterprise architecture design standards, integration patterns, and governance frameworks - and contribute to strengthening them where appropriate.
* Architect Snowflake solutions directly, or partner with the client's Snowflake leads to shape them, while safeguarding governance: cost management, consumption oversight, warehouse sizing, and access-management best practices.
* Lead technical implementation and stay hands-on where it matters - reviewing designs, unblocking the team, and building critical components.
* Own solution design decisions and their trade-offs, and communicate them clearly to technical and business audiences.

**Delivery & Team Leadership**

* Lead and coordinate a data team of seven across engineering, integration, and BI.
* Plan and run sprints, manage and prioritize the backlog, and keep delivery on track (scrum-master responsibilities).
* Own solution delivery from analysis through build, testing, deployment, and support.
* Manage defects, enhancements, and a prioritized improvement roadmap.
* Mentor team members, set technical direction, and support the team's growth.

**Client & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Own the client relationship and act as the primary liaison for the data program.
* Manage stakeholder communications across internal and external teams.
* Gather requirements directly from business and technical stakeholders; define priorities, KPIs, and acceptance criteria.
* Own client delivery outcomes and contribute to presales relationships.
* Build solution and proposal decks and present them to executive, business, and technical audiences.

**Required Skills and Experience:**

* 5+ years in data engineering, data integration, or business intelligence, with 3+ years in a data architecture capacity.
* Strong Snowflake experience - able to architect solutions independently or collaborate closely with dedicated Snowflake leads to shape them.
* Solid grasp of Snowflake governance concepts: cost management, consumption / credit oversight, warehouse sizing, and access-management best practices (RBAC, data security).
* Comfortable working within, and delivering to, an established enterprise architecture and governance framework.
* Strong hands-on experience with cloud ETL / data integration tooling - one or more of Informatica IICS, Talend, or Boomi - and the ability to design across a mixed toolset.
* Solid experience with AWS data and platform services.
* Experience delivering enterprise reporting and analytics with Cognos and/or Power BI.
* Strong SQL and data modelling skills (dimensional and analytical modelling).
* Demonstrated ability to lead delivery and coordinate a team, with foundational team-management experience and a clear interest in growing as a people / delivery leader.
* Proven ability to own client relationships and gather requirements directly from business stakeholders.
* Experience running agile delivery - sprint planning, backlog management, and prioritization.
* Excellent communication skills, able to explain technical concepts clearly to both business and technical audiences.
* Strong problem-solving, prioritization, and ownership skills.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience owning presales and building solution proposal decks.
* Snowflake advanced features and warehouse / cost optimization.
* Experience across multiple ETL / integration tools in the same landscape (IICS + Talend + Boomi).
* Data governance, security, and role-based access / access-model design.
* Experience delivering into a large, standards-driven enterprise - ideally in manufacturing or a comparable industrial / operational domain.
* Migration, go-live, or platform-modernization experience.
* Familiarity with ITIL-based incident, problem, and change-management processes.
* Certified Scrum Master or equivalent agile / delivery experience.

**Certifications (one or more preferred)**

* SnowPro Core - or SnowPro Advanced: Architect
* AWS Certified - Solutions Architect or Data Engineer / Data Analytics
* Informatica Cloud (IICS) certification
* Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300)
* Professional Scrum Master (PSM) / Certified ScrumMaster (CSM)
* ITIL Foundation

title: Sr. Manager Supplier Engineering
description:
**Company Description**
At Intuitive, we are united behind our mission: we believe that minimally invasive care is life-enhancing care. Through ingenuity and intelligent technology, we expand the potential of physicians to heal without constraints.
  
  
As a pioneer and market leader in robotic-assisted surgery, we strive to foster an inclusive and diverse team, committed to making a difference. For more than 25 years, we have worked with hospitals and care teams around the world to help solve some of healthcare's hardest challenges and advance what is possible.
  
  
Intuitive has been built by the efforts of great people from diverse backgrounds. We believe great ideas can come from anywhere. We strive to foster an inclusive culture built around diversity of thought and mutual respect. We lead with inclusion and empower our team members to do their best work as their most authentic selves.
  
  
Passionate people who want to make a difference drive our culture. Our team members are grounded in integrity, have a strong capacity to learn, the energy to get things done, and bring diverse, real world experiences to help us think in new ways. We actively invest in our team members to support their long-term growth so they can continue to advance our mission and achieve their highest potential.
  
  
Join a team committed to taking big leaps forward for a global community of healthcare professionals and their patients. Together, let's advance the world of minimally invasive care.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Primary Function of the Position:**
The successful candidate will lead a team of Supplier Engineers, to develop a portfolio of suppliers that deliver components, parts, and sub-assemblies at lowest landed cost for Intuitive’s robotic systems. By building technical expertise and business acumen in the Robotics space including its primary commodities of Motion control (electric motors, gearboxes, brakes, sensors, and other actuators), Electronics (PCBAs, PCBs, and electrical harness assemblies), Metals (CNC machining, Castings), and Plastics (injection molding, thermoforming, reaction injection molding), Supplier Engineering leads the technical evaluation during supplier selection, works with suppliers to develop manufacturing processes for components, and qualifies these processes to ensure suppliers can deliver the quality, capability, capacity, and cost necessary to meet Intuitive’s needs.
  
  
You will be responsible for the engineering relationship with many suppliers and the corresponding spend required to establish production, as well as for the discovery and development of new suppliers. You will strive to deliver the best-in-class performance score from your suppliers which is derived from several KPIs of Capacity, On-time Delivery, Cost reduction, Risk Mitigation, Product Quality and Service levels.
  
  
**Essential Job Duties**
Lead a team of supplier engineers who are delivering value to the business through the following activities.
  
  

* Supply-chain Strategy: Develop and execute Global Supply-chain strategy and roadmap for long term, sustainable and resilient supply-chain to support Intuitive’s Product strategy and roadmap.
* Supplier Selection: Conduct market research to identify trends in the field of [plastics, Metal] manufacturing and accordingly select and evaluate suppliers to enable Agility and innovation during New Product Introduction, and to enable production scale globally for products that reach broad commercial launch. Establish a strong partnership with the commodity sourcing team to incorporate commercial viability in supplier selection process.
* Supplier Development and collaboration: Drive and adopt new technologies and automation in supply-chain to achieve high efficiency and production scale. Champion best practices like DFX, Lean, SPC, Six-sigma, Project management, into supply-chain. Establish clear communication channels with suppliers and manage both technical and business relationships
* Supplier Performance and Monitoring: Partner closely with suppliers to select optimal mfg process and process controls to achieve high quality and cost performance. Develop effective KPIs to monitor supplier performance (delivery, capacity, cost, quality). Execute projects towards continuous improvements of KPIs.

title: Lead Specialist, Technology Solutions - Agentic Automations
description:
**About Pearson**

  
  

At Pearson, our purpose is simple:
**Add life to a lifetime of learning.**

  
  

As a global leader in digital learning, we are transforming how people learn through innovative, AI-powered experiences that improve outcomes and create meaningful impact. Pearson is embracing a digital-first future where AI, automation, and intelligent systems enable employees to focus on higher-value work while accelerating business transformation.

  
  

The
**Office of the CTO**
powers this transformation by delivering scalable, secure, resilient, and intelligent enterprise platforms. Within Digital & Technology (D&T), the
**AgentOps Team**
leads the next generation of enterprise automation through Agentic AI, intelligent workflows, and autonomous systems that drive measurable business value.

  
  

**Why Join AgentOps?**

  
  

This is an opportunity to be at the forefront of enterprise AI innovation and help shape how humans and AI agents collaborate at scale.

  
  

You will:

  

  
* Build cutting-edge agentic AI solutions deployed across Pearson's global enterprise
  
  
* Create intelligent workflows that combine automation, reasoning, and human oversight
  
  
* Solve high-impact business challenges using advanced AI technologies
  
  
* Influence enterprise-wide AI engineering and automation standards
  
  
* Help define the future of a symbiotic workforce where humans and AI agents work together seamlessly
  

  

**Role Overview**

  
  

The
**Lead Specialist, Agentic Automations**
is a senior practitioner and solution leader responsible for driving the end-to-end discovery, design, and delivery of enterprise-scale Agentic AI and intelligent automation solutions.

  
  

This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, process transformation, and AI engineering. You will work closely with business leaders, architects, engineers, and product teams to identify automation opportunities, design scalable agent ecosystems, and deliver solutions that generate measurable business outcomes.

  
  

As a critical member of AgentOps, you will translate complex business challenges into intelligent, AI-powered workflows while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, governance, risk, compliance, and ROI objectives.

  
  

You will play a key role in advancing Pearson's vision of an AI-enabled enterprise powered by agentic systems and intelligent automation.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  
  

**Business Analysis & Opportunity Discovery**

  

  
* Lead end-to-end requirements gathering, process discovery, and stakeholder workshops for agentic automation initiatives.
  
  
* Analyze business processes to identify opportunities for intelligent automation, autonomous agents, and AI-driven workflow transformation.
  
  
* Facilitate cross-functional discussions with SMEs, product owners, operational teams, and business leaders.
  
  
* Document and validate business requirements, use cases, process maps, and success criteria.
  
  
* Translate business challenges into scalable AI and automation solutions with clearly defined value realization metrics.
  
  
* Establish measurable ROI, productivity, efficiency, quality, and cost optimization objectives.
  

  

**Solution Design & Agentic Architecture**

  

  
* Design intelligent workflows, multi-agent systems, and semi-autonomous business processes.
  
  
* Define agent behaviors, orchestration patterns, decision frameworks, escalation mechanisms, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  
  
* Create comprehensive solution artifacts including:
  
  
* Process Design Documents (PDDs)
  
  
* Solution Design Documents (SDDs)
  
  
* User Journeys
  
  
* Process Flows
  
  
* System Interaction Diagrams
  
  
* Agent Behavior Models
  
  
* Data & Integration Specifications
  
  
* Partner with architects and engineering teams to establish scalable and reusable design patterns.
  
  
* Ensure solutions align with enterprise platform, integration, security, and governance standards.
  

  

**Agentic AI & Automation Delivery**

  

  
* Lead the functional design and implementation of agentic automation solutions.
  
  
* Collaborate with developers, AI engineers, and automation specialists throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  
  
* Design workflows incorporating:
  
  
* Autonomous and semi-autonomous agents
  
  
* Human review and approval stages
  
  
* Escalation paths
  
  
* Exception handling
  
  
* Feedback loops
  
  
* Continuous learning mechanisms
  
  
* Drive adoption of reusable components, templates, skills, prompts, and accelerators across initiatives.
  
  
* Support enterprise rollout, change management, and operational readiness activities.
  

  

**Stakeholder Management & Leadership**

  

  
* Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, delivery teams, and leadership.
  
  
* Communicate solution vision, business value, risks, and implementation approaches to executive and technical audiences.
  
  
* Manage competing priorities and navigate ambiguity in complex transformation programs.
  
  
* Facilitate decision-making and proactively escalate risks, dependencies, and roadblocks.
  
  
* Mentor team members and promote best practices in agentic automation delivery.
  

  

**Responsible AI, Governance & Risk Management**

  

  
* Ensure all solutions comply with Pearson's Responsible AI framework.
  
  
* Implement controls to mitigate:
  
  
* Hallucination risks
  
  
* Prompt injection attacks
  
  
* Data leakage
  
  
* Model misuse
  
  
* Compliance and privacy risks
  
  
* Apply governance requirements based on solution risk levels including low, medium, and high-stakes use cases.
  
  
* Support auditability, explainability, transparency, and regulatory compliance requirements.
  
  
* Partner with security, legal, privacy, and risk teams to ensure enterprise readiness.
  

  

**Delivery Excellence & Business Impact**

  

  
* Partner with program and project managers to ensure successful execution and delivery.
  
  
* Define and track success metrics including:
  
  
* Productivity improvements
  
  
* Cost reduction and avoidance
  
  
* Time savings
  
  
* Automation utilization
  
  
* Employee experience improvements
  
  
* Customer experience outcomes
  
  
* Ensure solutions integrate with enterprise observability, monitoring, telemetry, and governance platforms.
  
  
* Drive continuous optimization through performance measurement and feedback.
  

  

**Innovation & Capability Building**

  

  
* Contribute to Pearson's AgentOps roadmap and enterprise AI strategy.
  
  
* Create and maintain reusable assets including:
  
  
* Prompt libraries
  
  
* Agent templates
  
  
* Automation accelerators
  
  
* Design standards
  
  
* Playbooks and frameworks
  
  
* Evaluate emerging AI, agentic, and automation technologies.
  
  
* Champion an agentic-first mindset and culture of continuous learning across the organization.
  

  

**Technology Ecosystem**

  
  

**Agentic AI & Large Language Models**

  

  
* Azure OpenAI
  
  
* OpenAI APIs
  
  
* Claude
  
  
* Enterprise AI Platforms
  
  
* Multi-Agent Frameworks
  

  

**Automation & Orchestration**

  

  
* UiPath Studio
  
  
* UiPath Orchestrator
  
  
* UiPath Agent Builder
  
  
* UiPath Document Understanding
  
  
* Microsoft Power Automate
  

  

**Data, Integration & Enterprise Platforms**

  

  
* REST APIs
  
  
* JSON / XML
  
  
* OAuth
  
  
* Salesforce
  
  
* ServiceNow
  
  
* Oracle
  
  
* BigQuery
  
  
* OCR & Intelligent Document Processing
  

  

**Engineering & Development**

  

  
* Python
  
  
* JavaScript
  
  
* SQL
  
  
* Git & Version Control
  
  
* AI-Assisted Development Tools (Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot)
  

  

**Required Qualifications**

  
  

**Education**

  

  
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
  
  
* Master's degree preferred but not required.
  

  

**Experience**

  

  
* 8+ years of experience in technology consulting, digital transformation, automation, AI, or enterprise solution delivery.
  
  
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional automation and AI initiatives.
  
  
* Strong experience conducting discovery workshops and translating business requirements into technology solutions.
  
  
* Proven success delivering measurable business outcomes through automation, AI, or enterprise transformation programs.
  

  

**Technical & Functional Expertise**

  
  

Deep understanding of:

  

  
* Agentic AI and autonomous systems
  
  
* Intelligent process automation
  
  
* Enterprise integration patterns
  
  
* Human-in-the-loop workflow design
  
  
* AI governance and Responsible AI principles
  
  
* Enterprise architecture frameworks
  
  
* Business process analysis and optimization
  
  
* Risk management, compliance, and security requirements
  

  

**Leadership Competencies**

  

  
* Strategic thinking and problem solving
  
  
* Exceptional stakeholder management
  
  
* Strong communication and facilitation skills
  
  
* Executive presence and influence
  
  
* Decision-making under ambiguity
  
  
* Collaboration across global and cross-functional teams
  
  
* Continuous learning and innovation mindset
  

  

**Success Measures**

  
  

Success in this role will be measured by:

  

  
* Enterprise adoption of agentic automation solutions
  
  
* Measurable productivity and efficiency gains
  
  
* ROI realization from automation investments
  
  
* Delivery quality and stakeholder satisfaction
  
  
* Reusability and scalability of solutions
  
  
* Compliance with Responsible AI and governance standards
  
  
* Contribution to Pearson's AI and automation transformation agenda
  

  

**Pearson is committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where innovation thrives and every employee can contribute to shaping the future of learning through AI and technology.**

  
  

**Join us in building the future of work, where humans and intelligent agents collaborate to create extraordinary outcomes.**

  
  

**Who we are:**

  
  

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other group protected by law. We actively seek qualified candidates who are protected veterans and individuals with disabilities as defined under VEVRAA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act.

title: Digital Architect
description:
CXOntology is looking for a
**Digital Architect**
who can lead solution design and delivery across digital experience programs. The role needs someone who understands CMS platforms, commerce platforms, marketing technology, analytics, and consulting-led delivery.

This person will work with clients, internal delivery teams, stakeholders, and executive teams to define the right solution, guide implementation, own technical direction, and ensure the team delivers business outcomes, not just tasks.

**Minimum Expectations:**

* Experience working on 2+ CMS platforms, such as Drupal/Acquia, Contentful, Contentstack, AEM, Optimizely, Sitecore, or similar.
* Experience with at least one commerce platform, such as Shopify, Adobe Commerce/Magento, BigCommerce, commercetools, or similar.
* Understanding of marketing technology stacks, including CRM, marketing automation, CDP/personalization, campaign operations, and customer journey activation.
* Working knowledge of analytics and measurement, including GA4, GTM, attribution, conversion tracking, dashboards, and KPI reporting.
* Ability to lead strategy and consulting conversations with clients, including discovery, current-state assessment, roadmap definition, and recommendation framing.
* Strong solution design capability across CMS, commerce, integrations, front-end, cloud, analytics, and marketing technology.
* Ability to take delivery ownership for technical decisions, risks, dependencies, estimates, implementation quality, and release readiness.
* Experience collaborating with client stakeholders and executive teams, translating technical choices into business impact.

**Core Responsibilities:**

* Lead architecture and solution design for digital experience, commerce, marketing technology, and analytics-led programs.
* Own technical discovery and translate business goals into clear platform and implementation recommendations.
* Define solution blueprints, integration approaches, technical roadmaps, and delivery plans.
* Guide the delivery team across engineers, QA, DevOps, UX, analytics, and marketing operations teams.
* Review technical designs, unblock delivery teams, and ensure implementation quality.
* Identify platform risks, technical debt, dependencies, and ownership gaps early.
* Support managed services, migrations, CRO, platform optimization, and AI-enabled digital workflows.
* Communicate clearly with client stakeholders, senior leadership, and executive sponsors.

**Required Experience:**

* 7+ years in digital platforms, CMS, commerce, MarTech, web engineering, solution consulting.
* 4+ years in an architect, lead engineer, technical consultant, solution design role.
* Hands-on background in CMS, commerce, integrations, front-end, cloud delivery.
* Strong understanding of performance, accessibility, SEO, security, analytics, QA, and release governance.
* Ability to work across business, technology, marketing, and delivery teams.

**Success In This Role:**

Success means the delivery teams has clear technical direction, the client understands the recommended path, risks are visible early, and delivered solutions improve platform health, customer experience, conversion, and business outcomes.

title: DPDP Data Privacy Lead
description:
We are expanding our DPDP delivery team for upcoming implementation engagements and are looking for Two Data Privacy Leads. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will personally carry out discovery, mapping, RoPA and DPIA work, and you will lead the engagement end to end – from scoping through to hardening, consent and incident-readiness deliverables.

**Engagement Snapshot:**

**Role -**
**Data Privacy Lead (DPDP)**

**Engagement type - Contract**

6-month rolling; extension subject to project waves and performance

**Experience**

8–12 years overall, with at least 4 years in data privacy / data protection

**Location**

One position is based in Chennai and the Second position is based in Bengauru. Local candidates preferred.

Mostly On-site with some hybrid

**Reporting to**

Engagement Lead / Project Partner, PTS Consulting LLP

**Start**

November 1st Week; start date to be confirmed with shortlisted candidates

**Key Responsibilities:**

The Data Privacy Lead will be expected to perform the following personally and to a consulting-deliverable standard.

•    
**Process map review.**
Review business process maps and SIPOC documentation, identify where personal data is collected, used, shared, stored and disposed of, and validate findings with process owners.

•    
**Data discovery and classification.**
Independently plan and run data discovery across applications, databases, file shares and collaboration tools; classify personal data elements by category and sensitivity, using discovery tooling and manual techniques.

•    
**Data-to-process mapping and DPDP scope.**
Map discovered data to business processes and activities, and clearly articulate the scope of DPDP coverage for each activity – including applicability, legal basis, exemptions and the roles of data fiduciary and data processor.

•    
**Record of Processing Activities (RoPA).**
Prepare and maintain a complete, defensible RoPA linked to processes, systems, data elements, purposes, retention and third-party sharing.

•    
**DPIA and hardening.**
Conduct Data Protection Impact Assessments, and oversee the resulting privacy hardening and security hardening work – tracking recommendations, owners and closure through to verified completion.

•    
**Consent management.**
Oversee consent management design and rollout – notices, purpose-wise consent, preference and withdrawal handling, and records of consent – working with legal, product and technology teams.

•    
**Incident response and breach notification.**
Manage the personal data breach response lifecycle: triage, containment, assessment, notification to the Data Protection Board and affected Data Principals as required, and post-incident corrective action.

•    
**Engagement leadership.**
Lead the engagement team, own the work plan and quality of deliverables, and manage client stakeholders up to senior leadership.

**What we are looking for:**

**Essential:**

•    8–12 years of overall experience, including 4 or more years of hands-on data privacy or data protection delivery (DPDP Act).

•    Demonstrated, in-depth experience in every one of the responsibilities listed above – not a subset. You should be able to describe what you personally did on each.

•    Experience of independently running data discovery and classification and translating the output into process-level scope and a RoPA.

•    Experience of conducting DPIAs and taking the outcomes through to implemented privacy and security controls.

•    Practical experience of consent management and of handling a personal data breach including regulator and individual notification.

•    Proven record of leading a privacy engagement successfully with client leadership, a delivery team and defined deadlines.

•    Clear, structured written and verbal communication; strong, well-organised documentation.

**Preferred / nice to Have:**

•    Certifications such as CIPP/E, CIPM, DCPP (DSCI), ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor or Implementer, ISO/IEC 27701, CISA or CISSP.

•    Familiarity with data discovery, consent management or privacy management platforms.

•    Exposure to multi-entity corporate groups and to manufacturing, healthcare, financial services, technology or consumer-facing businesses.

•    Working knowledge of information security controls (access control, encryption, logging, retention and disposal).

**A note on Fit**

This is a delivery role. We are looking for practitioners who have done the work themselves. Candidates whose experience is primarily in policy drafting, awareness training or advisory review without hands-on discovery, mapping and assessment work may find the role is not the right fit.

**How to express Interest:**

Please send your CV and a short note (half a page) describing one privacy engagement in which you personally carried out data discovery, RoPA preparation and a DPIA, and what your role was in leading it.

**Apply to:**
[insert application email / LinkedIn application link]

*Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.*

Full-time

**Job Overview**
We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented
**SAP Transportation Management (TM) Consultant**
with a minimum of

* Module Configuration & Implementation: Design, configure, customize, and deploy SAP TM functionalities to optimize end-to-end transportation planning, freight order management, execution, and carrier selection.

* Data Management: Determine and define data requirements directly from process/solution documentation, leveraging high proficiency in MS Excel for data mapping, analysis, and validation.
* System Integration: Configure and manage integrations between SAP TM and other S/4HANA core modules (e.g., OTC, P2P, R2R, Manufacturing) as well as third-party systems.
* Training & User Enablement: Conduct workshops, training sessions, and structured knowledge transfer for business key users, end-users, and project delivery teams.
* Support & Maintenance: Provide ongoing application support, complex troubleshooting, system enhancements, and maintenance for SAP TM landscapes.
* Continuous Improvement: Stay updated with the latest SAP S/4HANA and TM innovations to propose continuous process improvements and feature adoption.

**Required Qualifications & Skills1. Core Functional Expertise**
  
  

* Minimum 3+ years of hands-on experience in SAP Transportation Management (TM) implementation, rollout, and support.
* Good functional understanding of one or more core S/4HANA functional areas:

+ OTC (Order to Cash)
+ P2P (Procure to Pay)
+ R2R (Record to Report)
+ Manufacturing / Digital Supply Chain

* In-depth knowledge of S/4HANA data objects within the candidate's core functional areas.
* Technical & Process Capabilities
* Proven experience in writing comprehensive Functional Specifications (FS) for custom development objects (RICEFW).
* Ability to interpret solution/process documentation to identify and extract data requirements.
* Advanced proficiency in MS Excel for data modeling, mapping, and project reporting.
* Experience in system configuration, freight order management, transportation planning, carrier selection, and freight settlement.
* Soft Skills & Professional Attributes
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking abilities to navigate complex business workflows.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience presenting solutions to business stakeholders.
* Strong team player capable of working effectively in multi-disciplinary project teams.

**Preferred / Good-to-Have Qualifications**

* SAP Certification: Official SAP Certified Application Associate – SAP Transportation Management.
* Exposure to integrated S/4HANA Supply Chain modules (e.g., EWM, SD, MM).
* Prior experience with data migration tools and data loading processes.

title: Solar Liaisoning Officer – Solar Projects, Roofsol Energy, Chennai
description:
**Job Description – Solar Liaisoning Officer – Rooftop & Ground-Mounted Solar Projects**

**Company:**
Roofsol Energy Pvt. Ltd.

**Job Location:**
Tamil Nadu

**Department:**
Liaisoning / Project Coordination

**Experience:**
4–5 Years

**Reporting To:**
National Liaisoning Head

**Language Requirement:**
Fluency in Tamil and English; working knowledge of Hindi will be an advantage.

**About the Company**

Roofsol Energy Pvt. Ltd. operates in the solar energy sector, with business activities across solar EPC and renewable energy projects. The company is focused on delivering solar solutions for commercial, industrial, rooftop, and ground-mounted project requirements.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced and proactive
**Solar Liaisoning Officer**
to manage liaisoning activities, statutory approvals, documentation, and coordination with government departments, electricity distribution companies (DISCOMs), and other relevant authorities across Tamil Nadu. The candidate will support both rooftop and ground-mounted solar projects and ensure timely completion of approvals, inspections, grid connectivity, and commissioning-related formalities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Government & DISCOM Liaisoning**

·      Coordinate with TANGEDCO/TNPDCL and other relevant electricity authorities, as applicable, for solar project approvals and clearances.

·      Liaise with DISCOM officials, electrical inspectors, local authorities, and other statutory bodies for project-related permissions and documentation.

·      Follow up on applications, approvals, inspections, and pending cases to ensure timely resolution.

**2. Rooftop Solar Project Liaisoning**

·      Coordinate net-metering, grid connectivity, feasibility approvals, and other applicable permissions for rooftop solar projects.

·      Follow up on meter installation, testing, inspections, and commissioning-related approvals.

·      Coordinate with internal project teams and customers to resolve documentation gaps and approval delays.

**3. Ground-Mounted Solar Project Liaisoning**

·      Support land-related statutory coordination, electrical approvals, grid connectivity, and evacuation-related permissions, as applicable.

·      Coordinate with relevant authorities for connectivity, substation-related approvals, electrical inspections, and project commissioning.

·      Assist project teams with regulatory documentation and approval tracking.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

·      Graduate in any discipline; a diploma or degree in Electrical Engineering will be an advantage.

·      4–5 years of relevant experience in solar liaisoning, preferably involving both rooftop and ground-mounted solar projects.

·      Practical experience dealing with DISCOMs, electrical inspectors, government departments, and other statutory authorities in Tamil Nadu.

·      Knowledge of net-metering, grid connectivity, electrical inspections, solar project approvals, and commissioning procedures.

·      Strong understanding of documentation, regulatory follow-ups, and approval processes relevant to solar projects.

**Required Skills**

·      Fluency in Tamil is mandatory for effective coordination with local authorities.

·      Good communication and stakeholder-management skills.

·      Strong follow-up, coordination, and problem-solving abilities.

·      Ability to manage multiple project approvals and meet timelines.

·      Proficiency in MS Excel, email communication, and documentation management.

·      Willingness to travel within Tamil Nadu as required.
