title: Senior ELV Engineer
description:
Egis is an international player active in architecture, consulting, construction engineering and mobility services. We create and operate intelligent infrastructures and buildings that respond to the climate emergency and contribute to more balanced, sustainable and resilient territorial development. Operating in 100 countries, Egis puts the expertise of its 19,500 employees at the service of its clients and develops cutting-edge innovations accessible to all projects. Through its wide range of activities, Egis is a key player in the collective organisation of society and the living environment of citizens all over the world.

With 3,500 employees across 8 countries in the Middle East, Egis has delivered over 700 complex development projects, stimulating economic growth and enhancing quality of life. Ranked among the top ten firms in the Middle East by Engineering News Record (ENR), Egis is committed to sustainable development. The Group’s operations in the Middle East are built on strategic acquisitions and a deep understanding of local market conditions. Egis’ long history of providing comprehensive engineering, consulting, and project management services makes it a trusted partner for regional governments, investors, and developers.

**Job Description**

We are seeking a Senior ELV Engineer to join our organization in India. In this role, you will lead the design, implementation, and management of Extra Low Voltage systems for commercial and residential projects. You will be responsible for ensuring all ELV installations meet international standards and local regional regulations while maintaining the highest levels of quality and safety. This position offers the opportunity to work on complex, large-scale projects and mentor junior engineering staff.

* Design and develop comprehensive ELV system solutions including fire alarm systems, CCTV, access control, and building automation systems
* Prepare detailed technical drawings, specifications, and documentation using CAD and BIM software
* Coordinate with MEP teams and other stakeholders to ensure seamless system integration and compliance with project requirements
* Conduct site inspections and supervise ELV installations to verify adherence to design specifications and quality standards
* Analyze project requirements and develop cost-effective solutions while maintaining technical excellence
* Manage project timelines, budgets, and resources to ensure efficient project delivery
* Ensure all work complies with regional building codes, safety regulations, and international standards
* Prepare technical reports, test certificates, and commissioning documentation
* Provide technical support and guidance to junior engineers and installation teams
* Liaise with clients, consultants, and contractors to address technical queries and resolve issues
* Stay current with industry advancements and emerging ELV technologies

**Qualifications**

\*\*Required Qualifications:\*\*

* Minimum 5 years of professional experience in ELV engineering and system design
* Proven expertise in fire alarm systems, CCTV, access control, and building automation
* Strong proficiency with AutoCAD, BIM software, and electrical design tools
* Comprehensive knowledge of UAE building codes, NFPA standards, and international electrical regulations
* Demonstrated project management experience with ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail
* Strong organizational and time management abilities
* Proficiency in preparing technical specifications and engineering documentation
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

\*\*Preferred Qualifications:\*\*

* Experience with advanced building management systems and IoT integration
* Familiarity with project management software and tools
* Knowledge of sustainable building practices and green building standards
* Experience mentoring and leading technical teams
* Professional certifications in electrical engineering or ELV systems
* Previous experience working on large-scale commercial or infrastructure projects in the Middle East region

title: Project Manager
description:
**Position : Project Manager**
**Location - Perungudi, Chennai
  
  
Work mode - Onsite
  
  
Type - Full time**
**Who We Are**
We build AI-powered sports data APIs used around the world and we ship serious software consulting and e-commerce work alongside it. We value the right amount of process - enough structure to keep delivery predictable and clients confident, without the bureaucracy that slows good teams down. Clients across the world trust us to deliver.
  
  
**Why this role exists**
We're at the point where great delivery needs dedicated ownership. We need someone to bring the structure and rhythm that keep multiple projects on track. You'll be the person clients trust and the person our engineers, designers, and product folks rally around. When a project is on track, it's because you made it so. When it's about to go sideways, you're the one who saw it three weeks out.
  
  
This isn't a status-report job. It's a "make-things-happen job" and it takes someone deeply organized to pull it off.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Do**
Own delivery, end to end. Multiple projects at once - consulting builds, e-commerce launches, integrations. Scope, plan, ship, close. You set the rhythm.
  
  
Stay on top of the details. With several projects running in parallel, nothing can fall through the cracks. You track every deliverable, deadline, and dependency, keep documentation clean, and always know the status of everything without having to dig.
  
  
Own the client relationship. Manage expectations, handle the hard conversations, negotiate scope changes without drama. Turn vague asks into clear plans.
  
  
Deliver products, not just projects. Help ship our own payments and MBC-integrated tools alongside client work, product delivery on its own roadmap and release cycle.
  
  
Ship e-commerce that works. Own delivery of Magento and headless platform builds, ERP integrations (MBC, Navision), payments, and omnichannel flows — from scope through UAT and launch.
  
  
Own the process. Decide how each project runs - planning, check-ins, tracking and put the right practices in place to keep delivery on schedule and everyone aligned.
  
  
Watch the numbers. Estimates, margins, utilization. Know where every project stands and flag risk early, not at postmortem.
  
  
Hold the quality bar. You're the last line before it reaches the client. Enforce testing discipline, clean documentation, and delivery standards and don't let "done" mean "probably fine."
  
  
**Requirements**
5 to 12 years running software consulting and/or e-commerce projects - real ownership, not just coordination.
  
  
Comfortable spanning both client project delivery and product work, bonus if you've delivered payments, or ERP-integrated products before.
  
  
Exceptionally organized. You keep multiple moving projects straight, structure information so anyone can find it, and stay on top of details without losing the big picture.
  
  
You've juggled multiple client engagements at once and kept them all honest.
  
  
Client-facing confidence - you can push back, negotiate, and keep everyone aligned.
  
  
Fluent in the tools (Jira, Linear, Asana) and sharp on estimation and budgets.
  
  
Enough technical fluency to hold your own with engineers on architecture and trade-offs.
  
  
Experience with distributed, cross-time-zone teams.
  
  
**Benefits**
Real ownership and a direct line to leadership - no layers to shout through.
  
  
A genuinely varied project mix: consulting, e-commerce, API products.
  
  
A tight India + Iceland team that ships.
  
  
Competitive pay and a clear path into PMO leadership as we grow.

title: Cyber Operate- Vulnerability Management + Anthropic - Manager
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
As a Manager at Deloitte Consulting, you will lead vulnerability management programs and teams across a portfolio of enterprise clients, owning service quality, client relationships, and commercial outcomes. You will drive the strategic vision for AI-augmented VM delivery, championing the adoption of Anthropic Claude-based agentic capabilities across Deloitte's Cyber Operate practice. You will develop and mentor a high-performing team, shape go-to-market offerings and represent Deloitte's thought leadership in vulnerability management.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Manager on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for leading vulnerability management programs across a portfolio of enterprise clients.
  
  

* Own end-to-end vulnerability management program delivery, including service quality, service level agreement adherence, client satisfaction, and remediation outcomes across enterprise environments.
* Lead executive client relationships, provide strategic guidance on vulnerability risk management and program maturity, and translate complex exposure data into board-level reporting and investment priorities.
* Define and execute the strategy for integrating Anthropic Claude and agentic artificial intelligence capabilities into vulnerability management services, including automation, orchestration, and operating model improvements.
* Oversee integration of vulnerability management platforms with security orchestration, security information and event management, and information technology service management systems, and align delivery to client security architecture and regulatory obligations.
* Manage and develop team members, support offering development and sales collaboration, and oversee engagement financial performance including budgeting, forecasting, utilization, and profitability.

**The team**
Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes managing the identity lifecycle, security operations, threat intelligence, application security, business transformation, and ensuring continuous compliance. Services include Cyber-as-a-Service, Managed Application Security, and Managed Extended Detect & Respond (MXDR).
  
  
**Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai**

* 9-15 years of experience in cybersecurity, including 5+ years in vulnerability management and 2+ years in team leadership or program management
* Experience managing enterprise vulnerability management programs across hybrid and multi-cloud environments, including Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform
* Experience designing and governing agentic artificial intelligence systems for security use cases, including multi-agent orchestration and tool-use application programming interfaces
* Experience with vulnerability management platforms such as RiskSense, ServiceNow Vulnerability Response, Armis VIPR or Centrix, Tenable, Qualys VMDR, Rapid7 InsightVM, Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management, Prisma Cloud, and cloud-native scanning tools

* Experience managing executive client relationships and leading geographically distributed, multi-disciplinary teams in a consulting or managed service environment
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Security, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent

* Experience productizing artificial intelligence capabilities into repeatable service offerings or internal tools, including application programming interface architecture, cost optimization, and scalability patterns for Claude-based agents
* Experience with artificial intelligence or machine learning applied to cybersecurity, including vulnerability prediction models or artificial intelligence-assisted threat intelligence correlation
* CISSP, CISM, CRISC, Tenable Certified Security Professional, AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Specialty, or equivalent certification
* Experience with attack surface management platforms and integrating external exposure data into vulnerability management prioritization workflows
* Published thought leadership, conference presentations, or contributions to vulnerability management or artificial intelligence in security communities
* Master of Business Administration or postgraduate degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or a related discipline

* Set clear expectations, goals, and objectives for each team. Ensure a balanced distribution of work among teams to optimize productivity. title: ELN/LIMS configurations expert
description:
**Company Description**
DigAIT is a scientific technology and consulting partner that supports chemical and life sciences organizations in accelerating digital transformation across research, development, laboratory, manufacturing, and operations. The company combines AI, IT, scientific data, and deep domain expertise to design and implement digital solutions that make scientific processes more connected and data-driven. Its capabilities span process modeling, laboratory and manufacturing solutions, data analytics, business intelligence, and advanced AI technologies, including machine learning and generative AI. DigAIT works across the full transformation journey—from assessing current processes to implementing ELN/LIMS, integrating data, and enabling scalable analytics and AI. The team is experienced with leading platforms and tools such as LIMS, ELN, MES, ERP, SAP Signavio, BPMN, Power BI, Tableau, AWS, Azure, Python, and modern AI/LLM platforms.

**Role Description**
For Client based in Europe, we are looking for a ELN/LIMS configurations expert. This role based will be in Chennai, structured as a hybrid position that combines on-site work with some work-from-home flexibility. You will connect lab users, data science teams, and IT, ensuring that experimental data is captured in a structured, high-quality, and ML-ready form. The role combines hands-on configuration, product ownership, roll-out coordination for targeted labs and sites, and IT operations.

**Key responsibilities:**

1. Configurations and trainings

* Work with lab colleagues to design and configure workflows, data uploaders, templates, and master data especially related to formulation development process (materials, formulations, raw materials, test methods, properties, units)
* Translate lab processes in chemistry and material development into robust platform configurations
* Train users, support onboarding, and drive adoption

2. Product management

* Collect, prioritize, and manage requirements from business stakeholders
* Maintain the product backlog and roadmap, and deliver in an agile (Scrum) setup
* Run sprint planning, reviews, and stakeholder communication
* Manage releases, change requests, and configuration testing/validation

3. Integrations and IT operations

* Coordinate the development of integrations between the ELN and other systems (LIMS, ERP, PLM, instruments/CDS, data lakes, analytics/ML platforms) via APIs and interfaces
* Handle incident and problem management, second-level support, and vendor coordination
* Maintain knowledge documentation (configuration specs, SOPs, user guides, FAQs)

4. Roll-out and adoption coordination

* Coordinate roll-out activities end-to-end for specific smaller labs or sites (e.g., HTE lab, a particular site roll-out), building on the platform already established in the larger labs
* Reuse and adapt existing configurations, templates, and master data from the larger labs, and identify only the lab-specific extensions needed (e.g., HTE-specific workflows, uploaders, instrument interfaces)
* Define roll-out plans, timelines, and milestones together with the respective lab leads, IT, and data science teams
* Manage change and communication: stakeholder updates, training, user onboarding, and feedback loops
* Track adoption and roll-out KPIs (e.g., active users, workflow usage, open issues) and hand over to operations with complete documentation and support processes

5. Data governance

* Work with ML/data science teams to define rules for good data management (naming conventions, ontologies, mandatory fields, units, metadata)

**Qualifications**

* PhD or master’s degree in a relevant field such as Material science, Chemistry, physics or a related discipline is preferred.
* Experience with other ELN/LIMS/R&D platforms
  in chemical or life sciences laboratories including workflow design and data model configuration
  (Preferably Formulation data related experience). With PhD a minimum for 2-3 working experience is required and with Masters a minimum of 7-8 years working experience in required.
* Strong knowledge of application integration (REST APIs, data pipelines, SSO/identity, interfaces between lab and enterprise systems)
* Experience with Scrum/agile, backlog management, and stakeholder prioritization. Certifications such as Scrum Master/PSPO, ITIL, or relevant vendor certifications
* Experience with ITIL-based incident/change management
* Candidates should possess clear Communication skills to collaborate with scientists, IT teams, and business stakeholders and to document configurations and processes.
* Good familiarity with data science and ML concepts: data preparation, feature/data requirements, FAIR principles, data modeling
* Ability to work in a hybrid setup in Chennai, manage priorities independently, and adapt to evolving project requirements and technologies.

title: Senior Engineering Manager, MineStar
description:
**Career Area**
Engineering
  
  
**Job Description**
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
**Senior Engineering Manager, MineStar**
**Your Work Shapes the World**
Whether it is groundbreaking products, best-in-class solutions or creating a lifelong career, you can do work that matters at Caterpillar. When you join Caterpillar, you join a global team of makers, innovators and doers who turn progress and innovation into outcomes for customers and communities.
  
  
**Job Summary**
Caterpillar is seeking a Senior Engineering Manager to provide product and technical leadership for MineStar development. This role leads engineering teams responsible for developing, integrating, enhancing, maintaining and supporting mining technology solutions that deliver measurable value for customers.
  
  
The Senior Engineering Manager operates across a broader product and organisational scope than an Engineering Manager while providing direct leadership to engineering managers and supervisors in the organization. The role translates MineStar product strategy into executable engineering priorities, develops leaders and technical talent, and ensures teams deliver safe, reliable, supportable and competitive solutions.
  
  
This leader will partner closely with product management, commercial and product support organisations, process owners, suppliers, dealers and mining customers. Success requires strong engineering judgement, disciplined program execution, customer focus, global collaboration and the ability to influence complex decisions through technical and business expertise.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Lead a portfolio of MineStar product development, integration, enhancement, maintenance work, aligning engineering outcomes with product strategy and business priorities.
* Translate strategic direction into department objectives, roadmaps, resource plans, budgets and measurable delivery commitments across multiple teams or technical workstreams.
* Provide leadership and performance management for engineering managers, technical leaders and product development staff. Build succession strength and a high-performing leadership pipeline.
* Coordinate technical feasibility assessment, architecture and design optimisation, validation planning, cost and schedule management, risk assessment, mitigation and ongoing production support.
* Own or influence engineering investment decisions and manage the research and development budget for the assigned MineStar portfolio, balancing new capability, modernisation, quality, reliability and customer support.
* Establish governance and operating rhythms that provide stakeholders with clear visibility into scope, decisions, dependencies, risks, financial performance and delivery status.
* Guide the resolution of complex, cross-component and field issues by bringing together internal experts, suppliers, dealers and customer teams. Ensure that lessons learned improve future product and process decisions.
* Champion systems and software engineering discipline, technical excellence, cybersecurity, safety, quality, reliability, scalability and lifecycle support across MineStar solutions.
* Monitor customer needs, market dynamics, competitor movement and technology developments. Recommend product, capability and engineering responses that strengthen MineStar customer value and competitive position.
* Build strong partnerships across Caterpillar business units and functions and with external suppliers. Reconcile competing priorities and create shared accountability for outcomes.
* Represent MineStar with customers, dealers, suppliers and senior leaders, communicating complex technical and business issues clearly and serving as a trusted engineering adviser.
* Foster innovation, operational excellence, inclusion and continuous improvement while maintaining urgency and accountability for commitments.

**Education Requirement**

* Bachelor’s degree in an accredited Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering or closely related technical curriculum.
* An advanced technical or business degree is preferred.

**What Skills You Will Have**
**Planning: Tactical and Strategic**
Develops integrated plans across multiple teams; converts product strategy into sequenced engineering priorities; allocates people and funding against the highest-value outcomes; and adjusts plans using data, risks and changing business conditions.
  
  
**Technical Excellence**
Creates an environment that rewards technical excellence; provides recognised leadership on complex systems and software challenges; engages the appropriate subject-matter experts; and ensures decisions reflect sound architecture, engineering evidence and lifecycle considerations.
  
  
**Decision Making and Critical Thinking**
Frames ambiguous problems, evaluates alternatives with multiple stakeholders, distinguishes facts from assumptions, anticipates second-order effects and makes timely decisions during high-impact or customer-critical situations.
  
  
**Product Design and Development**
Leads cross-functional development from concept through production and support; strengthens development methods and governance; and balances customer value, speed, quality, cost, reliability and technical debt.
  
  
**Customer and Market Focus**
Maintains a direct understanding of mining customer needs and success criteria; responds proactively to market and competitive shifts; resolves difficult customer issues; and converts field insight into prioritised product and engineering action.
  
  
**Influencing Through Expertise**
Explains complex concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences; challenges decisions constructively with evidence; builds trust across organisational boundaries; and develops others as credible technical advisers.
  
  
**Collaborating Globally**
Builds networks across functions, regions, dealers, suppliers and customers; reconciles conflicting interests; uses collective expertise to solve complex problems; and creates shared ownership for business results.
  
  
**People Leadership and Career Development**
Develops managers and technical leaders, establishes business-driven development plans, identifies mission-critical capability gaps, supports targeted rotations and learning, and links talent decisions to long-term MineStar needs.
  
  
**Program, Financial and Risk Management**
Manages a portfolio of commitments, budgets, dependencies and risks; establishes transparent operating mechanisms; and intervenes early when delivery, quality, cost or customer outcomes are at risk.
  
  
**Troubleshooting and Production Support**
Directs the structured resolution of complex and non-recurring failures, coordinates internal and external experts, establishes mechanisms for problem tracking and organisational learning, and ensures corrective actions address root causes.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Typically fifteen or more years of progressively responsible experience in engineering, software, systems or product development, including significant leadership responsibility. Equivalent combinations of education and experience will be considered.
* Demonstrated experience leading managers, technical leaders or multiple engineering teams delivering complex products or integrated systems.
* Experience managing product development scope, schedules, budgets, risks and production-support priorities.
* Experience working across organisational boundaries and communicating with senior leaders, customers and external partners.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, make evidence-based decisions and deliver outcomes through others.

**Top Candidates Will Also Have**

* Experience with MineStar, mining technology, autonomy, fleet management, site systems or related digital products.
* Experience with software-intensive and systems-of-systems product development, including cloud and on-premises deployments and integration with machine or site technology.
* Experience implementing Gen AI development tools and practices.
* Knowledge of Caterpillar product development and new product introduction processes, or comparable lifecycle governance in a complex industrial environment.
* Experience modernising established products while maintaining compatibility, quality and customer continuity.
* Demonstrated success developing engineering managers and senior technical talent across global teams.
* Direct experience engaging mining customers, dealers, suppliers and product support organisations.

**Additional Information**

* Location, relocation support and travel requirements will be confirmed for the final posting.
* The role is expected to include regular interaction with global teams, suppliers, dealers and mining customers.
* Final experience requirements and internal job classification should be validated with Human Resources before posting.

**What You Will Get**
A career with a global team whose engineering work helps customers build a better, more sustainable world, together with Caterpillar total rewards and development opportunities applicable to the position and location
  
  
**Posting Dates**
October 12, 2026 - October 26, 2026
  
  
Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply
  
  
Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community.

We are headquartered in the Silicon Valley and have our delivery centres across the globe.

The below role is for our Chennai, Bangalore and Hyderabad.

**About the role:**

As
**Delivery Partner - Technology Consulting,**
you will be performing the role of Global Service delivery manager for various D&A products built and managed for a set of Tiger clientele.

In doing so, you will closely collaborate with program leads, technology architects and data scientists across global locations.

In this Global Service delivery Manager role, below are some of the Key R&R: As a Global Service Delivery Manager:

Guarantee 99%+ refresh reliability across all data products (daily, weekly, real-time refreshes). Oversee incident response for failed data pipelines, schema drift, API timeouts, or data quality breaches.

Define and enforce Tier 1–3 support workflows, Mean Time to Detect (MTTD), and Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR).

Implement DQ and BQ testing (Manual Automated) to ensure data accuracy before reports update.

Manage data refresh dependencies, batch scheduling, and resource allocation to prevent cluster/warehouse bottlenecks during peak hours.

Monitor cloud data platform costs associated with entire portfolio and enable implementation of auto-scaling, query optimization, and idle compute termination to optimize cloud consumption.

**Track active user metrics across all the products:**

* Daily Active Users (DAU), Monthly Active Users (MAU), query count, and top-utilized dashboards. Identify "dormant" or low-usage products (e.g., <5 views/month) to run targeted re-engagement campaigns or sunset them to save cost.
* Manage product versions, feature updates, and deprecation roadmap for obsolete dashboards or legacy pipelines.
* Conduct quarterly product reviews with business owners to ensure data products still match changing business logic.
* Establish user feedback loops (NPS/CSAT surveys) integrated directly into BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker) and web applications
* Deploy automated mechanisms to identify data anomalies, unexpected row-count spikes, or volume drops before products refresh for end-users.

title: CAPEX Excellence specialist
description:
**Support CAPEX planning, execution and reporting**
Join NKT in a role that connects CAPEX governance, system support, and business improvement across an international organization. You will own day-to-day support, adoption, and continuous improvement of the CAPEX tool, helping teams work with consistent data, reliable reporting, and clear processes. This is a valuable opportunity to contribute to the green transition by supporting investment decisions across the business. Are you motivated by combining systems, process standards, and user support in one role?
  
  
**Keep CAPEX operations stable and consistent**
In this role, you will act as the main business contact for the CAPEX tool and related process standards. You will support users, coordinate incidents and improvement requests with, and help maintain common templates, workflows, and reporting standards. The role also includes governance of master data, backlog prioritization, UAT coordination, and communication around releases and changes. You will work closely with CAPEX project managers, finance, procurement, IT, and process owners to support reliable planning, execution, and tracking across sites and functions.
  
  
**Your Responsibility Will Be To**

* Provide first-line functional support and coordinate further support when needed
* Maintain user guides, SOPs, and training materials
* Govern usage standards, workflows, and documentation requirements
* Support reports and dashboards with consistent KPI definitions
* Coordinate UAT, releases and backlog priorities

You will work across manufacturing sites and shared functions, in close collaboration with CAPEX project managers, site controllers, procurement and IT.
  
  
**Structured communicator with a clear quality focus**
We are looking for someone who is service-minded, and organized, with a practical approach to user support and process governance. You communicate clearly with both end users and management, work carefully with documentation and change control, and are comfortable balancing business needs with standard ways of working. The right person is initiative-taking, detail-oriented, and able to move issues forward while keeping compliance, auditability, and data quality in focus.
  
  
**You Also Have**

* 5+ years of experience in CAPEX controlling, project execution, PMO, finance, or a similar area using CAPEX, ERP, or project portfolio tools
* Experience translating business needs into system requirements and supporting UAT, training, and change management
* Good understanding of data structures, reporting, and integrations with finance or ERP systems
* Experience acting as system or product owner
* Training or certification in ERP/PM systems or project management

**Help improve investment quality for a greener future**
NKT is committed to developing a diverse organization and culture where people of diverse backgrounds can grow and are inspired to do their best. We are motivated to establish gender diversity at NKT and encourage all interested candidates to apply – even if you don’t tick all the boxes described. We believe that a diverse organization enables long-term performance, and that an inclusive and welcoming culture creates a better work environment.
  
  
In this role, you will be part of a collaborative international setting where you can broaden your skills in CAPEX governance, systems, reporting, and change processes. You will work with colleagues across business functions and sites, contribute to continuous improvement, and support reliable investment planning that matters to NKT’s ongoing journey and the wider green transition.
  
  
“This role is ideal for someone who enjoys connecting systems, process standards, and user needs to create reliable CAPEX planning and reporting across the business,” says Hiring Manager, Karim Damiani
  
  
Read more about our offer and listen to some voices of NKT Connectors here!
  
  
We will review applications continuously, but we recommend you apply no later than 20th November 2026. Be aware that personality and cognitive tests might be included in the recruitment process. Please note that due to the GDPR regulations we cannot accept any applications via e-mail.
  
  
We collect confidential candidate experience feedback to improve our recruitment process. Your responses are for quality development only and do not affect hiring decisions.
  
  
Be a Connector of the green tomorrow!
  
  
**About NKT**
*NKT connects a greener world with high-quality power cable technology and takes centre stage as the world moves towards green energy. NKT designs, manufactures and installs low-, medium- and high-voltage power cable solutions enabling sustainable energy transmission. Since 1891, NKT has innovated the power cable technology building the infrastructure for the first light bulbs to the megawatts created by renewable energy today. NKT is headquartered in Denmark and employs 6,500 people. NKT is listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen and realised a revenue of EUR 3.6 billion in 2025. We connect a greener world. www.nkt.com*

title: Project Manager (2-4 years exp in Strategic Portfolio Management/SPM)
description:
**About Gartner IT:**
Join a world-class team of skilled professionals who build creative digital solutions to support our colleagues and clients. We make a broad organizational impact by delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that power Gartner. Gartner IT values its culture of nonstop innovation, an outcome-driven approach to success, and the notion that great ideas can come from anyone on the team.
  
  
**About this role:**
Our Technology Strategy and Operations team is seeking a Project Manager to lead administration of the IT Strategic Portfolio Management processes and tool. You will implement SPM capabilities and processes to be utilized across the IT department, maintaining overall responsibility for the SPM processes and coordination across multiple IT PMO teams. You will provide training to users and will be responsible for access control, security, preparing system requirements, documentation, and UAT/regression testing of any development with respect to the SPM tool.
  
  
**What you’ll do:**

* Responsible for managing and maintaining the processes of an enterprise software platform used to prioritize, track, and analyze an organization's strategic initiatives, programs, and projects.
* Ensuring smooth operation, data accuracy, and efficient access for users to support informed decision-making regarding project selection and resource allocation across the portfolio
* Key duties include system configuration, user management, data integrity checks, reporting generation, and providing technical support to stakeholders.
* Monitor system performance, identify and troubleshoot technical issues, and collaborate with the development team to implement updates and patches.
* Manage data integrations with other systems to ensure accurate data flow.
* Uphold security protocols to protect sensitive data within the system.
* Define and enforce data quality standards, ensuring accurate data entry and validation.
* Regularly review and clean data to maintain data integrity.
* Develop and maintain data dictionaries to clarify data definitions and usage.
* Create customized reports and dashboards to visualize key portfolio metrics (e.g., project status, resource utilization, financial impact).
* Analyze portfolio data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for optimization.
* Apply project management methodologies to manage projects related to SPM, inclusive of project planning, backlog refinement, scope definition, team collaboration, documentation, and roll-out activities.
* Generate reports for senior management and stakeholders to support strategic decision-making.
* Provide training and support to users on navigating the SPM system and utilizing its functionalities.
* Address user queries and resolve system-related issues.
* Gather feedback from users to identify areas for improvement and system enhancements.
* Configure and manage workflows within the SPM system to streamline project intake, prioritization, and approval processes.
* Ensure adherence to established portfolio management methodologies and governance procedures.

**What you’ll need:**

* 2 to 4 years progressive technology experience with administrating strategic portfolio management tools at an enterprise level.
* Strong understanding of project management principles and methodologies
* Expertise in Strategic Portfolio Management software (e.g., Planview, ServiceNow, etc.) will be preferred.
* Proficiency in data analysis, reporting, and visualization tools
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with diverse stakeholders
* Proficiency in gathering and documenting business requirements and processes
* Technical skills in database management, system integration, and troubleshooting
* Ability to learn new technologies quickly and adapt to changing business requirements
* Excellent verbal & written communication skills with demonstrated ability to convey complex concepts and analyses in an accessible and compelling way.
* Strong knowledge of tech operations practices with SPM Tools and a proven ability to establish trusted business relationships across business units
* Results-oriented with strategic thinking and a proven track record of solving complex problems, thinking creatively and successfully drawing the larger business story out of facts and data.
* Demonstrated ability to lead projects and teams in a fast-paced environment and to inspire rapid adoption of change in a complex matrixed organization with distributed virtual teams.
* Scrum/Agile certification, PMP certification preferred

**Who you are:**

* Effective time management skills and ability to meet deadlines.
* Excellent communication skills for interacting with both technical and business audiences.
* Strong organization, multitasking, and prioritization abilities.
* Willingness and aptitude to embrace new technologies and rapidly master new concepts.
* Intellectual curiosity and passion for technology, with a drive to stay current with emerging trends.
* Commitment to delivering high-quality project work on time and within budget.

Don’t meet every single requirement? We encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be the right candidate for this, or other roles.
  
  
**Who are we?**
At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
  
  
Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.
  
  
Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.
  
  
**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**
Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
  
  
We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
  
  
Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.
  
  
We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.
  
  
**Gartner is the world authority on AI**
At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.
  
  
It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.
  
  
**What do we offer?**
Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.
  
  
In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.
  
  
Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

title: Operations Delivery Manager - Insurance
description:
**About Anoud Technologies**

Anoud Technologies builds scalable, high-quality Insurance product solutions, partnering closely with global stakeholders and delivery teams.

**The Role**

Anoud is hiring an Operations Delivery Manager to own end-to-end delivery of our Insurance product implementation for onshore/global clients, working out of our Chennai offshore team. This is an application implementation delivery role – the person will lead product configuration, rollout, and go-live delivery for insurance clients, not infrastructure or platform operations. Strong stakeholder management is core to this role, as the person will be the primary bridge between onshore business/client stakeholders and the offshore implementation team.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Insurance Product Implementation & Delivery Management**

* Own end-to-end delivery of Insurance product implementations – configuration, testing, UAT, and go-live
* Ensure implementation delivery consistently meets agreed SLAs, OLAs, KPIs, and client expectations
* Establish clear ownership, accountability, and governance across implementation and engineering teams
* Monitor delivery performance, identify implementation risks, and initiate corrective actions
* Drive delivery maturity through standardization, automation, process improvement, and implementation best practices
* Ensure business-critical product rollouts have appropriate coverage, documented procedures, and escalation mechanisms
* Maintain a strong focus on delivery quality, client satisfaction, and product reliability
* Provide regular management reporting covering implementation health, risks, issues, and improvement initiatives

**2. Stakeholder Management (Core Strength Required)**

* Act as the primary offshore point of contact for onshore/global client stakeholders and leadership
* Lead client and internal governance calls, presenting delivery status, risks, and outcomes with clarity and confidence
* Build and maintain trusted, long-term relationships with client stakeholders across business and technology
* Own escalations end-to-end – fast resolution, transparent and proactive communication
* Manage expectations across multiple stakeholder groups (client, onshore leadership, offshore delivery team) simultaneously

**3. Team & People Management**

* Manage and grow team leads and implementation/delivery managers
* Own capacity planning and resource allocation across implementation projects
* Build a culture of ownership and accountability; support career growth and succession planning

**4. AI-Enabled Delivery**

* Actively use AI tools in day-to-day delivery work – reporting, status updates, documentation, risk analysis, and productivity tasks
* Champion the adoption of AI-assisted workflows within the delivery team to improve speed and quality
* Comfortable evaluating and recommending AI tools that can streamline implementation and operational processes

**5. Reporting**

* Own weekly/monthly implementation reporting: SLA adherence, delivery timelines, quality, risk status, and client feedback

**Required Experience**

* 12–16 years in IT Delivery Management, Implementation Management, or Insurance Technology Delivery
* 6–8 years specifically managing offshore delivery/implementation teams reporting into onshore/global stakeholders
* Mandatory: Experience delivering Insurance product implementations (policy admin, claims, underwriting, or related insurance platforms)
* Proven, demonstrable strength in stakeholder management – client-facing experience is essential, not just internal team coordination
* Comfortable using AI tools daily as part of delivery workflow (reporting, documentation, analysis)
* Demonstrated ownership of delivery governance and KPI reporting

**Required Skills**

Insurance Product Implementation • Application Delivery Management • Stakeholder & Client Management • SLA/OLA Management • Delivery Governance • Team Leadership • Capacity Planning • Risk & Escalation Management • Process Improvement • AI-Assisted Delivery Practices

**Preferred Certifications**

* PMP (Project Management Professional) – Preferred for strong project, delivery, planning, risk, budget, and stakeholder management capabilities
* ITIL 4 Foundation / Managing Professional – Preferred for service management, incident, problem, change, and governance experience
* PRINCE2 Practitioner – Preferred for structured project governance and delivery controls
* Agile / Scrum certification – Desirable for Agile, DevOps, and product-oriented delivery environments

title: Project Manager
description:
**About FAIR CONNECTS INDIA LLP**

FAIR CONNECTS INDIA LLP (FCI) is an emerging exhibition and conference organising company focused on creating sector-specific B2B business platforms across India. Our portfolio covers the entire construction industries such as construction machineries, equipment, materials, products, solutions, smart building technologies, electrical and power, paints and coatings.

With over 20 years of industry experience behind our core expertise, we aim to connect manufacturers, suppliers, distributors, buyers, industry associations and business decision-makers through professionally organised exhibitions and conferences.

**Job Overview**

We are looking for a result-oriented
**Project Manager**
to drive exhibition sales, develop new business opportunities, build industry relationships and manage the commercial growth of assigned exhibition projects.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for identifying potential exhibitors and sponsors, acquiring new clients, developing strategic partnerships, achieving project revenue targets and coordinating with internal teams to ensure the successful execution of exhibitions.

This role is suited to a proactive professional with strong B2B sales capabilities, industry networking skills, commercial acumen and the ability to manage projects independently.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Business Development & Sales**

·       Develop and implement business development strategies for assigned exhibitions and conferences.

·       Identify, approach and acquire exhibitors, sponsors, industry partners and strategic clients.

·       Generate new business leads through LinkedIn, databases, telephone calls, email campaigns, industry networks and direct meetings.

·       Promote exhibition participation to manufacturers, dealers, distributors, importers, exporters and service providers.

·       Prepare sales proposals, quotations, participation packages and sponsorship offers.

·       Negotiate commercial terms and close exhibition space bookings and sponsorship deals.

**2. Exhibition Project Management**

·       Take ownership of assigned exhibition projects from planning and sales mobilisation through execution and post-event follow-up.

·       Develop project sales plans, timelines, budgets and revenue forecasts.

·       Monitor exhibition space sales, booking status, payment collections and revenue performance.

·       Coordinate with marketing, operations, design, visitor promotion and finance teams.

·       Ensure timely follow-up with exhibitors and sponsors regarding participation, payments, branding and other commitments.

·       Monitor project milestones and resolve commercial or operational issues in coordination with management.

**3. Revenue Generation & Target Achievement**

·       Achieve assigned monthly, quarterly and project-wise sales targets.

·       Drive revenue through exhibition space sales, sponsorships, advertising, branding opportunities and other commercial offerings.

·       Maintain a healthy sales pipeline and provide accurate sales forecasts.

·       Ensure timely collection of exhibitor payments and follow up on outstanding receivables.

·       Prepare regular reports on sales performance, bookings, collections, lead conversion and project profitability.

**4. Industry Networking & Strategic Partnerships**

·       Build relationships with industry associations, trade bodies, chambers of commerce and sector-specific organisations.

·       Develop association partnerships to increase exhibitor participation and industry engagement.

·       Identify new industry segments and potential opportunities for future exhibitions.

·       Represent FCI at industry meetings, business networking events and relevant trade exhibitions.

**5. Team Leadership & Reporting**

* Guide and coordinate with sales executives, tele callers and business development team members, as applicable.
* Establish lead-generation, follow-up and client-conversion processes.
* Maintain accurate CRM records, sales databases and project reports.
* Conduct periodic performance reviews of the sales pipeline and take corrective action to meet targets.
* Report project progress, commercial risks and business opportunities to management.

**Candidate Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Commerce or a related discipline; an MBA is an advantage.
* 5–10 years of relevant experience in B2B business development, exhibition sales, trade fairs, conferences or event management.
* Demonstrated ability to acquire corporate clients and close high-value B2B sales.
* Experience in exhibitor acquisition, sponsorship sales, space booking and commercial negotiations is highly desirable.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship-management skills.
* Ability to work with sales targets, revenue forecasts and collection objectives.
* Familiarity with MS Excel, PowerPoint, CRM tools, LinkedIn prospecting and digital lead-generation methods.
* Willingness to travel within India for client meetings, industry networking and exhibition-related activities.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership and deliver measurable business results.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be assessed against agreed objectives, including:

·       Exhibition space sales and revenue achieved.

·       Number of new exhibitors and corporate clients acquired.

·       Sponsorship and additional revenue generated.

·       Lead-to-booking conversion rate.

·       Timely collection of exhibitor payments.

·       Project revenue forecast accuracy and contribution to profitability.

·       Association partnerships and strategic business relationships developed.

·       Timely completion of project milestones and quality of client servicing.

**What We Offer**

* An opportunity to take ownership of growing B2B exhibition projects.
* Exposure to multiple industrial sectors and corporate business networks.
* Performance-linked incentives based on agreed sales, collection and project targets.
* Career growth opportunities in exhibition management and business development leadership.
* A dynamic, entrepreneurial work environment with opportunities to build new industry platforms.

**How to Apply**

·       Interested candidates may apply through LinkedIn with their updated resume, highlighting relevant experience in B2B sales, exhibition business development, client acquisition and revenue generation.

·       Contact at +91 9500070800 or write to info@fairconnects.in

title: Head, Transversal Change Management (Program Manager)
description:
**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.
  
  
**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialised businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability
  
  
Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
  
  
At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. title: ST - Telco-Nokia Flow One-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Technology Consulting - Manager – Nokia FlowOne Solution Architect**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
In this role at EY GDS Consulting, you will play a key role in shaping innovative solutions for telecom clients, acting as their trusted advisor in transformation leveraging Nokia FlowOne driven solutions. You will apply leading industry standards along with Nokia FlowOne expertise to solve complex telecommunication challenges and leverage cutting-edge technologies to drive Telco transformations. You will support the Partners and the Markets team in any opportunities that are initiated by clients.
  
  
You will be responsible to create a market for EY offerings across the telecommunications value chain and generate new leads and opportunities based on the client relationships you already have. Additionally, you will be responsible for delivery of key client outcomes on engagements by managing the teams on ground and client expectations of delivery, helping project teams mitigate delivery risk and identifying key issues that hinder outcomes for the client.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Provide solution architecture and thought leadership on Zero Touch Fulfilment and Autonomous Networks leveraging Nokia FlowOne and other Nokia suite of OSS products
* Lead the implementation of related solutions, ensuring adherence to project timelines and quality standards.
* Driving presales response for OSS transformation RFIs/RFPs.
* Develop comprehensive documentation for network architectures, designs, and processes.
* Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in Autonomous networks, AI, and Machine learning with hands on experience in leveraging leading AI tools for deliveries.
* Develop and apply solution architecture standards, processes, and principles.
* Evaluate and recommend technologies, tools, and platforms that support autonomous networking initiatives.
* You will be the day-to-day point of contact for clients and managers on projects. You structure and engage teams to deliver high-quality outputs.
* Take the lead in identifying client issues and proposing the most appropriate approach for challenges that the telecommunication industry players face.
* You help develop the business and acquire new clients and engagements, including the identification and pursuit of business opportunities by forging strong client relationships.
* You build and maintain long-term relationships with senior clients.
* You drive strategic discussions regarding business objectives and strategy KPIs.
* Delivering qualified solutions to meet business objectives, providing focus to ensure scope and objectives are maintained throughout the project and program life cycles ensuring benefits realization.
* Result oriented leadership style, setting achievable goals and leading by example – linking commercial and technical arenas.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Consultant with 10-12 Years proven experience and hands-on professional experience in Nokia FlowOne, driving large programs and should have worked as an Architect/Designer for at least 5 years.
* Understanding of 5G Slicing, 5G SA/NSA networks, IP/MPLS, Optics, IMS, VoLTE, NFV/SDN, Fixed network.
* In depth knowledge of TMForum’s Open Digital Architecture (ODA) and related ODA components along with TMForum Open APIs.
* Deep knowledge of OSS Architecture, Processes and Systems with practical and proven experience of solutioning for large telecom companies.
* Experience in architecting Zero-Touch operations, Closed Loop Automation, Autonomous Networks and implementing Intent-Driven Management systems to translate business goals to machine readable “Intents” in telecom domain.
* Experience in building comprehensive solutions and response to complex RFx during presales, especially leveraging Nokia’s OSS product suite.
* Providing Autonomous Networks (AN) thought leadership, solution implementation leadership, application expertise and solution vision to clients.
* Additional experience in other Nokia suite of OSS products will be an added advantage.
* Hands-on experience in Java, Python, Kubernetes, Microservices, Databases, etc.
* Expertise and experience to provide thought leadership and guidance on resolving complex implementation and solution issues.
* Expertise to review and approve methods design and development solution documents, internal and external test strategies, plans and scripts.
* Navigate complex client relationships and large transformation related challenges.
* Extensive RFP exposure - developing capability needs and supplier liaison.
* Process development for both 'As Is' and 'To Be' to aid requirement and solution definition and scoping.
* A bachelor’s degree in Electronics/Computer Science/Information Technology/ or any other relevant discipline.
* Relevant certifications (E.g., TOGAF, eTOM, ODA) are a plus.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

**Ideally, you will also have:**

* Strong leadership skills, teaming and communications
* Strong drive to excel professionally, and to guide and motivate others.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Dedicated, resourceful and able to work under pressure.

**What we look for:**
Highly motivated individuals with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to prioritize shifting workloads in a rapidly changing industry. An effective communicator, you’ll be a confident leader equipped with strong people management skills and a genuine passion to make things happen in a dynamic organization. If you’re ready to take on a wide range of responsibilities and are committed to seeking out new ways to make a difference, this role is for you.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Business Operations Specialist
description:
**Description -**
**Job Summary**
The Business Operations Specialist supports HP Service Supply Chain Harvesting programs and operations in India and other APJ markets. The role is responsible for end-to-end operational coordination, service partner governance, performance analysis, and continuous improvement. Working closely with internal stakeholders and external service partners, the position helps optimize cost, quality, turnaround time, and operational performance while ensuring compliance with agreed KPIs and governance requirements.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Program and Operational Management
  
  

* Manage end-to-end program operations to deliver agreed savings targets and operational KPIs.
* Coordinate moderately complex Service Supply Chain activities, including demand planning, ROI analysis, pricing, purchase order requests, delivery scheduling, and operational readiness.
* Track operational performance, identify gaps, and coordinate corrective actions with the relevant owners.
* Support the validation and approval of partner spend in accordance with established controls and timelines.

Partner and Vendor Governance
  
  

* Govern service partner and vendor performance against agreed cost, quality, turnaround time, and service-level targets.
* Conduct regular performance reviews with partners, vendors, internal stakeholders, and management teams.
* Manage operational escalations and drive timely resolution through structured problem-solving and clear follow-up actions.
* Maintain positive and professional working relationships with internal teams and external partners.

Performance Reporting and Data Analysis
  
  

* Analyze performance data, operational trends, and cost impacts to support business decisions.
* Prepare monthly and ad hoc KPI reports, dashboards, management slides, and business updates.
* Provide clear insights, recommendations, and action tracking based on data analysis.
* Maintain accurate and well-governed program documentation and SharePoint content.

description:

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The SAP TM Transportation Management Senior Consultant serves as a senior-level advisor responsible for leading complex SAP Transportation Management (TM) transformation initiatives for enterprise clients. This role combines deep SAP TM expertise with strategic consulting capabilities to design, implement, and optimize end-to-end transportation solutions that drive operational excellence, cost reduction, and supply chain visibility. The consultant participates in pursuing client sales opportunities and working on bid & proposal efforts along with activities including configuration and setting up the SAP TM system, assessment of client business problems, conducting the analysis to solve the problems, administration of engagement activities while contributing to practice growth and innovation.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Responsible for the successful delivery of the SAP TM module related deliverables in SAP and S4 HANA implementation, support, and upgrade projects to meet engagement objectives and budget
* Lead design workshops with the client and responsible for requirement gathering, solution design, fit-gap analysis, writing functional specification, system configuration, testing and cutover activities for both standalone SAP TM system and embedded SAP TM in S/4 HANA
* Design SAP TM system Integrations with other modules of SAP/S4 HANA (like EWM, SD, MM etc.) and 3rd Party system
* Provide functional and business process expertise to the project team, resolve TM related client s issues and mentor junior team members
* Handle various industry specific complex TM scenarios like shipper, LSP and carriers
* Work with sales team, write proposals, define SAP TM scope and effort estimation for the new opportunities and present SAP TM capability to the potential client

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Technical and Professional Requirements:**

* 8-10 years of experience in implementation, support and upgrade projects in SAP TM
* Must have good functional and business knowledge, worked in multiple E2E implementations, integration, testing and application support in S/4HANA embedded TM and SAP TM (latest versions)
* Ability to interact with other cross functional teams from modules like OTC, EWM for integration scenario
* Excellent written and verbal interpersonal skills for co-ordinating across teams
* Should be able to lead workshop or working sessions with business
* Knowledge in ABAP and debugging would be nice to have

**Core SAP TM Competencies:**

* Comprehensive knowledge in all L3 aspects of SAP TM such as Order Management (Logistics Integration, Freight Unit, Forwarding Order, Freight Order, Freight Booking), Transportation Planning and Execution, Carrier Selection, Charge Calculation and Freight Settlement, Invoice Integration and Carrier Communication methodologies
* Proficiency in Master Data setup such as Resource Management, Locations, Business Partners etc.
* Deep understanding of SAP TM integration with SAP ERP S/4HANA logistics (SD, MM, LE) and embedded TM scenarios
* Expertise in Transportation Planning strategies: manual planning, Transportation Cockpit, optimizer-based planning (VSR), and automated freight unit building
* Proficiency in Freight Order Lifecycle Management, Freight Tendering processes, Subcontracting and Execution monitoring
* Advanced knowledge of Charge calculation, Freight Agreement Management, Rate tables and Transportation cost allocation

**Technical Skills:**

* SAP TM configuration and customizing across all functional areas (master data, organizational structures, profiles setup for Planning, business rules such as BRF+ conditions)
* Data migration methodologies using DRF, LSMW, SAP Data Services, or Migration Cockpit; system landscape design (Development, Quality, Production)
* Understanding of SAP TM on HANA optimization, performance tuning, and analytics capabilities
* Expertise in implementation planning, fit-gap analysis, SAP TM system configuration E2E, testing, rollout and post-implementation support.

**Industry Knowledge:**

* Expertise in logistics and supply chain operations across multiple transportation modes (road, rail, ocean, air, intermodal)
* Knowledge of carrier management practices, freight procurement, contract negotiations, and service level agreements
* Familiarity with industry best practices, benchmarks, and emerging trends (sustainability, real-time visibility, autonomous transportation)

**Consulting Competencies:**
**Client Management**

* Proven ability to engage with client and influence strategic decision-making
* Expertise in requirements gathering through workshops, interviews, and process analysis; translating business needs into technical specifications
* Change management and organizational adoption strategies, including training program design, communication planning, and stakeholder engagement
* Project governance frameworks, steering committee management, and escalation resolution

**Solution Design**

* End-to-end solution architecture spanning SAP TM, ERP or S/4 HANA, EWM, GTS, and third-party logistics systems (TMS, WMS, visibility platforms)
* Business process optimization using Lean Six Sigma or similar methodologies; identification of automation opportunities and efficiency gains
* Integration strategy development including point-to-point, hub-based, and API-led connectivity approaches
* Oversight of custom development (ABAP, SAPUI5, BRF+) ensuring adherence to SAP standards and maintainability

**Leadership & Delivery**

* Project and program management using methodologies such as SAP Activate, Agile, or hybrid approaches.
* Leadership of diverse teams (10-30+ members) including onshore, nearshore, and offshore resources across functional and technical disciplines
* Quality assurance practices including test strategy development, UAT coordination, cutover planning, and post-go-live support
* Risk management, issue resolution, and proactive communication to ensure on-time, on-budget delivery

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Degree in Engineering or MBA in Supply Chain Area.
* Desired to have SAP certification on SAP TM.
* Having experience of working in integration area of SAP TM and other areas.
* Minimum of 8-10 years of experience in SAP TM.

**What We Offer You**

 We design, build, manage, and maintain infrastructure for our clients. We recruit, reward, and develop our people based on merit, regardless of race, nationality, religion, gender, age, sexual orientation, marital status, or disability. We value our people and treat everyone who works for or with Petrofac fairly and without discrimination.
   

  

 The world is re\-thinking its energy supply and energy security needs and planning for a phased transition to alternative energy sources. We are here to help our clients meet these evolving energy needs.
   

  

 This is an exciting time to join us on this journey.
   

  

***Are you ready to bring the right energy to Petrofac and help us deliver a better future for everyone?***
**JOB TITLE:** 
**IT Lead \- Infrastructure**
**Role Purpose**
 The Infrastructure Lead is accountable for the successful design, delivery and transition of the Petrofac Emirates infrastructure, network and IT operations landscape as part of the Emirates Carve\-Out Programme.
   

  

 The role will provide leadership across the infrastructure workstream, ensuring that all solutions are aligned with the approved Emirates architecture, High Level Design (HLD), security standards and programme guiding principles. The individual will work closely with business, technical, security, application, procurement and managed service partners to ensure the infrastructure platform is delivered within agreed timelines, supports Day 1 operational readiness and enables a successful TSA exit.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
**Infrastructure Strategy \& Architecture**
* Own the infrastructure workstream across network, cloud, operational tooling and managed services for the new Petrofac Emirates.
* Ensure all infrastructure decisions align with the approved Emirates HLD, target architecture and programme guiding principles.
* Act as the primary infrastructure technical authority within the programme, reviewing designs and challenging deviations from architecture standards.
* Ensure infrastructure solutions remain scalable, secure, supportable and aligned to the future Petrofac Emirates operating model.
