title: Supplier Assurance Project Manager
description:
**Job Title: Supply Chain Assurance Manager – Pacific (Australia and New Zealand)**
 ISS connects people and places to make the world work better. Are you ready to connect to a place where you belong? At our corporate facilities or at client sites – together, we make places while transforming businesses into having even more positive impact on societies, the environment, and our people.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Guindy, Chennai, India
   

  

**Language:** 
 English
   

  

**Main purpose of the position:**
 ISS is looking for dynamic individuals in the supply chain, risk and assurance function to drive CUSTOMER VALUE by securing assurance of subcontractors that provide compliance services to ISS.
   

  

 We’re delighted to be recruiting for a new Supply Chain Assurance Manager to join the ISS Procurement Excellence team. This role will be predominantly working with our Australia and New Zeeland team and Group Supply chain assurance team. Working with suppliers and subcontractors who are aligned with ISS and its customers’ values is critically important to us; the Supply Chain Assurance team drive supply chain compliance with ISS standards and policies on our key customer accounts. You will be responsible for supplier relationship management. Reporting to the Assistant General Manager of Supply Chain Assurance, you will play a key role in adding value to our customer accounts in the Australia and New Zealand, minimising risk exposure via the implementation, delivery, and reinforcement of supplier management processes.
   

  

 You will work cross\-functionally to ensure effective supplier management and strong relationships with both ISS functions and countries (Australia and New Zealand).
   

  

**What you’ll do:**
* Supplier Relationship Management: Ensure focus with material supplier(s), that delivery is consistent, aligned to scope and quality assured.
* Ensure supplier performance is monitored at defined intervals, and corrective actions are implemented to address performance gaps.
* Creation of supplier contracts with flow\-down terms and conditions for our material suppliers in Australia and New Zeeland providing services to Key Accounts \- liaising with the supplier, Country Legal, the ISS customer account management team and Country Procurement category teams where appropriate. Negotiate terms, pricing and set KPIs and manage the contracts through to signing.
* Work in collaboration with the Vetting team and group assurance team to ensure compliance for suppliers in the assurance programme
* Manage ‘material’ suppliers to complete any client specific requirements
* Conduct audit support activity – introduction meeting including presentation, pre\-audit documentation, collaborate with supplier to close gap closure items and submit relevant documentation for closure
* Management of action plans for our key customer accounts, to incorporate defined standards of compliance with the Group Supply Chain \& Procurement supplier assurance programme
* Managing and reporting on performance by all parties per supplier assurance activity
* Routinely re\-communicating the supplier assurance programme parameters and its importance to all stakeholders and securing their continued buy\-in
* Support as required for wider supplier assurance activities, Procurement Excellence projects, and Supply Chain \& Procurement objectives


**Ideal Candidate**
* Previous employment in Supply Chain Management, Supplier Assurance or Procurement (typically 5\+ years), or strong corporate background in other professional services within a large organisation
* Degree level education or professional qualification (e.g., CIPS) is highly desirable
* Demonstrable experience in stakeholder/relationship management skills
* Strong business acumen, with negotiation skills (experience of working with contracts is highly desirable)
* Organised, thorough, and diligent work ethic; a desire to take ownership of tasks and deadlines, executing activities without micromanagement


**Who you’ll work with:**
* Key Account Director / Key Operation Directors – ensure in first instance Compliance Services are managed effectively.
* Critical and Strategic Suppliers (Key contacts)
* Interact with senior ISS stakeholders in establishing a fact base for implementing and driving performance management of suppliers and subcontractors
* Interact with our customers to define, deliver, and update on the assurance progress and enable a risk
* Drive results through working with country procurement, operations organizations and subcontractor.


**Personal skills you excel:**
* On a personal level, you are structured and demonstrates energy, persistence, and determination in the implementation of projects and initiatives.
* You are diplomatic and persuasive and demonstrates good understanding of the general business principles.
* Moreover, you have great interpersonal skills in building relationship and networking with both internal and external stakeholders.
* Knowledge of Technical Services


**Why ISS**
 Since our founding in 1901, ISS has been a people\-first company. We recognize the power of diversity and celebrate the differences that make us unique. When everyone is free to be themselves, everyone benefits. Our people feel safe, respected, represented, and supported as their authentic selves, allowing them to seize opportunities and reach their full potential. We take seriously our obligation to improve lives, make a difference in our communities, and protect our planet — because when we get things right, the world works better. And that is what drives us.
   

  

**ISS is a Place to Be You.**
 Be who you are. Become what you want. Be part of something bigger.
   

  

 Become more.
 **Become ISS.**
**How You’ll Apply**
 Apply directly via the link on this page by submitting a cover letter, CV and other relevant documents for the position you are applying for.
   

  

 We look forward to receiving your application as soon as possible.
   

  

**ISS seeks to BE a place of belonging and CREATE places where every person is welcomed, embraced, and valued for exactly who they are. Places where people feel safe, respected, represented, and supported as their authentic selves.**

 Posting Start Date: 9/9/26

Founded in Japan in 1935, Fujitsu has been a pioneer in technology and innovation for decades. Today, as a world\-leading digital transformation partner, we are committed to transforming business and society in the digital age.
   

  

 With approximately 130,000 employees across over 50 countries, Fujitsu offers a broad range of products, services, and solutions. We collaborate with our customers to co\-create solutions that drive enterprise\-wide digitalization while actively working to address social issues and contribute to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
   

  

**FJ Level:** 
 12
   

  

**Area/Tower:** 
 Program \& Project Management
   

  

**Purpose**
 The Program \& Project Management Services Manager is an execution\-focused leadership role and at a level below the L3 Global Sub\-Capability Head, Cluster Delivery Head of Program \& Project Services – IN/PH/MY. The role contributes to the transformation of the Global Delivery Unit into the Future Mode of Operation (FMO) supporting large\-scale adoption of automation, follow\-the\-sun delivery, AI techniques, and a one\-standard approach across Global Delivery Centers, while ensuring quality and competitiveness at a GDC level.
   

  

 The Program \& Project Management Services Manager is a GDC\-based role with accountability within a single location. The role will be responsible for operationalizing and executing globally defined sub\-capability strategies within the GDC\-specific Program \& Project Management Services’ managed area / service and team. This includes optimizing service delivery, operational performance, and delivery execution within the agreed global framework defined by L3 leadership. While global strategy ownership remains with the Cluster Delivery Head of Program \& Project Services – IN/PH/MY, decision authority of the Program \& Project Management Services Manager is focused on operational execution, prioritization, and delivery governance within a single location.
   

  

**Key Objectives**
* Given the role has single\-location accountability within one Global Delivery Center and country, execute and operationalize the globally defined sub\-capability strategy and standards for the managed area / service and team within Program \& Project Management Services of P\&PS, aligned with the HIT\&DWP Service Line strategy.
* Manage and develop high\-performing professionals within the Program \& Project Management Services’ managed area / service of dedicated location, collaborating with global and regional stakeholders.
* Provide guidance and support to local team members within the managed area, fostering continuous learning while promoting diversity and an inclusive workplace.
* Ensure effective and efficient delivery through strong people leadership, skills development, and implementation of global career pathways.
* Oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of services within the local managed area / service and team of GDC.
* Drive continuous improvement and standardization across all managed services or teams within the GDC, aligned to expected outcomes such as standardization, effectiveness, efficiency, and roadmap delivery.
* Identify opportunities for business growth and improved market competitiveness, tailored to the managed area.
* Establish and oversee management reporting, review, and change\-control processes.
* Drive the adoption and effective use of Agile practices. Implement AI and automation solutions as defined by global standrads to enhance local delivery performance.
* Ensure compliance with industry regulations, organisational and GDU policies, and incorporate ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) principles within the local GDC scope.
* Manage delivery within agreed budgets and financial frameworks defined at sub\-capability level, ensuring cost discipline and forecast accuracy.
* Participate in the pre\-sales process at local execution level, including cost\-model development and approvals.
* Continuously monitor and analyse market trends affecting the managed area / service and team of GDC to identify opportunities and challenges.


**Qualifications**
* Experience: Several years (at least 8\) in the IT industry, and in a leadership or management role.
* Significant experience in managed services operations, with a track record of implementing standardized processes and delivery excellence.
* Industry Knowledge: Deep understanding of Program \& Project Management Services related industry, including the latest trends, challenges, and opportunities.
* Certifications: preferred, but non\-mandatory certifications, i.e. ITIL, Agile, PM (PMI, Prince2, P3O, PgMP).


**Competencies**
* Operational Excellence: Knowledge of operational best practices in the Program \& Project Management Services within GDC, including process improvement, quality management, resource optimization, and performance metrics.
* Strategic and Commercial Acumen: Ability to support and execute strategic plans for Program \& Project Management Services’ growth, improve service delivery, increase client satisfaction, and align operational goals with organizational strategy.
* Financial Acumen: Understanding of financial management principles, including budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis. Ability to manage the profitability of managed area / service or team of GDC.
* Leadership and Team Management: Proven ability to lead, motivate, and develop high\-performing teams. Strong decision\-making and problem\-solving skills.
* Client Relationship Management: Experience in managing client relationships, understanding client needs, and delivering high\-quality service.
* Communication and Collaboration: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage with clients, team members, senior management, and diverse stakeholders. Demonstrated ability to foster collaboration and teamwork within GDC.
* Adaptability: Ability to adjust to rapidly changing environments while applying a problem\-solving mindset to address people challenge.

You will lead high\-visibility initiatives, investigate complex operational challenges, influence technical roadmaps, and ensure automation systems continue to operate effectively as the business scales. Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, technical aptitude, ownership, and the ability to deliver results in a fast\-paced environment.

* Partner with Product Managers, Software Engineers, Application Engineers, and Risk teams to define requirements and deliver scalable solutions.

 A day in the life
   

  

 You may start your day reviewing operational metrics and automation performance, investigating a production issue impacting a critical workflow, partnering with engineers on a new automation launch, conducting a deep dive into quality trends, or presenting program updates to senior leaders. You will regularly work across business, product, and technical teams to solve complex problems, prioritize opportunities, and deliver scalable solutions that create measurable business impact.

 The BRM Automation team is responsible for driving automation, AI adoption, and process transformation across Books Risk Management. Our mission is to improve operational efficiency, strengthen risk controls, and protect customer trust by building scalable solutions that reduce manual effort, improve decision quality, and enable the organization to scale effectively. We operate at the intersection of business, risk, and technology, partnering closely with engineering and product teams to solve some of the most complex challenges in the Books ecosystem.

* 3\+ years of program or project management experience

 Department: Project Management / Execution
 



 Reports To: Head – Projects / COO

**Role Summary** 




 The Project Manager is responsible for end‑to‑end project planning, execution, monitoring, control, and closure, ensuring timely delivery, quality compliance, safety adherence, and cost control. The role requires strong leadership, cross‑functional coordination, client management, and the ability to manage multiple teams and subcontractors.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Project Planning \& Initiation** 




 \- Develop comprehensive project execution plans, schedules, and budgets.
 



 \- Review engineering designs, BOQ, drawings, and technical specifications.
 



 \- Identify project risks and prepare mitigation plans.
 



 \- Coordinate with engineering, procurement, construction, and finance teams.
 



  





**Project Execution \& Monitoring** 




 \- Lead the execution of all project phases to meet timelines and quality standards.
 



 \- Monitor progress using MSP/Primavera and ensure adherence to baseline schedules.
 



 \- Conduct regular review meetings with site teams and contractors.
 



 \- Resolve site bottlenecks and ensure smooth project flow.
 



  





**Contractor \& Resource Management** 




 \- Finalize work packages, contractor scopes, and resource allocation.
 



 \- Oversee contractor performance, productivity, and compliance.
 



 \- Verify work measurements, certifications, and billing.
 



  





**Quality \& Compliance** 




 \- Ensure adherence to QAP, ITP, and company quality standards.
 



 \- Conduct quality audits, inspections, and review NCRs with corrective actions.
 



 \- Ensure compliance with technical specifications and statutory requirements.
 



  





**Health, Safety \& Environment (HSE)** 




 \- Enforce HSE standards across site operations.
 



 \- Ensure site safety plan implementation and regular audits.
 



 \- Promote a strong safety culture through toolbox talks and training.
 



  





**Commercial \& Cost Control** 




 \- Manage project budgets, cash flow, and material consumption.
 



 \- Identify cost‑saving opportunities and prevent cost overruns.
 



 \- Support procurement in vendor finalization and technical evaluations.
 



  





**Client \& Stakeholder Management** 




 \- Act as the single point of contact for clients, consultants, and authorities.
 



 \- Conduct progress review meetings and manage approvals.
 



 \- Handle escalations and ensure high client satisfaction.
 



  





**Reporting \& Documentation** 




 \- Prepare daily/weekly/monthly progress reports and MIS.

 \- Support management with dashboards, presentations, and closure reports.

**Educational Qualification** 




 \- Bachelor’s Degree in Civil/Electrical/Mechanical Engineering.

**Experience**

**Technical Skills** 




 \- Expertise in MS Project or Primavera.
 



 \- Strong understanding of engineering designs, drawings, and construction practices.
 



 \- Knowledge of QA/QC standards, contracts, and safety norms.
 



 \- Strong commercial and project costing knowledge.
 



  





**Behavioral Skills** 




 \- Excellent leadership and decision‑making capabilities.
 



 \- Strong interpersonal, negotiation, and communication skills.
 



 \- Ability to manage multi‑disciplinary teams.
 



 \- High adaptability and problem‑solving mindset.
 



  





 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 



 \- On‑time project delivery
 



 \- Budget adherence and cost control
 



 \- Quality compliance and minimal rework

 \- Client satisfaction and approvals

 \- Documentation accuracy and timely reporting

 and reviews regularly.
   

  

 Sound like you?
   

  

 Our successful Project Managers ...
   

  

 Engage confidently with internal and external stakeholders and see things from their
   

  

 perspective.

 Bring a structured and organised approach to everything they do.
   

  

 Communicate and collaborate to achieve success.
   

  

 Thrive under pressure and deal effectively with tight deadlines and high expectations.
   

  

 To apply you need to be:
   

  

 Project\-smart and technology\-savvy
   

  

 We employ talent from a wide range of backgrounds, though typically you should have a
   

  

 degree in any property\-related discipline, and at least 10 to 12 years’ experience in
   

  

 design, construction or project management.
   

  

 Are you technology savvy? As the digital leader in project management, we use a range
   

  

 of technology platforms to deliver our projects.
   

  

 Do you have a deep understanding of the legal environment for each project in respect to
   

  

 planning, commercial aspects, and delivery? If your answers are ‘yes’, then you’re already

 This role calls for superior communication skills, as we’ll expect you to be able to handle
   

  

 complex conversations with business owners, senior executives, and decision makers. We

 times. Of course, you’ll be good at building team relationships and interacting effectively

 What we can do for you:
   

  

 At JLL, our purpose is to shape the future of real estate for a better world.
   

  

 We make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realise your
   

  

 full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your
   

  

 ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits
   

  

 package.
   

  

 Apply today!

**Job Description**

* Take complete ownership of assigned digital transformation and MES projects.

* Track project progress against approved baseline schedules.

* Act as the primary project\-level contact for customers.
* Conduct regular project review meetings with customer stakeholders.

* Prepare and present project status reports.
* Manage customer communication related to scope, schedule, risks, issues and dependencies.

* Escalate critical customer issues to management at the appropriate time.
* Ensure customer acceptance and successful project closure.
* Technical Coordination
* Coordinate with software development teams for application development.
* Coordinate with automation teams for PLC, SCADA and machine integration.
* Coordinate with database and infrastructure teams.
* Coordinate ERP/SAP integration activities.
* Review functional and technical specifications.
* Participate in solution architecture discussions.
* Ensure technical deliverables meet project requirements.
* Support technical teams in resolving critical implementation issues.
* Ensure integration between software, hardware, machines and enterprise systems.

* Identify scope deviations during execution.

* Coordinate technical and commercial impact assessment.

* Communicate scope, schedule and cost impacts to stakeholders.
* Support the sales/commercial team in preparing change\-order proposals.
* Resource Management
* Prepare project resource plans.
* Allocate resources based on project priorities.
* Coordinate software developers, BA, QA, automation engineers, technical writers and commissioning engineers.
* Monitor resource utilization.
* Identify resource constraints and resolve conflicts.
* Plan onsite/offsite resource requirements.
* Ensure adequate technical resources are available during critical project phases.
* Risk \& Issue Management
* Identify project risks during planning and execution.
* Maintain a Project Risk Register.
* Define mitigation and contingency plans.
* Monitor technical, commercial, schedule and resource risks.
* Maintain an Issue Log and ensure timely closure.
* Escalate critical risks and issues to management.
* Conduct root\-cause analysis for major project problems.
* Implement preventive actions to avoid recurrence.
* Project Documentation

* Testing, Commissioning \& Go\-Live

* Prepare deployment and go\-live plans.

* Monitor project cost against approved budget.
* Track project profitability and resource utilization.

* Identify potential cost overruns.

title: Project Manager (Value & Delivery) - Enterprise AI
description:
**WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.**
**We unite cutting\-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world\-class creativity, next\-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.**

**For more information, visit WPP.com.**
**Why we're hiring:**
 This role provides the project management and delivery\-tracking backbone for the Value \& Delivery \& Measurement team, reporting to the Manager (Value \& Delivery) – Enterprise AI. It runs the recurring cadence \- licence utilisation, return on investment and benefits tracking, and adoption reporting \- to a dependable rhythm rather than depending on one person, and provides hands\-on delivery coordination across the opportunity pipeline: tracking, scheduling, follow\-through and status reporting. This is a coordination and tracking role, distinct from the Medallion delivery team's project managers, who run the build and deployment of agentic solutions themselves; here, the focus is on keeping the value and delivery reporting cadence moving and the opportunity pipeline visible and on schedule.
   

  

**What you'll be doing:**
* Run the recurring reporting cycles \- weekly and monthly adoption, utilisation and value packs \- to a fixed calendar and a consistent standard, so measurement keeps running independent of any one person.
* Track licence utilisation across all seven tenants: assigned against available, active against assigned, and dormant licences identified for reclaim and recycling.
* Maintain return on investment and benefits tracking against agreed business cases \- baseline, actuals, variance \- and the evidence trail behind every claim.
* Provide hands\-on delivery coordination across the opportunity pipeline: tracking, scheduling, follow\-through and status reporting, keeping a live view of what's in flight and what's at risk.
* Administer use\-case intake and first\-pass scoring, flagging items that trip a governance guardrail, and keep the intake pipeline moving rather than stalling in the queue.
* Support the Manager on Viva Insights configuration and customisation: custom dashboards, group definitions, benchmark selection, and the retention and consistency views.
* Maintain a project\-level RAID log (risks, actions, issues, decisions) and status reporting for the Value \& Delivery team's own workstreams, escalating what needs the Manager's attention.


**What you'll need:** 
  

  

* Skills / Experience Requirements (Subject to change as per role title)
+ Four to six years in project or programme delivery, business analysis, or performance and benefits reporting, ideally coordinating multiple concurrent workstreams.
+ Comfortable working with usage and adoption data \- able to build, check and explain a set of numbers, not simply present them.
+ Strong data\-handling discipline; working Viva insight and Power BI capability or the aptitude to reach it quickly.
+ Analytical curiosity that goes past the surface: asks why this method, this platform, this formula, and can justify the answer.
+ Fast learner with a track record of absorbing new tooling and turning it into working output within weeks.
+ Problem framing from the stakeholder's perspective \- able to sit with a pain point and return options rather than obstacles.
+ Organised and structured: comfortable owning a calendar of recurring deliverables, a RAID log, and a status report, and keeping them current without being chased.
+ Excellent written English; self\-directed operating style with reliable overlap into London hours.
+ Comfortable moving between granular tracking work and a high\-level status conversation, and increasingly able to judge which the moment needs.

* Qualification Requirements (Desirable) (Subject to change as per role title)
+ Microsoft AZ\-900 and DP\-900 or equivalent cloud and data fundamentals; PMP, Prince2 or equivalent project/programme management certification is an advantage; prior involvement in a Copilot or Microsoft 365 rollout is an advantage.

**You're open

 we are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open\-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

 we approach all that we do with confidence: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

 We are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. title: Program Manager II (Cost To Serve), RBS : Cost To Serve
description:
**Description**
 Are you passionate about solving business challenges at a global scale? Amazon Retail Business Services is looking for an experienced Business Analyst to join our team and help unlock insights which take our business to the next level. The candidate will be excited about understanding and implementing new and repeatable processes to improve our employee global work authorization experiences. They will do this by partnering with key stakeholders to be curious and comfortable digging deep into the business challenges to understand and identify insights that will enable us to figure out standards to improve our ability to globally scale this program. They will be comfortable delivering/presenting these recommended solutions by retrieving and integrating artifacts in a format that is immediately useful to improve the business decision\-making process. This role requires an individual with excellent analytical abilities as well as business acumen. The candidate knows and values our customers (internal and external) and will work back from the customer to create structured processes for global expansions of work authorization, and help integrate new countries/new acquisitions into the existing program. They are experts in partnering and earning trust with operations/business leaders to drive these key business decisions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own the development and maintenance of new and existing artifacts focused on analysis of requirements, metrics, and reporting dashboards.
* Partner with operations/business teams to consult, develop and implement KPI’s, automated reporting/process solutions, and process improvements to meet business needs.
* Enable effective decision making by retrieving and aggregating data from multiple sources and compiling it into a digestible and actionable format.
* Prepare and deliver business requirements reviews to the senior management team regarding progress and roadblocks.
* Participate in strategic and tactical planning discussions.
* Design, develop and maintain scaled, automated, user\-friendly systems, reports, dashboards, etc. that will support our business needs.
* Excellent writing skills, to create artifacts easily digestible by business and tech partners.


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Define and Drive Business Goals: Lead strategic initiatives to reduce Cost to Serve (CtS) across key areas, including inventory defects, shipping costs and operational inefficiencies. Own the lifecycle of these initiatives, from problem definition to solution implementation, with limited leadership direction.
* Data\-Driven Decision\-Making: Use advanced analytics tools to uncover inefficiencies, analyze cost and volume drivers, and develop actionable solutions. Drive detailed discussions based on data insights and align cross\-functional teams on high\-priority initiatives.
* Financial Collaboration: Partner with finance teams to validate cost models, forecast savings and ensure alignment with Amazon’s financial goals. Make trade\-offs between short\-term cost reductions and long\-term strategic objectives to maximize financial impact.
* Cross\-Functional Leadership: Collaborate with cross\-functional teams across finance, operations and supply chain to implement scalable solutions. Unblock teams to increase speed of delivery and ensure alignment on program goals.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Conduct deep dives into defects to identify systemic inefficiencies, leveraging frameworks like Upstream Defect Elimination (UDE). Influence technology decisions and external entity interactions to resolve complex, undefined problems effectively.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Communicate effectively with senior leaders, presenting data\-driven insights and recommendations to influence decision\-making. Trusted to present decisions to leaders up to three tiers above level, driving alignment across diverse areas.
* Scalable Solutions: Develop and implement scalable programs across geographies, incorporating regional nuances and best practices.


**About The Team**
 Cost to Serve (CTS) aims to identify and eliminate waste, negative experiences, and non\-value activities across the end\-to\-end remit of supply chain and dependent workstreams that slow down resolution for our stakeholders. The primary objective is to reduce Cost To Serve for Amazon and enable “Free Cash Flow” by optimizing the Cost per shipped unit economics across the supply chain systems. Our program will support in establishing the end\-to\-end supply chain checkpoints on how the inventory moves inside Amazon to identify gaps, broken processes/policies to eliminate root causes of systemic difficulties rather than merely addressing symptoms, on behalf of our customers. This team will partner with internal/external stakeholders to establish the FCF/Cost to serve charter based on opportunity size and own specific unique initiatives that are beyond the existing team’s program scope.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

title: Learning Content Producer – 3D & Video
description:
Hexr Factory is a next\-generation immersive technology company and an Unreal Engine Authorized Service Partner — redefining how businesses and teams turn ideas into reality through powerful, real\-time digital experiences.
   

  

 We don’t just build products — we engineer dynamic, interactive ecosystems that transform complex concepts into compelling, high\-impact solutions. From cutting\-edge digital twins and advanced simulations to fully interactive platforms, our work enables sectors such as AEC, real estate, automotive, edtech and enterprise to visualise, communicate and operate with exceptional clarity and accuracy.
   

  

 At Hexr, innovation is at the core of everything we do. Our multidisciplinary team blends deep interactive realtime 3D expertise with leading\-edge software engineering, design thinking and high\-fidelity visualization to deliver visually striking, technically robust experiences across web, desktop and mobile environments.
   

  

 This is a place for ambitious thinkers and problem\-solvers — people who want to push boundaries, build meaningful technology and create experiences that don’t just look good, but truly make an impact.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a Learning Content Producer – 3D \& Video to own day\-to\-day planning and delivery across digital\-learning content production. The role turns approved scripts, storyboards and animatics into structured, trackable production plans and coordinates the complete content pipeline—from 3D assets, animation and lighting through video, voice\-over, subtitles, review and quality control—to ensure work is delivered on time, at the required quality, and ready for formal review and delivery.
   

  

 You will work closely with the Creative Director, Project Head, instructional designers, storyboard artists, 3D artists, animators, editors, QA teams, language and voice teams, vendors and relevant stakeholders. This is a hands\-on delivery leadership role: the focus is dependable execution, clear ownership, early risk visibility and disciplined follow\-through.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Build and maintain master schedules for content units, segments, shots and deliverables.
* Break briefs and scripts into clear tasks, dependencies, owners, estimates, milestones and review gates.
* Track daily production across scripting, storyboarding, animatics, 3D, animation, lighting, rendering, video editing, audio, subtitles, translation and QA.
* Coordinate handoffs between creative, technical, production and quality teams so work does not stall between stages.
* Maintain a single source of truth for status, blockers, priorities, due dates, feedback, revisions and next actions.
* Monitor workload and capacity, identify bottlenecks early, and recommend practical reallocation or sequencing changes.
* Run concise production reviews and stand\-ups, document decisions and follow up until actions are closed.
* Establish and enforce internal quality gates; ensure only complete, checked and approved work moves to formal review or delivery.
* Review progress and output readiness across multiple teams without replacing specialist creative or technical ownership.
* Coordinate external vendors and contract teams, including briefs, handoffs, follow\-ups, review cycles, corrections and delivery commitments.
* Prepare clear status reports covering progress, risks, dependencies, resource constraints, decisions required and recovery actions.
* Communicate with internal and external stakeholders professionally, escalating risks with options and evidence.
* Support realistic planning during peak delivery periods while protecting quality, ownership and sustainable workload.
* Maintain organised production records, trackers, references, approvals and version history.
* Handle work materials with discretion and confidentiality.


**Required Experience \& Skills**
* 5–10 years of experience in production, delivery, project coordination or program operations within digital learning, animation, media, gaming, VFX, interactive content or related industries.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams and delivering multiple content streams or recurring deliverables.
* Strong understanding of digital learning and content production workflows, including scripts, storyboards, animatics, 3D and animation, video, audio, subtitles, review and QA.
* Proven ability to build schedules, manage dependencies, maintain trackers and drive closure of blockers.
* Practical experience with quality gates, review cycles, feedback management and delivery\-ready outputs.
* Strong workload planning, prioritisation, risk management and escalation skills.
* Experience coordinating vendors, contract teams or distributed production teams.
* Strong written and spoken communication in English is required. Ability to read and write Hindi fluently is mandatory.
* Comfortable working with Excel or Google Sheets and project or task\-tracking tools such as ClickUp, Jira, Asana, Trello, ShotGrid, fTrack or equivalent.
* Ability to work from the Chennai workspace on a full\-time, on\-site basis.
* Strong ownership, attention to detail and ability to operate calmly under delivery pressure.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience in e\-learning, educational video, animation, 3D production or game\-engine\-based workflows.
* Familiarity with subtitles, dubbing or voice\-over, language review and localisation workflows.
* Experience with production dashboards, reporting, SOPs, QC checklists or process improvement.
* Experience managing high\-volume, repetitive content delivery with consistent quality.
* Relevant education in project management, media, animation, digital learning, design, technology or an equivalent practical background.

title: Client Relationship Manager
description:
Company Description
 



 Uplift Innovations is a new\-age marketing and advertising company specializing in end\-to\-end offline branding solutions for businesses. The team designs 360\-degree offline marketing and advertising services with custom\-built brand strategies to drive better lead conversions and measurable ROI. Uplift Innovations works across the offline marketing landscape, including brand activation, sales promotion branding, OOH campaigns, community engagement, public relations, and brand marketing strategy. By focusing on personalized, customer\-centric content and strategic implementation, the company helps brands build a distinct voice, engage more customers, and unlock their potential as trendsetters in the marketplace.We are looking for a dynamic and client\-focused Client Servicing Executive to manage and execute Below\-the\-Line (BTL) marketing campaigns. The ideal candidate will serve as the primary point of contact between clients and internal teams, ensuring seamless execution of brand activations, promotional campaigns, retail branding, roadshows, and experiential marketing initiatives.This role requires excellent communication, strong project coordination skills, and the ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously while maintaining high client satisfaction.
 



  





 Key Roles :
 


* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, understanding their business objectives and marketing requirements.
* Manage end\-to\-end execution of BTL marketing campaigns, including brand activations, roadshows, apartment activations, mall activations, retail branding, product launches, sampling campaigns, kiosks, and experiential events.
* Coordinate with creative, production, operations, fabrication, logistics, and vendor teams to ensure timely project delivery.
* Prepare campaign proposals, presentations, quotations, timelines, and execution plans.
* Attend client meetings, conduct campaign briefings, and provide regular project updates.
* Coordinate with field teams to ensure flawless campaign execution across multiple locations.
* Monitor campaign performance and prepare post\-campaign reports with execution insights, photographs, and performance metrics.
* Handle client feedback and resolve issues promptly to ensure exceptional service delivery.
* Manage campaign budgets, vendor coordination, billing documentation, and project closures.
* Conduct market visits and oversee on\-ground execution whenever required.
* Identify opportunities for campaign enhancements and recommend innovative offline marketing solutions.
* Required SkillsExcellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong client relationship management abilities.
* Knowledge of BTL marketing, brand activation, retail branding, experiential marketing, and promotional campaigns.
* Project management and coordination skills.
* Vendor and stakeholder management.
* Problem\-solving and negotiation skills.
* Ability to work under tight deadlines and manage multiple projects.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).
* Familiarity with CRM and project management tools is an added advantage.
* Required hands on experience in Ai tools.
